The table skidded sideways, so {name} held tight and scooted along with it. Meiqi, who had been by the window, crawled away from the glass and squeezed in too. Then the shaking stopped. "Stay put," Mr. Chen said. "Wait for your teacher."

Ms. Lin counted every head before she spoke. "Line up and follow me. Walking feet." One by one, the class filed out, with no pushing and no racing. {name} glanced back at the table with a sheepish grin. "My champion running legs couldn't even manage two steps in there. I guess an earthquake isn't a race." Kai burst out laughing, and Meiqi giggled so hard she had to hold her stomach.

On the bus home, Kai still wasn't convinced. "Next time I'm zooming down the stairs and outside." {name} shook {his} head. "Stairs shake the worst, and everyone crowds together, so it's easy to trip. Outside, signs and glass can fall. Under a strong table, your head and neck are safe. And you hold the leg because the table moves." "What if there's no table?" Meiqi asked. "Crouch by an inside wall, away from windows, and cover your head with your arms."

Kai thought it over and finally nodded. "Okay. Then I'll be the fastest ducker in class." "We'll see," {name} said with a grin. "I've already had practice!" From the front seat, Ms. Lin turned around. "Our school drill is next week. How about you two be team leaders and help everyone practice?" Outside, the city lights blinked on one by one, and {name} felt completely ready.

questions: 在體驗屋裡地板開始搖晃時，{name}做了哪三個動作？為什麼要抓住桌腳？
小凱想衝下樓梯跑到外面，{name}是怎麼跟他說的？你同意嗎？
如果在我們家地震了，你覺得哪張桌子最適合躲？哪些地方要離遠一點？
zh.tip: 這週找一個晚上在家玩「地震小演習」：家長喊「地震來了！」，孩子練習趴下、躲到結實的桌下護住頭頸、抓住桌腳，數到二十後再等大人帶著慢慢走出來。

questions: When the floor started shaking in the Shake Room, what three things did {name} do? Why hold on to the table leg?
Kai wanted to run down the stairs and outside. What did {name} tell him? Do you agree?
If the ground shook in our home, which table would be the best one to get under? Which spots should we stay away from?
en.tip: One evening this week, play a quick 'shake drill' at home: call out 'The ground is shaking!' and have your child drop, cover head and neck under a sturdy table, and hold on, then count to twenty and wait for you to lead the way out calmly.

zh: 早上，媽媽牽著{name}走到校門口。媽媽蹲下來，小聲說：「我們來想一個祕密口令。」{name}眨眨眼說：「要很特別的！」媽媽笑著說：「就叫『彩虹企鵝』吧。」{name}在心裡念了三遍。「只有我們家知道喔！」媽媽說。「放學時，媽媽會來接你。」
今天，王老師帶大家去校園探險。每個人都拿著一張小地圖，一起找寶藏。{name}走過溜滑梯，又繞過大榕樹。花圃裡，有一隻蝸牛慢慢爬。「找到了！」{name}在沙坑旁挖到一個小盒子。盒子裡有一張閃亮亮的星星貼紙。
下午，大家把探險畫成一幅畫。{name}畫了蝸牛、榕樹，還有寶藏盒。噹噹噹，放學鐘聲響了。大家背起書包，跟著王老師排隊。校門口好熱鬧，有好多來接小朋友的大人。{name}踮起腳，找啊找，還沒看到媽媽。
這時候，一位阿姨走了過來。{name}從來沒見過她。阿姨笑咪咪地說：「媽媽叫我來接你喔。」她拿出一支彩色棒棒糖。「這個給你，我們走吧！」棒棒糖圓圓的，好漂亮。可是{name}把小手放好，沒有去拿。
{name}想起早上的事，心裡咚咚跳。「阿姨，我們家的祕密口令是什麼？」阿姨愣了一下。她歪著頭說：「口令？嗯⋯⋯我不知道耶。」{name}深深吸一口氣。媽媽說過，口令只有我們家知道。
「不要！我不跟你走！」{name}大聲說。這個聲音好大，好響亮。{he}轉過身，跑向排隊的王老師。「王老師！有一個我不認識的阿姨，她說要帶我走！」王老師馬上牽起{name}的手。「你做得很好，先待在老師旁邊。」
王老師請警衛伯伯過去。伯伯去和那位阿姨說說話。接著，王老師打電話給媽媽。「媽媽說，她沒有請別人來接你。」王老師溫柔地說：「她馬上就到。」{name}坐在老師身邊，緊緊握著星星貼紙。王老師說：「很多人都很友善。可是我們只跟爸媽說好的大人走。」
沒多久，媽媽快步走進校門。媽媽蹲下來，小聲說：「彩虹企鵝。」{name}笑了，撲進媽媽懷裡。「你大聲說不要，還跑去找老師，好勇敢！」媽媽緊緊抱著{him}。{name}把星星貼紙貼在媽媽手上。「這是今天的探險寶藏，送給你！」
en: In the morning, Mom walked {name} to the school gate. She whispered, "Let's make a secret password." "A special one!" said {name}. "How about 'rainbow penguin'?" Mom smiled. {name} repeated it three times. "Only our family knows it," Mom said. "I'll pick you up after school."

That day, Teacher Wang led a school adventure. Everyone got a little treasure map. {name} passed the slide and the big banyan tree. A snail crept slowly in the flower bed. "Found it!" By the sandbox, {name} dug up a tiny box. Inside was a shiny star sticker.

In the afternoon, everyone drew their adventure. {name} drew the snail, the tree, and the box. Ding, ding, ding! The last bell rang. The class lined up with Teacher Wang. The gate was busy with grown-ups. {name} stood on tiptoe and looked around. No Mom yet.

Then a woman walked over. {name} had never seen her before. She smiled. "Your mom sent me to get you." She held out a rainbow lollipop. "This is for you. Let's go!" It looked so pretty. But {name} kept both hands still.

{name} remembered the morning. Thump, thump! "What's our family's secret password?" {he} asked. The woman tilted her head. "Password? Hmm... I don't know." {name} took a deep breath. Only their family knew it.

"No! I won't go with you!" {name} said in a big, loud voice. Then {he} ran straight to Teacher Wang. "A lady I don't know wants to take me!" Teacher Wang held {name}'s hand right away. "You did great. Stay here with me."

Teacher Wang asked the school guard to talk with the woman. Then she called Mom. "Mom didn't send anyone," she said gently. "She's on her way." {name} held the star sticker tight. "Lots of people are friendly," said Teacher Wang. "But we only go with grown-ups our parents choose."

Soon Mom hurried through the gate. She knelt and whispered, "Rainbow penguin." {name} smiled and jumped into Mom's arms. "You said no loudly and found your teacher. So brave!" Mom hugged {him} tight. {name} stuck the star sticker on Mom's hand. "My adventure treasure. It's for you!"

questions: 阿姨拿出棒棒糖時，{name}做了什麼？為什麼？
如果有不認識的人說要帶你走，你會怎麼說、去找誰？
在你的生活裡，有哪些大人是爸媽說好可以接你的？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起想一個家裡的祕密口令，並約定只有爸媽說好的大人才會知道。也可以玩角色扮演，練習大聲說「不要！」再跑去找老師。

questions: What did {name} do when the woman held out the lollipop? Why?
If someone you don't know asked you to come along, what would you say, and who would you go to?
Which grown-ups in your life have we agreed can pick you up?
en.tip: Tonight, make up a secret family password together and agree that only grown-ups you choose will know it. Then role-play: practice saying "No!" loudly and running to a teacher.

title.en: {name} Says No at the Train Station

zh: 星期六早上，{name}和爸爸要搭火車去海邊的奶奶家。車站好大，屋頂高高的，廣播聲在空中迴盪，一列銀色的火車正慢慢駛進月台。{name}握緊爸爸的手，心裡咚咚跳：「今天是一場真正的冒險！」
售票機前排了長長的隊伍。爸爸說：「我們一起排隊，你就站在我旁邊，看看牆上的路線圖好嗎？」{name}點點頭，緊挨著爸爸，用手指沿著彩色的線條找：藍線經過大橋，綠線穿過山洞，最後一站就是奶奶住的小鎮。
這時，一位戴著帽子的叔叔走過來，笑咪咪的。他手上拿著一張亮晶晶的星星貼紙，在燈光下閃呀閃。「小朋友，這個送你。」叔叔說，「我的店就在轉角，裡面還有好多更漂亮的貼紙，跟我去挑一張吧！」
{name}好喜歡那張貼紙，可是突然想起來，爸爸並不認識這位叔叔。{name}把雙手放到背後，往後退了一步，大聲說：「不要，謝謝！我不跟你去！」聲音清清楚楚，連前面排隊的阿姨都轉過頭來看。
{name}轉身靠緊爸爸，拉拉爸爸的袖子：「爸爸，那個叔叔要給我貼紙，還叫我去他的店。」爸爸立刻蹲下來，摟住{name}的肩膀說：「你馬上來告訴我，做得真好。」那位叔叔聳聳肩，往別處走開了。
買好車票後，爸爸牽著{name}，走到穿藍色制服的站務員陳阿姨面前，把事情說了一遍。陳阿姨仔細聽完，拿起對講機說了幾句話。接著她彎下腰，對{name}微笑：「謝謝你勇敢說出來，車站裡的大家都會更安心。」
陳阿姨又說：「車站裡有很多好心的人，像賣便當的伯伯、開火車的司機。不過要跟誰去哪裡、收誰的東西，都要先問爸爸媽媽喔。」她從口袋拿出一枚小小的火車徽章，先看看爸爸。爸爸點點頭，{name}才開心的收下。
廣播響起：「往海邊的火車即將進站。」{name}把徽章別在背包上，牽著爸爸走上月台。火車轟隆隆的開動了，窗外的大樓一棟棟往後跑。{name}靠在爸爸身邊，想著要跟奶奶分享今天車站裡的大冒險。
en: On Saturday morning, {name} and Dad were taking a train to Grandma's house by the sea. The station was huge, with a high, high roof and voices echoing from the speakers. A silver train glided up to the platform. {name} squeezed Dad's hand. "This is a real adventure!"

There was a long line at the ticket machines. "Let's wait together," said Dad. "Stay right next to me and look at the map on the wall." {name} stood close to Dad and traced the colored lines with one finger. Blue crossed a bridge, green ran through a tunnel, and the last stop was Grandma's town.

Just then, a smiling man in a cap walked over. He held up a sparkly star sticker that twinkled under the lights. "This is for you," he said. "My shop is just around the corner, and it has lots more stickers, even prettier ones. Come with me and pick one!"

{name} really liked that sticker. But then {name} remembered that Dad didn't know this man. {name} put both hands behind {his} back, took a step away, and said in a big, clear voice, "No, thank you! I'm not going with you!" Even the lady ahead in line turned around.

{name} hurried back to Dad's side and tugged his sleeve. "Dad, that man wanted to give me a sticker and take me to his shop." Dad knelt down right away and wrapped an arm around {name}. "You came straight to tell me. That was just right." The man shrugged and wandered off.

Once the tickets were bought, Dad and {name} went to Ms. Chen, a station worker in a blue uniform. Dad told her what had happened. Ms. Chen listened carefully, then spoke into her radio. She bent down and smiled at {name}. "Thank you for speaking up. You helped make the station safer for everyone."

"Lots of people here are kind," Ms. Chen said, "like the lunchbox seller and the train drivers. But always ask your mom or dad before you go anywhere with someone or take something from them." She pulled a tiny train badge from her pocket and looked at Dad first. Dad nodded, and {name} happily took it.

"The train to the seaside is arriving," called the speaker. {name} pinned the badge on {his} backpack and walked to the platform holding Dad's hand. The train rumbled off, and tall buildings slid past the window. Snuggled beside Dad, {name} couldn't wait to tell Grandma about the big station adventure.

questions: 那位叔叔請{name}去他的店時，{name}做了哪些事？
如果有你不認識的人要送你零食或玩具，你會怎麼說、怎麼做？
陳阿姨給徽章時，{name}為什麼要先看爸爸點頭？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子玩「不要，謝謝！」練習遊戲：你扮演拿著小禮物的陌生人，讓孩子大聲說不、退後一步，再跑來告訴你。也可以一起列出幾位「爸媽同意可以一起走的大人」。

questions: What did {name} do when the man asked {him} to come to his shop?
What would you say and do if someone you don't know offered you a snack or a toy?
Why did {name} wait for Dad to nod before taking the badge from Ms. Chen?
en.tip: This week, play a "No, thank you!" practice game: you pretend to be a stranger with a small gift, and your child says no loudly, steps back, and comes to tell you. You can also make a short list together of grown-ups you've agreed they may go with.

title.en: The Rice Cooker Whale Goes Puff

zh: 廚房裡，電鍋咕嘟咕嘟。小煙囪噗噗冒白煙。噗——噗——好像鯨魚在噴水！{name}看呆了。「爺爺，鯨魚！」爺爺笑呵呵：「對呀，是電鍋鯨魚。」
{name}伸出{his}小手，想摸摸白煙。爺爺輕輕說：「等一下喔。」「白煙燙燙的。」「只有大人可以碰。」{name}把小手收回來，藏到背後去。
爺爺拿出粉筆，蹲在地上。畫呀畫，畫呀畫。畫出一個大圓圈。「這是安全圈。」「站在這裡看鯨魚。」{name}跳進圓圈裡。咚！站得好好的。
電鍋鯨魚噗噗噴水。{name}在圈圈裡拍手。「鯨魚，你好！」噗——白煙飄高高。{name}也學鯨魚，嘟起小嘴巴。呼——噗！爺爺笑得眼睛彎彎。
爺爺指著爐子上的水壺。「水壺也燙燙。」再指指鍋子裡的湯。「熱湯也燙燙。」「爐子也燙燙。」{name}點點頭。「燙燙的，爺爺碰。」「沒錯！」爺爺比個讚。
嗶嗶嗶！水壺突然大叫。{name}往後退一步。站在圈圈裡大喊：「爺爺！水壺叫了！」爺爺快快走過來，關掉爐火。「謝謝你叫爺爺！」{name}好得意。
叮！電鍋跳起來了。飯煮好囉！爺爺盛了一碗白飯。白飯冒著小白煙。「還燙燙喔，一起吹吹。」呼——呼——{name}吹，爺爺也吹。小白煙飄走了。
爺爺摸摸碗邊。「好了，涼涼了！」{name}舀起一大口。啊嗚！香香又軟軟。電鍋鯨魚不噴水了。好像在睡午覺。{name}小聲說：「鯨魚，謝謝你的飯。」
en: In the kitchen, the rice cooker hums. Its little chimney puffs white steam. Puff! Puff! It looks like a whale! "Grandpa, a whale!" says {name}. Grandpa chuckles. "Yes, a rice cooker whale."
{name} reaches out a little hand. Grandpa says softly, "Wait, please. The steam is hot. Only grown-ups touch it." {name} pulls the hand back. Tuck! It hides behind {his} back.
Grandpa gets some chalk. He kneels on the floor. Round and round, round and round. A big circle! "This is the safe circle. We watch the whale from here." {name} hops in. Thump!
Puff! Puff! The whale blows steam. {name} claps inside the circle. "Hello, whale!" The steam floats up high. {name} puckers up like a whale. Whoo, puff! Grandpa laughs and laughs.

Grandpa points at the kettle. "The kettle is hot, too." He points at the soup pot. "The soup is hot." "The stove is hot." {name} nods. "Hot things are for Grandpa." "That's right!" Grandpa gives a thumbs-up.
Wheee! The kettle whistles loudly. {name} takes a step back. "Grandpa! The kettle is calling!" Grandpa hurries over. Click! He turns off the stove. "Thank you for calling me!" {name} feels so proud.
Ding! The rice cooker pops. The rice is ready! Grandpa fills a bowl. Tiny steam puffs float up. "Still hot. Let's blow together." Whoo, whoo! {name} blows. Grandpa blows. The steam drifts away.
Grandpa touches the bowl. "Okay, it's cool now!" {name} takes a big bite. Mmm! Soft and yummy. The whale is quiet now. Maybe it's napping. {name} whispers, "Thank you, whale, for the rice."

questions: 水壺嗶嗶叫的時候，{name}做了什麼？
我們家有哪些燙燙的東西，只有大人可以碰？
飯還燙燙的時候，我們可以一起怎麼做？
zh.tip: 今晚吃飯前，一起在廚房找一個「安全圈」位置，並練習說：「燙燙的，往後退，叫大人！」等大人說涼了，再一起呼呼吹。

questions: What did {name} do when the kettle whistled?
What hot things in our home are only for grown-ups to touch?
When food is still hot, what can we do together?
en.tip: Before dinner tonight, pick a "safe circle" spot in your kitchen together and practice saying, "Hot! Step back and call a grown-up!" Then wait until you say it's cool, and blow on the food together.

zh: 冷冷的晚上，窗外風呼呼吹。廚房裡，水壺「嗚——」地叫起來。爸爸說：「水壺好燙，我來拿。」{name}坐在椅子上，看爸爸倒熱水。電鍋噗噗冒白煙，像一朵小雲。貓咪麻糬想去聞一聞。奶奶把牠抱開：「白煙很燙喔。」
餐桌中間，放著一個大火鍋。媽媽打開爐子，湯咕嘟咕嘟響。「哇，湯在唱歌！」{name}笑著說。媽媽說：「鍋子和爐子好燙，大人來煮就好。」{name}點點頭，坐得直直的，像個乖乖的小客人。
爸爸放進高麗菜，奶奶放進玉米。媽媽丟進好多圓圓的魚丸。魚丸在湯裡翻跟斗，一下浮上來，一下沉下去。「魚丸在游泳！」{name}拍拍手。麻糬在桌子下喵喵叫，好像也想吃。
媽媽用大湯匙撈起一顆魚丸，放進{name}的小盤子。魚丸冒著熱氣，聞起來香香的。{name}好想馬上咬一口。媽媽說：「還很燙喔，等它涼一點。」{name}小聲咕噥：「魚丸，你快點變涼嘛！」
奶奶笑著說：「我們一起吹吹它。」{name}和奶奶鼓起臉頰，一起吹。「呼——呼——」熱氣飄呀飄，慢慢跑走了。麻糬也湊過來，鬍子抖一抖，好像在幫忙吹。大家都笑了。
媽媽摸摸盤子邊，說：「好了，現在可以吃囉。」{name}咬一口，魚丸軟軟又Q彈。「好好吃！」{he}開心得腳晃呀晃。爸爸眨眨眼說：「等一等，真的會更好吃。」
這時，爸爸放進一大塊豆腐。湯「噗通」一聲，濺出幾滴。熱湯落在桌上，冒出小白煙。{name}馬上把椅子往後挪，大聲叫：「媽媽，湯跳出來了！」媽媽拿抹布擦乾淨，說：「往後退再叫我，你做得真好。」
吃飽了，媽媽關掉爐子。電鍋的白煙也慢慢不見了。{name}抱著暖暖的麻糬，打了個小呵欠。窗外還在吹風，屋裡卻好溫暖。{name}小聲說：「明天還要吃魚丸，我們一起吹吹。」
en: It was a chilly, windy night. In the kitchen, the kettle whistled. "The kettle is hot. I'll get it," said Dad. {name} watched from {his} chair. The rice cooker puffed steam like a tiny cloud. Mochi the cat sniffed at it. Grandma picked her up. "Steam is hot, Mochi."

A big hot pot sat in the middle of the table. Mom turned on the stove. Blub, blub, bubble went the soup. "The soup is singing!" {name} giggled. "The pot and stove are hot," said Mom. "Grown-ups will cook." {name} nodded and sat up tall.

Dad added cabbage. Grandma added corn. Mom dropped in lots of round fish balls. Up they bobbed, then down they dipped. "The fish balls are swimming!" {name} clapped. Under the table, Mochi meowed. She wanted some too.

Mom scooped one fish ball onto {name}'s little plate. It smelled so good, but it was still steaming. {name} wanted a bite right away. "It's still hot," said Mom. "Let's wait." {name} whispered, "Hurry, fish ball. Cool down, please!"

Grandma smiled. "Let's blow on it together." {name} and Grandma puffed out their cheeks. Whoo! Whoo! The steam floated up and drifted away. Mochi leaned in too, whiskers twitching, as if she was helping. Everyone laughed.
Mom touched the edge of the plate. "Okay, it's cool now." {name} took a bite. Soft and bouncy! "Yummy!" Happy feet swung under the chair. Dad winked. "Waiting makes it taste even better."

Then Dad dropped in a big piece of tofu. Plop! A few drops of soup splashed onto the table. {name} scooted the chair back fast. "Mom! The soup jumped out!" Mom wiped it up with a cloth. "Good job stepping back and calling me," she said.

Soon everyone was full. Mom turned off the stove. The rice cooker stopped puffing. {name} cuddled warm, sleepy Mochi and gave a tiny yawn. Outside, the wind still blew. Inside, it was warm and cozy. "Tomorrow, more fish balls," {name} said softly. "We'll blow on them together."

questions: 吃火鍋的時候，誰來煮湯、拿水壺？{name}坐在哪裡？
魚丸還很燙的時候，{name}和奶奶一起做了什麼？
如果你看到湯濺出來，或是東西冒熱氣，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 今晚吃飯時，練習一句「等大人說涼了，我們一起吹吹」，再一起吹一口食物。也可以在家指一指水壺、爐子和電鍋，說「這是大人的燙燙東西」。

questions: At hot pot dinner, who cooked the soup and carried the kettle? Where did {name} stay?
When the fish ball was still hot, what did {name} and Grandma do?
What would you do if soup splashed or something was steaming near you?
en.tip: At dinner tonight, practice saying "Wait for a grown-up to say it's cool, then blow together," and blow on a bite side by side. You can also point to the kettle, stove, and rice cooker and call them "grown-up hot things."

zh: 嘩啦啦，洗澡真好玩。{name}洗好澡了。水珠滴答，滴答，滴答。媽媽拿出吹風機。「要呼呼囉！」{name}開心地拍拍手。
{name}拿起插頭。「我來插！像媽媽一樣！」媽媽說：「等一等喔。」「看看你的小手。」{name}低頭看一看。哎呀，濕濕的！還有水珠呢。
媽媽說：「濕濕的手，」「和插頭不見面。」「插頭不喜歡水喔。」{name}點點頭。{he}把插頭放回桌上。輕輕的，慢慢的。「插頭，先休息一下。」
牆上有個插座。小洞洞，排排站。像兩隻小眼睛。{name}說：「它在看我！」媽媽笑咪咪。「插座是大人的工作。」「手指不進去，」「筷子也不進去。」
「那我做什麼呢？」媽媽遞來大毛巾。「你是毛巾小幫手！」擦擦手心，擦擦手背。擦擦小手指。擦呀擦，擦呀擦。乾乾的，好舒服！
媽媽拿起電線。「我們一起看一看。」電線長長的，滑滑的。沒有破洞，沒有裂開。「如果破破的，」「或冒出小火花，」「我們就退後，叫大人。」{name}退一小步：「叫媽媽！」
媽媽的手乾乾的。插頭插好了，喀！{name}抱著毛巾。站得好好的，乖乖的。媽媽按下開關。呼呼呼！呼呼呼！暖暖的風來了！
呼呼呼，吹吹手臂。呼呼呼，吹吹肚子。{name}咯咯笑：「好癢喔！」乾乾的，暖暖的。媽媽拔好插頭，收好電線。{name}抱著毛巾說：「明天我還要當小幫手！」
en: Splish, splash! Bath time is fun. Now {name} is all done. Drip, drop, drip go the water drops. Mom takes out the hair dryer. "Whoosh time!" {name} claps and claps.
{name} grabs the plug. "I can do it! Just like Mom!" Mom says, "Wait a moment." "Look at your hands." {name} looks. Oops! Still wet and drippy!
"Wet hands and plugs never meet," says Mom. "Plugs do not like water." {name} nods. Then {he} sets the plug on the table. Slow and gentle. "Rest, little plug."
There is a socket on the wall. Two tiny holes in a row. "It looks like eyes!" says {name}. Mom giggles. "Sockets are a grown-up job." "No fingers inside. No sticks inside."
"Then what can I do?" Mom gives {him} a big towel. "You can be the towel helper!" Rub the palms. Rub the backs. Rub each tiny finger. Rub, rub, rub! All dry!
Mom picks up the cord. "Let's check it together." It is long and smooth. No cracks, no holes. "If it looks broken, or sparks, we step back." "We tell a grown-up." {name} steps back. "Tell Mom!"
Mom's hands are dry. She pushes in the plug. Click! {name} hugs the towel. {name} stands nice and still. Mom flips the switch. Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! Here comes warm air!
Whoosh on {his} arms. Whoosh, tummy too! {name} giggles. "It tickles!" Warm and dry. Mom unplugs it and puts the cord away. {name} hugs the towel. "I'll help again tomorrow!"

questions: {name}的手濕濕的時候，媽媽請{him}做什麼？
牆上的插座是誰的工作？手指和東西可以放進去嗎？
如果你看到電線破破的或冒火花，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 今晚洗完澡，請孩子當「毛巾小幫手」，先把手擦乾，再由大人插插頭；一起練習說：「破破的，退後，叫大人！」

questions: What did Mom ask {name} to do when {his} hands were wet?
Whose job is the socket on the wall? Can fingers or sticks go in?
What would you do if you saw a broken cord or a spark?
en.tip: After tonight's bath, let your child be the towel helper who dries hands before a grown-up plugs anything in. Practice the phrase together: "Broken? Step back, tell a grown-up!"

title.en: {name} and the Spark Behind the TV

zh: 星期六早上，{name}在客廳玩小火車。小火車的名字叫「嘟嘟號」。{name}輕輕一推，嘟嘟號咻地跑走了！它滑過地毯，鑽進電視櫃後面，一下子就不見了。{name}大聲說：「嘟嘟號，我來救你！」尋寶冒險開始囉！
{name}拿起小手電筒，趴在地上往裡面看。電視後面暗暗的，有好多灰塵。一條條黑黑的電線彎來彎去，像睡著的小蛇。咦，{name}看到嘟嘟號了！它就停在一條舊延長線旁邊，好像在等人來救它。
{name}慢慢伸出手，想拿回小火車。突然，「啪！」傳來一聲好小的響聲。延長線閃出一點亮亮的火花。{name}睜大眼睛再看一次。原來舊電線上有一道裂縫，外面那層皮破了一個小口。
{name}馬上把手縮回來。{he}往後退了三大步。{name}沒有碰電線，也沒有去拿嘟嘟號。{name}跑進廚房喊：「爸爸！電視後面的電線冒火花了！」爸爸放下鍋鏟，快步走到客廳。
爸爸用手電筒照一照，點點頭。他先把延長線的插頭從牆上拔掉。爸爸說：「這條電線太舊了。你沒有碰它，還馬上來找我，做得真好！」爸爸伸長手臂，拿出嘟嘟號。{name}抱著小火車，開心地笑了。
下午，{name}牽著爸爸的手，一起去五金行。架子上有好多新的延長線。{name}幫忙挑了一條白色的。爸爸還拿了一包透明的小東西。{name}問：「這是什麼呀？」爸爸眨眨眼說：「回家你就知道了。」
回到家，{name}先去洗手。爸爸說：「手濕濕的不能碰電線，要擦乾喔。」{name}用毛巾把手擦得乾乾的。爸爸把{his}果汁杯拿到餐桌上，離插座遠遠的。爸爸接好新電線，{name}幫忙遞束帶。爸爸把電線綁得整整齊齊，藏在櫃子後面。
牆上還有幾個空空的插座。爸爸說：「插座是給大人用的。手指和玩具都不能放進去。」{name}把透明蓋子一個一個遞給爸爸。喀、喀、喀！每個插座都戴上了小帽子。{name}把嘟嘟號放回軌道上。嘟嘟號又出發了，這次安安全全。冒險成功囉！
en: On Saturday morning, {name} played with a little train. Its name was Toot-Toot. {name} gave it a gentle push. Whoosh! Toot-Toot rolled across the rug. It slid behind the TV stand and was gone. "I'll rescue you, Toot-Toot!" said {name}. The adventure began!

{name} grabbed a small flashlight and lay on the floor. It was dark and dusty behind the TV. Black wires curled around like sleepy snakes. Look, there was Toot-Toot! It sat right beside an old extension cord, waiting to be rescued.

{name} slowly reached in for the train. Then came a tiny sound. Snap! A little spark flashed from the cord. {name} looked again with wide eyes. The old cord had a crack. Its outside cover was split open.

{name} pulled back fast and took three big steps away. {name} did not touch the cord or the train. Instead, {he} ran to the kitchen. "Dad! The cord behind the TV made a spark!" Dad put down the spoon and hurried over.

Dad shone the flashlight and nodded. First, Dad pulled the plug out of the wall. "That cord is too old," Dad said. "You stayed away and came to get me. Well done!" Dad reached in and pulled out Toot-Toot. {name} hugged the train and smiled.

In the afternoon, {name} held Dad's hand and walked to the hardware store. The shelves had lots of new cords. {name} helped pick a white one. Dad also took a pack of small clear things. "What are those?" asked {name}. Dad winked. "You'll see at home."

Back home, {name} washed up first. "Dry your hands well," said Dad. "Wet hands and cords don't mix." {name} rubbed {his} hands dry with a towel. Dad moved {his} juice cup far from the socket. Dad set up the new cord, and {name} handed over the ties. Dad bundled the wires neatly and tucked them away.

A few empty sockets were still on the wall. "Sockets are just for grown-ups," Dad said. "No fingers or toys go inside." {name} passed the clear covers to Dad, one by one. Click, click, click! Now every socket wore a tiny hat. {name} set Toot-Toot back on the track. Off it went, safe and sound. Adventure complete!

questions: {name}看到電線冒火花時，做了哪些事？
如果你的手濕濕的，看到插頭或電線，你會怎麼做？
家裡的插座是給誰用的？我們可以一起找找家裡的插座在哪裡嗎？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起在家「巡邏」，找出所有插座和電線，練習說「插座不要碰，壞了找大人」。也可以讓孩子幫忙把插座蓋遞給你裝上。

questions: What did {name} do when the cord made a spark?
If your hands were wet and you saw a plug or cord, what would you do?
Who are the sockets in our home for? Can we look for them together?
en.tip: This week, go on a home "safety patrol" together to find every socket and cord, and practice saying, "Sockets are for grown-ups; if it looks broken, tell a grown-up." Let your child hand you plug covers while you fit them.

zh: 早上，太陽暖暖的。奶奶抱著洗衣籃。{name}跟在後面，咚咚咚。「我們去陽台晾襪子囉！」籃子裡好多襪子。紅襪子，藍襪子，還有小花襪子。
奶奶拿夾子，夾一夾。{name}遞襪子，一隻又一隻。夾、夾、夾！咦？一隻長長的條紋襪。好像毛毛蟲喔！{name}笑了，奶奶也笑了。襪子在風裡搖搖搖。
{name}抬頭看。天空藍藍的。白白的雲，飄呀飄。「奶奶，雲好漂亮！」欄杆旁有一張小椅子。{name}指著椅子說：「我要站上去看！」
奶奶輕輕牽住{his}小手。「椅子不放欄杆旁喔。」「陽台是看花、看天空的。」奶奶搬起小椅子。一步，兩步，搬進屋裡。小椅子回家囉！
奶奶站在落地窗邊。「來，腳踩在地板上。」「奶奶陪你一起看。」{name}站好了，腳丫貼著地板。抬頭一看，哇！一朵雲像小兔子。長長的耳朵，跳呀跳。
「換{name}找！」{name}看呀看。那朵雲彎彎的。「是小船！」小船飄呀飄，划過藍藍的天。奶奶說：「小兔子坐船嗎？」{name}咯咯笑。
又一朵雲飄過來。捲捲的，一條一條。「是一碗麵！」{name}大叫。咕嚕咕嚕，肚子也叫了。奶奶摸摸肚子：「我的也咕嚕咕嚕。」兩個人笑成一團。
奶奶和{name}給小花澆水。嘩啦啦，小花喝飽了。襪子在風中揮揮手。「中午吃麵好不好？」「好！」{name}牽著奶奶，回屋裡囉。
en: The morning sun is warm. Grandma carries the laundry basket. {name} follows, thump, thump, thump. "Let's hang socks on the balcony!" Red socks, blue socks, little flower socks.
Grandma holds the clips. {name} hands her socks, one by one. Clip, clip, clip! Oh! A long striped sock. It looks like a caterpillar! Everyone giggles. The socks wiggle in the wind.
{name} looks up. The sky is so blue. Fluffy white clouds drift by. "Grandma, look at the clouds!" A small stool sits by the railing. "I want to stand on it!"
Grandma gently holds {his} hand. "Stools don't stay by the railing." "Balconies are for flowers and sky." Grandma lifts the stool. One step, two steps, inside it goes. Bye-bye, stool!
Grandma stands by the big glass door. "Feet on the floor, like me." "I'll look with you." {name} stands nice and tall. Wow! A cloud looks like a bunny. Long ears, hop, hop!
"Your turn to find one!" {name} looks and looks. One cloud is curvy. "A boat!" The boat sails across the sky. "Is the bunny riding in it?" asks Grandma. {name} giggles.
Another cloud floats over. It is curly and wiggly. "A bowl of noodles!" {name} shouts. Rumble, rumble, goes a tummy. Grandma pats her tummy. "Mine says rumble too!" They laugh and laugh.
Grandma and {name} water the flowers. Splash, splash! The flowers drink it all up. The socks wave in the breeze. "Noodles for lunch?" "Yes!" Hand in hand, they go inside.

questions: {name}想站上小椅子時，奶奶做了什麼？
看窗外的時候，我們的腳要放在哪裡？誰會陪在旁邊？
在陽台上，你最喜歡看什麼？
zh.tip: 這週找一天和孩子站在窗邊玩「找雲朵」遊戲，先一起說「腳踩地板，大人陪著」再開始看。也可以檢查一下，把椅子和箱子移離窗戶與欄杆。

questions: What did Grandma do when {name} wanted to stand on the stool?
When we look out the window, where do our feet go, and who stays beside us?
What do you like to look at from a balcony?
en.tip: This week, play a cloud-finding game at the window together, starting with the phrase "Feet on the floor, grown-up by my side." Also take a moment to move chairs and boxes away from windows and railings.

zh: 除夕夜，天慢慢黑了。城市的燈一盞一盞亮起來。{name}和爸爸住在高高的公寓裡。窗外有一座好高的塔，塔尖閃著金色的光。爸爸說：「今晚十二點，塔上會放煙火喔！」{name}開心得拍拍手。
「我要找最好的位置！」{name}說。看煙火的大冒險開始了！{name}先跑到陽台門邊。陽台上有小番茄和香草，在風裡輕輕搖。爸爸打開門，牽著{name}走出去。「陽台是看風景和種花的地方。」爸爸說。{name}幫小番茄澆了一點水。
欄杆旁邊的風冷冷的。{name}站在花盆旁邊，雙腳穩穩踩著地板。遠遠的高塔亮晶晶，可是被另一棟大樓擋住了一半。「我們回屋裡找找看。」爸爸說。爸爸和{name}關好陽台門，回到暖暖的客廳。
客廳的大窗戶正對著高塔。{name}看看窗台，又看看旁邊的小椅子。「我可以爬上去嗎？把椅子推過去就好！」爸爸笑著搖搖頭。「窗台不是用來爬的，椅子也要離窗戶遠遠的。我有更好的辦法。」
「什麼辦法？」{name}眨眨眼。「我們來找軟軟的寶藏！」爸爸說。{name}跑到沙發旁，抱來兩個大抱枕。爸爸從臥室拿來一個圓圓的坐墊。{name}又找到一條毛毯，像小斗篷一樣拖在後面。
兩個人把抱枕排在窗戶前面，再鋪上毛毯。哇，變成一個軟軟的小窩了！{name}和爸爸並肩跪下來，膝蓋和腳都貼著地板。高塔就在眼前。「哇，比爬上去還清楚！」{name}說。
樓下街上傳來好多人的笑聲。電視裡開始倒數了。「十、九、八……」{name}和爸爸一起大聲數。「三、二、一！」咻——砰！第一朵煙火在塔上開花了。紅的、綠的、金色的光，把天空塗得滿滿的。
煙火像一場閃亮的雨。{name}靠在爸爸身邊，一朵一朵數著。「爸爸，明年我們還要這樣看。」爸爸抱抱{name}。「好啊，還是在這個軟軟的小窩。」{name}打了個小呵欠，小聲說：「新年快樂！」
en: It was New Year's Eve, and the sky grew dark. City lights blinked on, one by one. {name} and Dad lived high up in a tall building. Outside stood a tall tower with a golden tip. "At midnight, fireworks will pop over the tower!" said Dad. {name} clapped.

"I'll find the best spot!" said {name}. The fireworks adventure began! First, {name} ran to the balcony door. Little tomato plants and herbs swayed outside. Dad opened the door and held hands with {name}. "Our balcony is for looking and for plants," said Dad. {name} gave the tomatoes a little water.

The air by the railing felt chilly. {name} stood by the flowerpots, feet steady on the floor. The tower sparkled far away. But another building hid half of it. "Let's look inside," said Dad. They shut the balcony door and went back to the cozy living room.

The big living room window faced the tower. {name} looked at the windowsill, then at a small chair. "Can I climb up? I'll push the chair over!" Dad smiled and shook his head. "Windowsills aren't for climbing. Chairs stay away from windows too. I have a better idea."

"What idea?" asked {name}. "Let's hunt for soft treasure!" said Dad. {name} raced to the sofa and hugged two big cushions. Dad brought a round pillow from the bedroom. Then {name} found a fluffy blanket and dragged it along like a cape.

They lined the cushions up by the window and spread the blanket on top. Now it was a soft little nest! {name} and Dad knelt side by side, knees and feet on the floor. The tower was right there. "Wow! This is even better than climbing!" said {name}.

Happy voices floated up from the street below. On TV, the countdown began. "Ten, nine, eight..." {name} and Dad counted out loud. "Three, two, one!" Whoosh, boom! The first firework bloomed above the tower. Red, green, and gold filled the sky.

The fireworks fell like sparkly rain. {name} leaned close to Dad and counted each one. "Dad, let's watch like this next year too." Dad gave {name} a big hug. "Yes, from our soft little nest." {name} gave a tiny yawn and whispered, "Happy New Year!"

questions: {name}想爬上窗台時，爸爸想到了什麼更好的辦法？
在陽台上，{name}做了哪些事？我們家的陽台可以用來做什麼？
如果你想從窗戶看外面，你會怎麼做？要找誰陪你？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起在窗邊用抱枕做一個「看風景小窩」，練習說：「腳踩地板，大人在旁邊。」也檢查一下，把椅子和箱子從窗戶與陽台欄杆旁移開。

questions: When {name} wanted to climb onto the windowsill, what better idea did Dad have?
What did {name} do on the balcony? What is our balcony for?
If you want to look out a window, how will you do it, and who will be with you?
en.tip: Tonight, build a cushion "looking nest" by a window together and practice saying, "Feet on the floor, grown-up beside me." Also move any chairs or boxes away from windows and balcony railings.

zh: 星期六早上，森林裡的小溪閃閃發亮。{name}和好朋友露露跟著溯溪教練阿山叔叔，還有露露的媽媽，一起出發。大家先戴好安全帽，再穿上橘色救生衣。阿山叔叔一個一個拉拉扣帶，笑著說：「扣緊了，我們才出發！」
溪水清清涼涼，只淹到{name}的膝蓋。阿山叔叔走在最前面，用一根長竹竿點點水底，說：「我們只走腳踩得到底的地方。」{name}跟著他的腳步，一步一步踩在平平的石頭上。露露的媽媽走在最後面，眼睛一直看著大家。
越往上游走，驚喜就越多。石頭縫裡躲著一隻小螃蟹，舉著兩隻鉗子揮呀揮。水裡有一群小魚，像銀色的箭一樣咻地游過去。遠遠的，一道小瀑布嘩啦啦地唱著歌，涼涼的水霧輕輕飄到{name}的手臂上。
走到一片淺灘，阿山叔叔拿出一個橘色的拋繩袋。「如果有人在水裡滑倒，不要跳下去，要大聲喊大人，再丟會浮的東西過去。」他讓大家輪流練習，把拋繩袋丟向一塊大石頭。{name}用力一丟，啪！正好落在石頭旁邊。
中午，大家坐在溪邊的大石頭上吃飯糰。露露把腳伸進水裡踢呀踢，沒想到涼鞋的帶子鬆開了。撲通一聲，一隻粉紅色的涼鞋掉進溪裡，順著水流慢慢漂走，一路漂向前面那個又深又綠的水潭。
「我的鞋子！」露露站起來想去追。{name}也好想衝過去，可是{he}看見水潭綠得像一大塊玉石，根本看不到底。{name}趕快拉住露露的手，深深吸一口氣，大聲喊：「阿山叔叔！露露的鞋子漂走了！」
阿山叔叔馬上跑過來，舉起那根長竹竿。他站在淺淺的岸邊，把竹竿伸向水潭，輕輕一勾，涼鞋就掛在竹竿尖上了。「謝謝你們沒有自己跑過去，還喊得這麼大聲！」他把涼鞋交給露露，對{name}比了一個大拇指。
露露把鞋帶綁得緊緊的，和{name}手牽手，跟著阿山叔叔往回走。陽光從樹葉間灑下來，小溪嘩啦嘩啦地流著。回到森林入口時，{name}和露露約好：下次溯溪，還要一起戴好安全帽、穿上救生衣，去找更多小螃蟹。
en: On Saturday morning, the forest stream sparkled in the sun. {name} and best friend Lulu set off with Uncle Shan, their river guide, and Lulu's mom. First, everyone put on helmets and bright orange life jackets. Uncle Shan tugged each strap and smiled. "Snug and tight? Then let's go!"

The cool, clear water came up only to {name}'s knees. Uncle Shan led the way, tapping the stream bed with a long bamboo pole. "We only walk where our feet can touch the bottom," he said. {name} followed his steps from flat stone to flat stone, while Lulu's mom walked at the back, watching everyone.

The farther upstream they went, the more surprises they found. A tiny crab hid between the rocks, waving both claws. A school of little fish zipped past like silver arrows. Up ahead, a small waterfall splashed and sang, and its cool mist drifted onto {name}'s arms.

At a shallow spot, Uncle Shan pulled out an orange throw bag with a rope inside. "If someone slips in the water, don't jump in. Shout for a grown-up and throw something that floats." Everyone took turns tossing the bag toward a big rock. {name} threw hard. Plop! It landed right beside it.

At lunchtime, they sat on wide rocks and ate rice balls. Lulu swung her feet in the water, but her sandal strap came loose. Plunk! One pink sandal dropped into the stream and bobbed away, drifting slowly toward a deep green pool ahead.

"My sandal!" Lulu cried, jumping up to chase it. {name} wanted to run after it too, but the pool was as green as a giant jewel, and no one could see the bottom. {name} grabbed Lulu's hand, took a big breath, and shouted, "Uncle Shan! Lulu's sandal is floating away!"

Uncle Shan hurried over with his long bamboo pole. Standing safely on the shallow edge, he stretched the pole out over the pool and gave a gentle flick. The sandal hung from the tip! "Thank you for not running after it, and for shouting so loudly!" He handed it to Lulu and gave {name} a big thumbs-up.

Lulu tied her strap extra tight, and she and {name} walked back hand in hand behind Uncle Shan. Sunlight sprinkled through the leaves as the stream bubbled along. At the forest gate, the two friends made a plan: next time, helmets and life jackets on, they would find even more crabs.

questions: 露露的涼鞋漂向深水潭時，{name}做了什麼？為什麼不自己去追？
溯溪時，大家穿了什麼、走在什麼樣的地方，讓玩水更安全？
如果你看到朋友在水裡需要幫忙，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這個星期玩一個「喊大人」小遊戲：假裝朋友在水裡需要幫忙，讓孩子練習大聲喊「大人快來！」，再把枕頭或球當成會浮的東西丟過去。

questions: What did {name} do when Lulu's sandal floated toward the deep pool? Why not chase it?
On the river trip, what did everyone wear, and where did they walk, to stay safe in the water?
What would you do if you saw a friend who needed help in the water?
en.tip: This week, play a quick "Call a Grown-up" game: pretend a friend needs help in the water, let your child practice shouting "Grown-up, come quick!" and then toss a pillow or ball as the floating helper.

zh: 下了一整夜的大雨，早上終於放晴了。{name}跟著舅舅來到稻田旁的小公園，好朋友阿凱和小芸已經在溜滑梯旁等著。公園邊有一條小溝渠，平常水淺淺的，今天卻嘩啦嘩啦地響，好像在唱一首很急的歌。
三個人跑到溝渠旁的草地，看見混濁的黃色水流得好快，還有銀色的小魚一閃一閃地跳起來。阿凱舉起手上的綠色小網子，開心地說：「我們來抓魚！」小芸也彎下腰，準備把褲管捲起來。
{name}盯著水面看，一片落葉剛掉進去，一下子就被沖得不見了。{name}往後退了一步，說：「水太急了，旁邊又沒有大人，我們不可以下去。」阿凱皺皺眉頭：「我只站在邊邊就好啊。」
「邊邊的土也是濕滑的。」{name}想了想，「你們站在草地上等我，我去找舅舅來，好不好？」小芸點點頭，拉著阿凱退到大樹下。{name}沿著步道一路跑向涼亭，舅舅正坐在那裡看報紙。
舅舅聽完，馬上跟著{name}走回來。他撿起一根長樹枝，伸進水裡量一量，樹枝一大半都沒進水裡。「看，這麼深，你們的腳根本踩不到底。」舅舅說，「不管是游泳池、海邊還是河邊，都要有大人在旁邊看著，也要待在腳踩得到的地方喔。」
「那我們還能看魚嗎？」阿凱問。舅舅笑著帶大家走上有欄杆的小木橋。從橋上往下看，小魚們正努力逆著水游，尾巴擺得好快。阿凱數著：「一條、兩條、三條……哇，那條最大！」小芸說牠們好像在比賽。
橋的另一邊是公園的小池塘，有人正在划小船，每個人都穿著橘色的救生衣。小芸說：「我上次去湖邊坐船，也穿了一件，鼓鼓的好像抱著枕頭。」舅舅點頭：「坐船或是在大水裡，一定要穿上它。」
舅舅指著橋柱上掛著的橘色救生圈問：「如果朋友掉進水裡，怎麼辦？」阿凱說：「跳下去救他！」舅舅搖搖頭：「要大聲喊大人，再丟會浮的東西給他。」大家在草地上玩練習遊戲，小芸假裝在水裡揮手，{name}大喊：「快來幫忙！」，把阿凱的皮球丟過去。
太陽慢慢往西邊走，稻田被染成金黃色，該回家了。阿凱說：「等水變乾淨，舅舅帶我們去游泳池好嗎？」舅舅答應了。{name}最後再看一眼橋下閃亮的小魚，揮揮手說：「小魚，下次見！」
en: It had rained all night, but by morning the sun came out. {name} walked with Uncle Wei to the little park beside the rice fields, where friends Kai and Yun were waiting by the slide. Along the park's edge ran a small ditch. Usually it was shallow and quiet, but today it roared and splashed.

The three friends ran to the grass beside the ditch. The muddy water rushed past, and little silver fish flashed and jumped. Kai lifted his green net. "Let's catch some fish!" he cried. Yun bent down to roll up her pants.

{name} watched a leaf drop onto the water. In a blink, it was swept away. {name} stepped back. "The water's too fast, and there's no grown-up here. We can't go in." Kai frowned. "I'll just stand at the edge."

"The edge is muddy and slippery," {name} said. "Wait on the grass, and I'll go get Uncle Wei, okay?" Yun nodded and pulled Kai back under a big tree. {name} raced down the path to the gazebo, where Uncle Wei sat reading the newspaper.

Uncle Wei came right away. He picked up a long stick and dipped it in. Most of the stick disappeared under the water. "See how deep it is? Your feet couldn't touch the bottom," he said. "At the pool, the beach, or the river, a grown-up should always be watching. And stay where your feet can touch."

"Can we still see the fish?" Kai asked. Uncle Wei smiled and led them onto a little wooden bridge with railings. Below, the fish swam hard against the current, tails wiggling fast. Kai counted, "One, two, three... Wow, look at that big one!" Yun said they looked like they were racing.

On the other side of the bridge was the park pond. People were rowing small boats, and everyone wore an orange life jacket. "I wore one on a boat at the lake," Yun said. "It was puffy, like hugging a pillow." Uncle Wei nodded. "On a boat or in big water, always wear one."

Uncle Wei pointed to an orange ring hanging on the bridge post. "What if a friend fell in the water?" "Jump in and save him!" said Kai. Uncle Wei shook his head. "Shout for a grown-up, then throw something that floats." On the grass they practiced. Yun pretended to wave for help, and {name} yelled, "Help, come quick!" and tossed Kai's ball to her.

The sun sank low, turning the rice fields gold. It was time to go home. "When the water's calm, can you take us to the pool?" Kai asked. Uncle Wei said yes. {name} took one last look at the shiny fish under the bridge and waved. "See you next time, little fish!"

questions: 看到溝渠的水流得很急時，{name}做了什麼？為什麼？
如果你的朋友掉進水裡，你會怎麼做？
你去游泳池或海邊的時候，誰會在旁邊看著你？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子玩「喊大人、丟浮板」的練習遊戲：用枕頭或球當作會浮的東西，練習大聲喊「快來幫忙！」再丟過去。

questions: What did {name} do when the ditch water was rushing fast? Why?
What would you do if a friend fell into the water?
When you go to the pool or the beach, who watches you?
en.tip: This week, play a "shout and throw" game: use a pillow or ball as the floating object, practice yelling "Help, come quick!" and then toss it.

zh: 清晨的澎湖港口，海風鹹鹹的，白色小船噗噗噗地準備出發，要載大家去一座小島浮潛。船長海叔發給每人一件橘色救生衣。{name}把三個扣環一一扣上，「喀、喀、喀」，再拉緊帶子。表哥阿哲卻把救生衣隨便披在肩上，皺著眉說：「穿這個好像一根大紅蘿蔔，超遜的！」
小船一離開港口就乘風破浪，浪花潑上船舷，濺得大家哇哇叫。忽然，一群飛魚從海面竄起，像銀色的紙飛機掠過浪頭。阿哲興奮得探出身子，海叔立刻走過來，輕輕扯了扯他敞開的救生衣：「沒扣好，它只是一件會被風吹走的背心喔。」阿哲吐吐舌頭，乖乖扣上。{name}偷偷笑了，現在船上有兩根紅蘿蔔了。
船停在小島旁一片清澈見底的淺灣，水面上浮著一圈黃色浮球。海叔指著浮球說：「只能在圈圈裡玩，那裡腳踩得到沙。兩人一組，一定要待在我看得到的地方。」他還在每組旁邊放一塊浮板。{name}和阿哲同一組。阿哲拍拍胸脯：「我游泳超強，你跟著我就好！」{name}點點頭，戴好面鏡，慢慢走下船梯。
海水涼涼的，{name}的腳穩穩踩在細沙上，水只到腰。低頭一看，海底簡直是另一個世界：條紋小魚成群結隊地穿梭，一隻海參懶洋洋地躺著，珊瑚旁還有藍色的魚一閃而過。{name}數著魚，正看得目不轉睛，旁邊卻傳來一陣慌亂的拍水聲。
阿哲的面鏡起霧了，他手忙腳亂地亂踢亂划，嗆了一口水，越緊張越站不穩。{name}心裡一驚，卻沒有撲過去，而是大聲喊：「海叔！海叔！」接著把浮板用力推向阿哲：「抓住它！」阿哲一把抱住浮板，雙腳往下一踩——咚，踩到沙了，水才到他的胸口。海叔已經游到旁邊，豎起大拇指：「{name}，又快又冷靜，做得好！」
阿哲紅著臉小聲說：「其實……我只在游泳池用過游泳圈，不太會浮。」原來「游泳超強」是吹牛的！{name}沒有笑他，而是在海叔的注視下示範：「肚子朝上，耳朵泡進水裡，手腳張開像海星，救生衣會撐住你。」阿哲試到第三次，終於輕飄飄地浮起來，望著藍天大叫：「哇，我變成一朵雲了！」
傍晚，小船載著曬得紅通通的大家返航。這次阿哲第一個把救生衣扣好，還得意地拍拍胸前：「這叫英雄紅蘿蔔。」夕陽把海面染成一片金黃，阿哲靠過來問：「明年夏天，你可以再教我浮嗎？」{name}笑著說：「好啊，不過要先找海叔一起來看著我們。」
en: Early morning at the Penghu harbor, the salty wind smelled like adventure. A little white boat putt-putted, ready to carry everyone to a tiny island for snorkeling. Captain Uncle Hai handed out bright orange life jackets. {name} snapped all three buckles, click, click, click, and pulled the straps snug. Cousin Azhe just draped his over his shoulders. "This makes me look like a giant carrot," he groaned. "So uncool!"

Once the boat left the harbor, it bounced over the waves, and spray splashed everyone. Suddenly a flock of flying fish burst from the water and skimmed the waves like silver paper planes. Azhe leaned out to look. Uncle Hai came over and gave his open jacket a gentle tug. "Unbuckled, it's just a vest the wind can steal." Azhe stuck out his tongue and clicked it shut. {name} hid a grin. Now there were two carrots on board.

The boat stopped in a clear, shallow cove beside the island. A ring of yellow floats bobbed on the water. "Stay inside the ring, where your feet can touch the sand," Uncle Hai said. "Two by two, and always where I can see you." He set a kickboard beside each pair. {name} and Azhe were buddies. Azhe thumped his chest. "I'm an amazing swimmer. Just follow me!" {name} nodded, pulled on a mask, and climbed carefully down the ladder.

The water was cool, and {name}'s feet settled firmly on soft sand, with the sea only waist-deep. Below the surface was a whole other world. Striped fish zipped past in glittering schools, a sea cucumber lounged lazily on the bottom, and something blue flashed beside the coral. {name} was counting fish, completely spellbound, when frantic splashing erupted nearby.

Azhe's mask had fogged up. He was kicking and flailing, coughing on a gulp of seawater, too flustered to find his footing. {name}'s heart jumped, but instead of lunging toward him, {name} shouted, "Uncle Hai! Uncle Hai!" and shoved the kickboard across the water. "Grab it!" Azhe hugged the board and pushed his feet down. Thump. Sand. The water only reached his chest. Uncle Hai was already swimming over. "Quick and calm, {name}. Well done!"

Azhe's cheeks turned pink. "Actually, I've only ever swum in a pool with a float ring. I can't really float." So the amazing swimmer had been bragging! {name} didn't laugh. With Uncle Hai watching, {name} showed Azhe how. "Tummy up, ears in the water, arms and legs out like a starfish. Your jacket will hold you." On his third try, Azhe drifted up, light as a feather. "Whoa," he cried, staring at the sky. "I'm a cloud!"

That evening, the boat carried everyone home, sunburned and happy. This time Azhe was the first to buckle up. He patted his chest proudly. "This is a hero carrot." The setting sun turned the sea to gold. Azhe leaned over. "Will you teach me to float again next summer?" {name} smiled. "Sure. But first we'll ask Uncle Hai to come and watch us."

questions: 阿哲在水裡慌張的時候，{name}做了哪兩件事？為什麼沒有直接撲過去？
海叔說只能在黃色浮球圈裡玩，你覺得為什麼要待在腳踩得到、大人看得到的地方？
下次去海邊、河邊或游泳池，你會先找誰一起來看著你？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子玩「喊人加丟浮板」的小練習：一人假裝需要幫忙，另一人大聲喊「大人快來！」再把枕頭丟過去，練到孩子不用想就會做。

questions: When Azhe was panicking in the water, what two things did {name} do? Why didn't {he} jump toward Azhe?
Uncle Hai said to stay inside the yellow floats. Why do you think it matters to stay where your feet touch and a grown-up can see you?
Next time you go to the beach, a river, or a pool, who will you ask to come and watch you?
en.tip: This week, play a quick "shout and throw" game: one person pretends to need help, and the other calls out "Grown-up, come quick!" and tosses a pillow. Practice until your child does it without thinking.

zh: 早上，陽光暖暖的。{name}抱著小恐龍咚咚。咚咚是綠色的恐龍。「咚咚，我們去探險！」咚咚說：「吼——吼！」走呀走，走進廚房。
廚房好大好大。這裡有鍋子，那裡有碗。抬頭看一看，流理臺上亮晶晶。咦？那是什麼？一個小小的瓶子。瓶子裡，有好多小熊。
紅色小熊，黃色小熊，橘色小熊。一隻一隻，圓滾滾。好像軟糖喔！咚咚說：「吼吼，好可愛！」{name}看呀看，眼睛眨呀眨。
{name}想一想。看起來像糖果，可是不一定是糖果。媽媽說過，瓶子裡可能是藥。藥要大人給，才可以吃。{name}小手放背後。不摸，不打開，不嚐一口。
「咚咚，我們去找媽媽！」{name}站得直直的。咚咚咚，穿過餐桌。咚咚咚，繞過椅子。小恐龍也說：「吼吼，出發！」探險隊，前進！
媽媽在客廳摺衣服。「媽媽，媽媽，快來看！」{name}拉著媽媽的手。咚咚咚，回到廚房。{name}指著瓶子說：「有小熊，我沒有吃。」
媽媽看一看，笑了。「這是維他命，不是糖果。」「媽媽給你，才可以吃。」「你沒有嚐，還來找我，好棒！」媽媽踮起腳尖。瓶子放進高高的櫃子。
「探險隊辛苦了！」媽媽拿出香蕉和小餅乾。{name}咬一口，甜甜的。咚咚也假裝咬一口：「吼吼，好吃！」{name}抱著咚咚，笑咪咪。今天的探險，好開心！
en: The morning sun is warm. {name} hugs Dongdong, a green toy dinosaur. "Dongdong, let's go explore!" "Roar!" says Dongdong. Stomp, stomp, into the kitchen!
The kitchen is big, so big. Pots here, bowls there. {name} looks up high. Something shiny sits on the counter. What is it? A little bottle! Inside are lots of tiny bears.
Red bears, yellow bears, orange bears. Round and squishy, one by one. They look like gummy candy! "Roar, so cute!" says Dongdong. {name} looks and looks. Blink, blink.
{name} thinks hard. They look like candy. But maybe they are not. Mom said bottles can hold medicine. Only grown-ups give medicine. Hands go behind {his} back. No touching. No opening. No tasting.
"Dongdong, let's go get Mom!" {name} stands up tall. Stomp, stomp, past the table. Stomp, stomp, around the chair. "Roar, let's go!" says Dongdong. March on, explorers!
Mom is folding laundry in the living room. "Mom, Mom, come and see!" {name} holds Mom's hand. Stomp, stomp, back to the kitchen. {name} points. "Bears! I didn't eat any."

Mom looks and smiles. "These are vitamins, not candy. You eat them only when I give them. You didn't taste. You came to get me. Great job!" Mom stands on tiptoe. Up goes the bottle, high in the cupboard.
"Good work, explorers!" Mom brings a banana and little crackers. {name} takes a bite. Yum, so sweet! Dongdong pretends to munch. "Roar, yummy!" {name} hugs Dongdong tight. What a happy adventure!

questions: {name}看到瓶子裡的小熊，做了什麼？
藥和維他命，要誰給你，才可以吃？
如果你在家裡看到小瓶子或藥丸，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週玩一個「找大人」小遊戲：放一個空的藥瓶在桌上，讓孩子練習不摸不嚐，跑來說「媽媽(爸爸)快來看！」，做到就給一個大大的擁抱。

questions: What did {name} do when {he} saw the bears in the bottle?
Who gives you medicine or vitamins before you can eat them?
What would you do if you found a little bottle or pills at home?
en.tip: This week, play a "get a grown-up" game: set an empty pill bottle on the table and let your child practice not touching or tasting it, then running to say "Come and see!" Give a big hug each time.

title.en: {name} and the Rainbow Box at Grandma's

zh: 星期六，{name}來到奶奶家。奶奶住在七樓，窗外有好多屋頂。奶奶笑著說：「我的老花眼鏡不見了。你願意當小探險家，幫我找一找嗎？」{name}拿起小手電筒，用力點點頭。「探險開始囉！」
{name}先到客廳探險。沙發底下有一顆毛線球，是奶奶織圍巾用的。書櫃旁邊有一本舊相簿。可是，眼鏡在哪裡呢？窗台上的小花貓咪咪喵喵叫，好像在說：「再找找看！」
接著，{name}走進廚房。矮矮的桌子上，有一個長長的盒子。盒子分成七個小格子。紅、橙、黃、綠、藍、紫，還有粉紅色。每一格都裝著圓圓的小顆粒。陽光一照，亮晶晶的，好像彩虹糖果！
{name}的眼睛睜得好大。「哇，好漂亮！」可是，{he}想起媽媽說過的話。藥和維他命，有時候長得很像糖果。可是，它們不是糖果。只有大人拿給你，才可以吃。{name}把小手放到背後，一點也沒有碰。
「奶奶，快來看！」{name}跑回客廳，拉著奶奶的手。奶奶跟著走進廚房。{name}指著盒子說：「這是糖果嗎？我沒有吃喔。」奶奶蹲下來，給{him}一個大大的擁抱。「這是奶奶的藥盒。你找大人來看，做得真好！」
奶奶說：「每天吃一格，奶奶的身體才會好好的。」她想了想又說：「明天小表妹樂樂要來玩。樂樂才一歲，什麼都想放進嘴巴。」{name}拍拍手說：「那我們幫藥盒找個新家吧！」奶奶笑了：「好主意，小探險家！」
新的探險開始了！他們先看看茶几。「太矮了，樂樂爬得到。」再看看書櫃。「咪咪會跳上去。」最後，他們找到冰箱旁邊的高櫃子。奶奶踮起腳，把藥盒放進去，再把櫃門關好。「這裡最安全！」
{name}抬頭一看，用手電筒照一照。「奶奶，冰箱上面有東西在發亮！」原來，正是奶奶的眼鏡！奶奶戴上眼鏡，哈哈大笑。她端出一盤切好的蘋果。「這才是小探險家的點心！」{name}咬一口，甜甜的，今天的探險真棒。
en: On Saturday, {name} went to Grandma's apartment. It was way up on the seventh floor. Grandma smiled. "I lost my reading glasses. Will you be my little explorer and help me look?" {name} grabbed a small flashlight. "Let the adventure begin!"

First, {name} explored the living room. Under the sofa was a ball of yarn for Grandma's knitting. By the bookshelf sat an old photo album. But where were the glasses? Mimi the cat sat on the windowsill. "Meow," she said. Keep looking!

Next, {name} tiptoed into the kitchen. On a low table sat a long box. It had seven little boxes inside. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, and pink! Each one held tiny round things. In the sunlight, they sparkled like rainbow candy.

{name}'s eyes grew wide. "Wow, so pretty!" Then {he} remembered something Mom said. Medicine and vitamins can look like candy. But they are not candy. You only take them when a grown-up gives them to you. So {name} kept both hands behind {his} back.

"Grandma, come and see!" {name} ran back and took Grandma's hand. Together they walked into the kitchen. {name} pointed. "Is this candy? I didn't eat any." Grandma knelt down for a big hug. "That's my pillbox. You did just right to get me!"

"I take one box each day," said Grandma. "It helps me stay well." Then she thought for a moment. "Baby Lulu is visiting tomorrow. She's only one. She puts everything in her mouth!" {name} clapped. "Let's find the pillbox a new home!"

A new adventure began! First they checked the coffee table. "Too low. Lulu can crawl there." Then they checked the bookshelf. "Mimi can jump up there." At last they found a tall cupboard by the fridge. Grandma reached up, tucked the pillbox inside, and shut the door.

{name} looked up and shined the flashlight. "Grandma, something's shiny on top of the fridge!" It was Grandma's glasses! Grandma put them on and laughed. Then she brought out a plate of apple slices. "Here's a real treat for my explorer!" {name} took a sweet, crunchy bite.

questions: {name}看到彩虹盒子時，做了什麼？為什麼？
如果你在家裡或別人家發現藥丸或藥罐，你會怎麼做？
什麼時候才可以吃藥呢？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子一起在家裡「探險」，檢查藥品和維他命是否都放在高處或鎖好的櫃子裡。練習一句話：「看到藥，不要碰，快找大人來看！」

questions: What did {name} do when {he} saw the rainbow box? Why?
What would you do if you found pills or a medicine bottle at home or at a friend's house?
When is it okay to take medicine?
en.tip: This week, go on a little home "adventure" together to check that all medicines and vitamins are stored up high or locked away. Practice the phrase: "See medicine? Don't touch, get a grown-up!"

zh: 昨天，電視上說颱風要來了。媽媽說：「我們一起來準備吧！」{name}跑到陽台，幫忙把小盆栽搬進屋裡。爸爸收起曬衣架，{name}抱回小板凳和雨鞋。陽台空空的，什麼都不會被風吹走了。
接著，爸爸拿出兩支手電筒。{name}按一下，喀嚓，亮了！媽媽把大水瓶一瓶瓶裝滿水。{name}把餅乾、香蕉和小麵包，放進一個紙箱裡。{he}在箱子上畫了一朵雲，大聲說：「這是我們的颱風寶箱！」
今天早上，颱風真的來了。窗外的風呼——呼——地叫，雨點啪啦啪啦打在玻璃上。{name}想跑到窗邊，看看外面的大樹。爸爸牽起{his}小手說：「風很大，我們坐到客廳中間吧。」貓咪豆豆也跟過來，喵喵叫。
突然，燈全都熄了！家裡變得暗暗的。{name}的心咚咚跳，緊緊抱住豆豆。可是{name}想起昨天的寶箱。「我知道手電筒在哪裡！」{name}牽著媽媽的手，慢慢走到寶箱旁。喀嚓！一道亮亮的光照出來了。
「我們來當探險隊吧！」爸爸說。{name}拿著手電筒，照照沙發下面，照照書櫃上面。光圈在地上跳來跳去。咦，桌子底下有兩個發亮的小圓點！原來是豆豆躲在那裡。「喵——」豆豆眨眨眼，好像在說：找到我了！
爸爸把手電筒對著牆壁。媽媽把手指彎一彎，牆上出現一隻小鳥。爸爸豎起兩根手指，變成一隻兔子，跳呀跳。{name}也試試看，牆上出現一隻大狗。「汪汪！」{name}學狗叫，全家都笑了。
探險隊肚子餓了。{name}從寶箱拿出香蕉和餅乾，分給大家。媽媽倒了一杯水給{him}。「風這麼大，河邊和海邊一定很好看吧？」{name}問。爸爸說：「現在還不安全。等大人說安全了，我們再一起去。」{name}點點頭。
慢慢地，天黑了，風聲變小了。{name}靠在媽媽身邊，覺得一點也不怕。因為昨天，{he}幫忙準備了好多東西。{name}關掉手電筒，小聲說：「颱風，晚安。」豆豆蜷成一團，呼嚕呼嚕地睡著了。
en: Yesterday, the TV said a typhoon was coming. "Let's get ready together!" said Mom. {name} ran to the balcony and carried the flower pots inside. Dad took down the clothes rack. {name} brought in the stool and rain boots. Now nothing could blow away.

Next, Dad found two flashlights. {name} pushed the button. Click! It worked. Mom filled big bottles with water. {name} packed crackers, bananas, and buns into a box. Then {he} drew a cloud on top. "This is our typhoon treasure box!"

This morning, the typhoon came. The wind howled, whoo, whoo! Rain went pitter-pat on the glass. {name} wanted to see the trees from the window. Dad held {his} hand. "The wind is strong. Let's sit in the middle of the room." Doudou the cat followed. "Meow!"

Suddenly, all the lights went out! The house was dark. {name}'s heart went thump, thump. {name} hugged Doudou tight. Then {he} remembered the treasure box. "I know where the flashlights are!" Holding Mom's hand, {name} walked slowly to the box. Click! A bright beam shone out.

"Let's be explorers!" said Dad. {name} shone the flashlight under the sofa, then up at the bookshelf. The circle of light danced on the floor. Look! Two shiny dots under the table! It was Doudou, hiding. "Meow!" Doudou blinked. You found me!

Dad pointed a flashlight at the wall. Mom bent her fingers, and a bird appeared. Dad held up two fingers, and a bunny hopped across. {name} tried too. A big dog showed up on the wall! "Woof, woof!" barked {name}. Everyone laughed.

The explorers got hungry. {name} took bananas and crackers from the box for everyone. Mom poured {him} a cup of water. "The river and the sea must look exciting," said {name}. "It's not safe yet," said Dad. "When grown-ups say it's safe, we'll go together." {name} nodded.

Slowly, evening came, and the wind grew softer. {name} snuggled next to Mom and felt brave. Yesterday, {he} had helped get everything ready. {name} switched off the flashlight. "Goodnight, typhoon," {name} whispered. Doudou curled into a ball and purred, fast asleep.

questions: 颱風來之前，{name}幫家人準備了哪些東西？你會想幫忙準備什麼？
風很大的時候，爸爸為什麼請{name}坐到客廳中間？
如果你想去看河邊或海邊的大浪，要等誰說可以呢？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子一起做一個「颱風寶箱」，放進手電筒、水和小點心，並讓孩子試按手電筒，知道寶箱放在哪裡。

questions: What did {name} help the family get ready before the typhoon? What would you like to help with?
Why did Dad ask {name} to sit in the middle of the living room when the wind was strong?
If you wanted to see big waves at the river or the sea, who would you wait for to say it is safe?
en.tip: This week, make a "typhoon treasure box" together with a flashlight, water, and snacks, and let your child test the flashlight and learn where the box is kept.

zh: 颱風要來的那天下午，天空灰灰的，風把樹葉吹得沙沙響。隔壁的阿豪和小美跑來敲門，阿豪舉著手機，興奮地說：「{name}，我們去河邊拍大水好不好？一定很壯觀！」
{name}心裡癢癢的，好想看看河水變成什麼樣子。可是媽媽從廚房探出頭，溫柔地說：「颱風天的河邊不是看熱鬧的地方，等大人說安全了再出門喔。」這時阿豪的爸爸也走過來，笑著把兩個孩子帶回家準備防颱。
「那我們來進行一場防颱大任務吧！」爸爸拍拍手。第一關是陽台。{name}和爸爸一起把兩台腳踏車牽進屋裡，再把小盆栽一盆一盆搬進來。風吹得窗簾鼓起來，爸爸說：「搬完了，關好門，任務成功！」
第二關是找光。{name}打開抽屜，找出那支黃色的手電筒，按下開關。咦，光怎麼這麼暗？{name}換上新電池，再按一次，一道亮亮的光照在天花板上，像一顆小月亮。「手電筒，檢查完畢！」
第三關是準備水。媽媽把大水壺裝滿，{name}把幾個水瓶排得整整齊齊，貼上寫著「喝的水」的紙條。到了晚上，雨嘩啦啦地下，窗戶被風吹得喀啦喀啦響。爸爸說：「我們把基地搬到客廳中間，離窗戶遠一點。」
一家人用毯子和椅子搭了一座帳篷基地。突然，燈閃了一下，暗了下來。{name}馬上打開手電筒，暖暖的光照亮了大家的臉。媽媽笑著說：「還好我們有一位手電筒隊長。」大家在帳篷裡玩影子遊戲，用手變出小狗和小鳥。
第二天早上，風停了，太陽從雲後面探出頭來。收音機裡說颱風已經走遠，可以出門了。爸爸看看外面，點點頭說：「現在安全了。」{name}拿起小掃把，跟著爸媽走到巷子裡，地上鋪滿了樹葉和小樹枝。
阿豪和小美也拿著掃把出來了。鄰居們一起掃，一起把落葉裝進袋子裡。掃完後，阿豪拿出手機，拍下乾乾淨淨的巷子，說：「這張比大水好看多了！」{name}笑了，覺得自己剛完成了一場真正的冒險。
en: On the afternoon before the typhoon arrived, the sky turned gray and the wind made the leaves rustle. Ah-Hao and Xiao-Mei from next door knocked on the door. Ah-Hao held up his phone. "{name}, let's go film the big river! It'll be amazing!"

{name} felt a little tingle of curiosity. What did the river look like now? But Mom leaned out of the kitchen and said gently, "A typhoon river isn't a place for watching. We wait until grown-ups say it's safe." Then Ah-Hao's dad came by and walked the two kids home to get ready.

"Time for a typhoon mission!" Dad clapped. Level one was the balcony. {name} and Dad wheeled the two bikes inside, then carried in the little flowerpots one by one. The wind puffed up the curtains. "All in, door shut," said Dad. "Mission complete!"

Level two was finding light. {name} opened a drawer and found the yellow flashlight. Click. Hmm, the light was so dim! {name} put in new batteries and clicked again. A bright beam shone on the ceiling like a tiny moon. "Flashlight checked!"

Level three was water. Mom filled the big jug, and {name} lined up the bottles neatly, adding a note that said "Drinking Water." By evening, rain was pouring, and the wind rattled the windows. Dad said, "Let's move our base to the middle of the living room, away from the windows."

The family built a tent base with blankets and chairs. Suddenly, the lights flickered and went out. {name} switched on the flashlight right away, and warm light filled the tent. "Lucky we have a Flashlight Captain," Mom smiled. Everyone made shadow puppets of dogs and birds.

The next morning, the wind was gone and the sun peeked out from behind the clouds. The radio said the typhoon had moved far away. Dad looked outside and nodded. "Now it's safe." {name} grabbed a small broom and followed Mom and Dad into the lane, which was covered in leaves and twigs.

Ah-Hao and Xiao-Mei came out with brooms too. The neighbors swept together and filled bags with leaves. When they finished, Ah-Hao took a photo of the clean, shiny lane. "This is way better than the river!" {name} laughed. It felt like the end of a real adventure.

questions: 阿豪想去河邊拍大水的時候，{name}和家人做了什麼？
颱風天{name}幫忙準備了哪些東西？你可以幫家裡準備什麼？
晚上風很大的時候，為什麼一家人要把基地搬到客廳中間？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起找出家裡的手電筒，檢查電池，並約定一句話：「颱風天，等大人說安全再出門。」

questions: What did {name} and the family do when Ah-Hao wanted to film the river?
What did {name} help get ready for the typhoon? What could you help get ready at home?
Why did the family move their base to the middle of the living room when the wind was strong?
en.tip: This week, find your home's flashlight together and check the batteries, then practice the phrase: "On a typhoon day, we wait until grown-ups say it's safe."

zh: 下著毛毛雨的星期六下午，{name}窩在沙發上，玩最愛的遊戲《雲端城堡》。{his}巨龍塔只差最後一層，偏偏寶石不夠用。就在這時，螢幕突然閃出一行金光閃閃的字：「恭喜！免費送你一千顆寶石！只要在五分鐘內輸入密碼和手機號碼！」旁邊的倒數計時器滴答滴答地跳個不停。
一千顆！{name}的手指懸在半空中，心裡怦怦直跳。可是，天上真的會掉餡餅嗎？{name}半信半疑地湊近一看，寄件人叫「官放寶石守護者」，「方」竟然寫成了「放」。這時，常一起蓋城堡的網友「露露星」也傳來訊息：「我也拿到了！快填！別告訴爸媽，不然平板會被沒收。對了，你讀哪間學校？週末約在公園交換寶物吧！」
{name}的肚子像打了一個結。要保密？還要見面？{name}按下暫停，抱著平板快步走進廚房。爸爸正蹲在地上，修那扇嘎吱亂叫的櫥櫃門。「爸，我……會不會被罵？」{name}小聲問。爸爸放下螺絲起子，認真地看著{name}：「一點也不會。你先停下來找我，做得太好了。走，我們一起當偵探！」
兩位偵探並肩坐在餐桌前，睜大火眼金睛。「真正的遊戲公司，永遠不會跟你要密碼。」爸爸指著那個錯字說。{name}點開露露星的個人頁面，忽然倒抽一口氣：這個帳號昨天才建立，頭像角落還有一顆小小的紫色星星，跟「官放寶石守護者」的一模一樣！原來，這兩個帳號很可能是同一個人。
「所以，網路上說自己十歲的人，不一定真的是十歲。」{name}恍然大悟。爸爸點點頭：「網友不管多親切，都不能約出來見面。」{name}想了想，又說：「那我的學校、電話、住址，還有照片，也都不能告訴網路上的人，對吧？」「完全正確！」爸爸和{name}一起按下檢舉鍵，再把兩個帳號統統封鎖。
接著是最好玩的任務：打造一組超級堅固的新密碼。爸爸說，好密碼就像一句只有自己懂的怪句子。{name}靈機一動：「紫色鬆餅在雲上翻跟斗！」兩人笑得東倒西歪，再把這句話變成英文字母、數字和符號的長長組合，連巨龍都猜不到。最後，{name}把新密碼牢牢記在心裡，不寫在便利貼上。
晚餐前，遊戲信箱叮咚一聲。這次是真正的官方通知：「感謝你的檢舉，你保護了城堡裡的每一個人！」{name}得到一枚閃亮亮的「城堡守衛」徽章。雖然沒有一千顆寶石，{name}卻覺得它比任何寶物都珍貴。{he}已經決定，明天就要把今天的偵探冒險，一五一十地說給表妹聽。
en: On a drizzly Saturday afternoon, {name} curled up on the couch to play Cloud Castle, {his} favorite game. The dragon tower needed just one more floor, but the gem jar was nearly empty. Suddenly golden letters burst across the screen: "Congratulations! One thousand FREE gems! Just type your password and phone number within five minutes!" A countdown clock started ticking beside it.

A thousand! {name}'s finger hovered over the screen. But do gems really rain from the sky? Leaning closer, {name} spotted something odd. The sender was called "Offical Gem Keeper." Official was spelled wrong! Then a chat popped up from Lulu_Star, a player who often helped build towers: "I got mine! Hurry! Don't tell your parents or they'll take your tablet. What school do you go to? Let's meet at the park and trade treasures!"

{name}'s stomach twisted into a knot. Keep a secret? Meet in person? {name} pressed pause and hurried into the kitchen, where Dad was kneeling beside a squeaky cabinet door. "Dad, am I going to be in trouble?" Dad set down his screwdriver and looked right at {name}. "Not one bit. You stopped and came to me, and that was exactly right. Now, shall we be detectives?"

The two detectives sat side by side at the table, eyes sharp. "A real game company never asks for your password," Dad said, tapping the misspelled name. {name} opened Lulu_Star's profile and gasped. The account was made only yesterday, and in the corner of its picture sat a tiny purple star, exactly like the one on Offical Gem Keeper's. They were probably the same person!

"So someone online who says they're ten might not be ten at all," {name} said slowly. Dad nodded. "No matter how friendly an online friend seems, we never meet them." {name} thought for a moment. "And I shouldn't tell anyone online my school, my phone number, or where we live. Or send photos, right?" "Right on every count!" Together they pressed Report, then blocked both accounts.

Next came the best mission of all: building a super-strong new password. Dad explained that a good one is like a silly sentence only you understand. {name} grinned. "Purple pancakes do cartwheels on clouds!" They laughed so hard Dad nearly toppled off his chair. Then they turned it into a long string of letters, numbers, and symbols that not even a dragon could guess, and {name} tucked it safely into memory instead of onto a sticky note.

Just before dinner, the game mailbox chimed. This time the message was truly official: "Thank you for reporting. You helped keep everyone in the castle safe!" {name} received a shiny Castle Guardian badge. It wasn't a thousand gems, but somehow it felt better than any treasure. Tomorrow, {name} decided, {his} cousin would hear the whole detective adventure from beginning to end.

questions: {name}發現了哪些線索，知道那則寶石訊息怪怪的？
露露星問學校、還約見面時，{name}做了什麼？如果是你，你會怎麼做？
上網時，有什麼事情會讓你覺得怪怪的？你會想找誰說？
zh.tip: 這星期和孩子一起玩「怪句子密碼」遊戲，用一句好笑的句子幫家裡的一個帳號換新密碼。也可以約定一句暗號，例如「我看到怪怪的東西」，孩子說出來時，你只要先感謝孩子告訴你。

questions: What clues helped {name} figure out the gem message was strange?
What did {name} do when Lulu_Star asked about school and wanted to meet? What would you do?
Has anything online ever felt strange to you? Who would you tell?
en.tip: This week, play the "silly sentence password" game together and use a funny sentence to make a new password for one family account. Also agree on a simple phrase like "I saw something weird," and when your child says it, start by thanking them for telling you.

zh: 嘩啦啦，洗澡時間到了！浴缸裡有好多泡泡。{name}坐進溫溫的水裡。小黃鴨呱呱也來了。啾啾！啾啾！呱呱漂呀漂。爸爸坐在旁邊陪著。
呱呱游到{name}面前。爸爸幫呱呱說話。「{name}，我有問題！」「什麼是泳衣呀？」{name}想一想。「玩水時穿的！」呱呱又問：「泳衣蓋住哪裡？」
爸爸笑一笑。「泳衣蓋住的地方，很特別。」「那是私密的地方。」「那是{name}自己的。」「別人不能叫你看，」「也不能摸喔。」{name}拍拍水。「是我的！是我的！」
呱呱歪著頭問。「別人叫我看別人的呢？」爸爸搖搖頭。「那也不可以喔。」「每個人都一樣，」「那是自己的地方。」呱呱說：「我懂了！啾啾！」
「爸爸可以幫忙洗嗎？」呱呱問。「可以，就像現在。」「爸爸幫忙洗乾淨。」「看醫生也一樣。」「爸爸媽媽會陪你。」「醫生會先說為什麼。」{name}點點頭。
「搔癢停不下來呢？」「不想要抱抱呢？」爸爸說：「你可以說：停！」「再告訴爸爸媽媽。」「擔心的秘密也要說。」「那不是你的錯。」「我們會聽，會幫你。」
{name}大聲說：「我要自己洗肚子！」{name}拿起海綿。擠一擠，泡泡跑出來。哎呀！海綿滑走了。撲通！{name}把它撿回來。再試一次！
搓搓搓，轉圈圈。小肚子上全是泡泡。「我洗好了！」爸爸拍拍手：「好棒喔！」呱呱也叫：「啾啾！啾啾！」暖暖的大毛巾，包住{name}。香香又乾淨！
en: Splash, splash! It's bath time! The tub is full of bubbles. {name} sits in the warm water. Here comes Quacky, the rubber duck. Squeak, squeak! Quacky floats around. Dad sits close by.
Quacky floats up to {name}. Dad gives Quacky a funny voice. "{name}, I have a question!" "What is a swimsuit?" {name} thinks hard. "We wear it to splash!" "What does it cover?" asks Quacky.
Dad smiles. "The swimsuit parts are special." "They are private." "They belong to {name}." "Nobody should ask to see them." "Nobody should touch them." {name} pats the water. "Mine! Mine!"
Quacky tilts its head. "What if someone wants me to see theirs?" Dad shakes his head. "That's not okay either." "Everyone's swimsuit parts are their own." "Got it!" says Quacky. Squeak!
"Can Dad help wash?" asks Quacky. "Yes, like right now," says Dad. "I help keep {name} clean." "The doctor is the same." "Mom or Dad stays close." "The doctor tells you why." {name} nods.

"What if a tickle won't stop?" "What if I don't want a hug?" Dad says, "You can say, 'Stop!'" "Then tell Mom or Dad." "Tell us worrying secrets too." "It's never your fault." "We will listen and help."
"I want to wash my own tummy!" says {name}. {name} squeezes the sponge. Bubbles pop out. Oops! The sponge slips away. Plop! {name} grabs it again. Try once more!
Rub, rub, round and round. Bubbles cover {his} tummy! "I did it!" Dad claps. "Great job!" Quacky squeaks too. Squeak, squeak! A big warm towel wraps {name} up. Cozy and clean!

questions: 泳衣蓋住的地方是誰的呢？
如果搔癢停不下來，或不想要抱抱，{name}可以說什麼？可以告訴誰？
洗澡時，{name}可以自己洗哪裡？
zh.tip: 今晚洗澡時，讓孩子自己洗肚子，並一起練習大聲說「停！」，再告訴孩子：「你可以隨時跟我說，我都會聽。」

questions: Who do the swimsuit parts belong to?
If a tickle won't stop or {name} doesn't want a hug, what can {he} say? Who can {he} tell?
What can {name} wash all alone at bath time?
en.tip: At bath time tonight, let your child wash their own tummy and practice saying "Stop!" together in a big voice. Then say, "You can always tell me anything, and I will listen."

zh: 星期六早上，爸爸帶{name}去城市裡的水上樂園。他們一起搭捷運，窗外有好多高樓。{name}抱著一件新的連帽浴巾斗篷。它軟軟的，套上去像一頂小帳篷。爸爸提著大包包，笑著說：「今天要玩個痛快！」
到了更衣區，{name}先把斗篷從頭上套下來。{he}在斗篷裡慢慢換衣服，扭一扭，拉一拉。換好了！{name}探出頭，得意地笑了。爸爸在旁邊等著，豎起大拇指：「泳衣蓋住的地方，是你自己的喔。」{name}點點頭：「那是隱私的地方。」
爸爸幫{name}擦防曬乳。手臂、臉頰和後背，都塗得亮亮的。他們走到淺水池，爸爸一直陪在旁邊。這時，有人大聲喊：「{name}！」原來是好朋友安安，和她的媽媽。兩個小朋友開心地跳了起來。
大家一起玩水。頭頂的大水桶裝滿了水。嘩啦一聲，水倒了下來！{name}和安安被淋成落湯雞，笑得停不下來。他們還和爸爸媽媽坐上游泳圈，在漂漂河上慢慢轉圈圈。太陽暖暖的，水花閃閃發亮。
玩累了，該回家了。大家回到更衣區。安安坐在長椅上，準備直接脫下泳衣。旁邊有好多人走來走去。{name}心裡有點緊張，要不要說呢？{name}深深吸了一口氣，走了過去。
「安安，要不要試試我的斗篷魔法？」{name}把斗篷借給她，教她從頭上套下去。安安的手卡在裡面，找不到袖口。{name}指著說：「往這邊伸！」安安終於鑽出頭來，大笑說：「好像躲在帳篷裡！」
安安在斗篷裡換好了衣服。她小聲說：「泳衣蓋住的地方，是我自己的。」{name}點點頭：「別人不能要求看或摸。也不能叫我們看別人的。」安安說：「洗澡時媽媽會幫忙。看醫生時，媽媽也會陪著我。」安安媽媽笑著說：「你們說得真好。」
防曬乳黏黏的，爸爸帶{name}去沖水。「手舉高！」爸爸幫忙沖手臂和後背。{name}自己搓一搓，洗得乾乾淨淨。爸爸說：「如果有什麼讓你不舒服，都可以告訴我。」{name}抱住爸爸：「我知道！」回家的捷運上，{his}斗篷還暖暖的。
en: On Saturday, Dad took {name} to the city water park. They rode the train past tall buildings. {name} hugged a soft hooded towel poncho. It was like a little tent. "Let's have fun!" Dad said.

In the changing area, {name} pulled the poncho over {his} head. Inside, {name} changed slowly. Wiggle, wiggle, tug! All done! {name} popped out, smiling. Dad gave a thumbs-up. "The parts your swimsuit covers belong to you." {name} nodded. "They're private."

Dad helped spread sunscreen on {name}'s arms, cheeks, and back. Then they went to the shallow pool, and Dad stayed close by. "{name}!" someone called. It was An-An, a good friend, with her mom. The two friends jumped for joy.

Everyone splashed together. A giant bucket overhead filled up and tipped. Splash! {name} and An-An were soaked from top to toe. They giggled and giggled. Then they floated on tubes down the lazy river with the grown-ups.

Then it was time to go home. Back in the changing area, An-An sat on a bench. She started to pull off her swimsuit right there. Lots of people were walking by. {name} felt a little nervous. Should I say something? {name} took a deep breath and walked over.

"An-An, want to try my poncho trick?" {name} helped her slip it over her head. An-An's hand got stuck inside. "Push it through here!" said {name}, pointing. An-An wiggled her head out and laughed. "It's like hiding in a tent!"

Inside the poncho, An-An changed into dry clothes. "The parts my swimsuit covers are mine," she whispered. {name} nodded. "Nobody should ask to see or touch them. Or ask us to see theirs." "Mom helps at bath time," said An-An. "And at the doctor's, Mom stays with me." An-An's mom smiled.

The sunscreen felt sticky, so Dad took {name} to the shower. "Arms up!" Dad rinsed {name}'s arms and back. {name} scrubbed the rest until it was squeaky clean. "If anything ever feels wrong, you can tell me," Dad said. {name} hugged him. "I know!" On the train home, {name} snuggled the warm poncho.

questions: 安安要在長椅上換衣服時，{name}做了什麼？
泳衣蓋住的地方，什麼時候可以讓別人幫忙？
如果有人一直搔癢、你說不要還不停，你會怎麼做、會告訴誰？
zh.tip: 今晚洗澡時，和孩子一起說一句「泳衣蓋住的地方是我自己的」，再練習大聲說「不要，我要告訴大人」。

questions: What did {name} do when An-An started to change on the bench?
When is it okay for someone to help with the parts your swimsuit covers?
If someone kept tickling you after you said stop, what would you do and who would you tell?
en.tip: At bath time tonight, say together, "The parts my swimsuit covers belong to me," then practice saying out loud, "No, I'm going to tell a grown-up."

zh: 星期三早上，教室裡好熱鬧。陳老師把手指放在嘴巴前，小聲說：「我們來做一個祕密。」大家都靠過來聽。「星期天是母親節，我們要偷偷做卡片，給媽媽一個驚喜！」小朋友都笑了。{name}的肚子暖暖的，好像有泡泡在跳舞。
老師發下紅色的紙。{name}剪了一顆大大的愛心，又貼上亮晶晶的星星。{name}在卡片上畫了一朵花，還寫上「我愛你」。做好以後，{name}把卡片藏進櫃子裡。樂樂眨眨眼說：「噓，星期天才能說喔！」{name}笑著點點頭。這個祕密好甜，好像糖果一樣。
下課了，大家跑到操場玩。樂樂的球滾到矮籬笆旁邊。樂樂沒有找老師幫忙，自己爬上籬笆。腳一滑，咚的一聲坐在地上。{name}趕快跑過去。樂樂的膝蓋紅紅的，擦破了一點皮。樂樂咬著嘴唇，眼睛濕濕的。
{name}輕輕說：「我們去找陳老師吧。」樂樂馬上搖頭：「不要！爬籬笆會被唸。」樂樂拉著{name}的手說：「這是祕密，永遠不能說喔！」{name}愣住了，慢慢點點頭。可是{his}心裡，好像有一顆小石頭掉下來。
回到教室，大家開始畫畫。{name}拿起蠟筆，卻畫不下去。{his}肚子緊緊的，扭來扭去。做卡片的祕密，讓人想笑。這個祕密，卻讓人好擔心。{name}偷偷看樂樂。樂樂走路慢慢的，還一直揉膝蓋。
{name}深深吸一口氣。{name}站起來，慢慢走到陳老師旁邊。{his}聲音小小的：「老師，樂樂下課時跌倒了。膝蓋受傷了，可是樂樂說不能說。」說完，{name}的手還有一點抖。樂樂會不會不開心呢？
陳老師蹲下來，對{name}微笑。「謝謝你告訴我。你做得很對，你不會有麻煩的。」老師帶樂樂到保健室，把膝蓋洗乾淨，貼上一片小熊OK繃。陳老師溫柔地說：「下次球滾走了，來找老師幫忙喔。」樂樂點點頭，鬆了一口氣。
後來，樂樂走過來，小聲說：「{name}，謝謝你。我的膝蓋不痛了。」{name}的肚子不再扭來扭去，變得輕輕鬆鬆。放學前，{name}看看櫃子。紅色的卡片還藏在裡面，等著星期天。到了那天，這個甜甜的祕密，就會變成大大的笑容。
en: On Wednesday morning, the classroom was buzzing. Teacher Chen put a finger to her lips. "Let's make a secret," she whispered. Everyone leaned close. "Sunday is Mother's Day. We'll make cards as a surprise!" The children giggled. {name}'s tummy felt warm and bubbly.

Teacher Chen handed out red paper. {name} cut out a big heart. Then {name} added sparkly stars and a flower. "I love you," {name} wrote inside. The card went into {his} cubby. Lele winked. "Shh! Not until Sunday!" This secret felt sweet, like candy.

At recess, everyone ran outside to play. Lele's ball rolled over by the low fence. Lele didn't ask a teacher for help. He climbed the fence instead. Then his foot slipped. Bump! Lele sat down hard. {name} hurried over. Lele's knee was red and scraped. His eyes were wet.

"Let's go find Teacher Chen," {name} said gently. Lele shook his head fast. "No! I'll get in trouble for climbing." He held {name}'s hand tight. "This is a secret. Never tell!" {name} froze, then slowly nodded. But inside, something felt heavy, like a little stone.

Back in class, it was drawing time. {name} picked up a crayon but couldn't draw. {his} tummy felt tight and twisty. The card secret made {name} want to smile. This secret made {name} worried. Lele walked slowly and kept rubbing his knee.

{name} took a deep breath. {name} stood up and walked to Teacher Chen. "Teacher," {name} said in a small voice, "Lele fell at recess. His knee is hurt. He said not to tell." {name}'s hands shook a little. Would Lele be upset?

Teacher Chen knelt down and smiled. "Thank you for telling me. That was the right thing. You're not in any trouble." She took Lele to the nurse's room. They washed his knee and added a bear bandage. "Next time, ask me to get the ball," she said kindly. Lele nodded, relieved.

Later, Lele came over. "Thank you, {name}. My knee feels better." {name}'s tummy wasn't twisty anymore. It felt light and calm. Before home time, {name} peeked into {his} cubby. The red card was still hiding there. On Sunday, that sweet secret would become a big smile.

questions: 做母親節卡片的祕密，和樂樂說「永遠不能說」的祕密，讓{name}的肚子有什麼不一樣的感覺？
{name}告訴陳老師以後，發生了什麼事？
如果有人要你保守一個讓你擔心的祕密，你可以去告訴誰？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子玩「驚喜還是擔心？」的小遊戲：你說一個祕密情境，孩子判斷它是會讓人開心、很快就揭曉的驚喜，還是該告訴大人的擔心祕密。一起練習說：「說出來，你永遠不會有麻煩。」

questions: How did {name}'s tummy feel about the Mother's Day card secret, and how did it feel about Lele's "never tell" secret?
What happened after {name} told Teacher Chen?
If someone asked you to keep a secret that made you worried, who could you tell?
en.tip: This week, play a "Surprise or Worry?" game: describe a secret and let your child decide if it is a happy surprise that ends soon or a worried secret to tell a grown-up. Practice the phrase together: "You will never be in trouble for telling me."

title.en: {name} and the Secret on the Wall

zh: 三年二班有一個大祕密：大家要在禮堂後面的牆上，偷偷畫一幅感謝壁畫，送給下個月就要退休的林老師。每天午休，{name}和同學們躡手躡腳地溜進去，調顏料、畫花朵。只要一想到林老師看見時的表情，{name}的心裡就像汽水一樣，咕嘟咕嘟冒著快樂的泡泡。
可是這幾天，{name}發現一件怪事。每到下課，同學小安就不見人影。有一次，{name}經過洗手間門口，聽見裡面傳來細細的吸鼻子聲。「小安，是妳嗎？」門慢慢打開，小安的眼睛紅紅的，小聲地說：「下課的時候，我好害怕，所以躲在這裡。」
「發生什麼事了？」{name}問。小安只是搖搖頭，緊緊拉住{his}手：「你要答應我，永遠永遠不能告訴任何人，連老師都不行。」{name}愣了一下，還是點了點頭。那天下午，{name}每走一步都覺得好沉重，好像書包裡被偷偷塞進了一顆大石頭。
第二天午休，大家又到牆邊畫畫。阿哲不小心把藍色顏料點在自己鼻尖上，全班笑得東倒西歪。{name}也跟著笑，心裡卻悶悶的。壁畫的祕密像口袋裡的糖果，越想越甜；小安的祕密卻像打結的毛線，越想越亂。而且壁畫過幾天就會揭曉，小安卻說要守住「永遠」。
{name}想起輔導室的陳老師，她總是笑咪咪的，說過有任何煩惱都可以去找她。可是，萬一小安生氣了怎麼辦？萬一大家說自己愛告狀呢？{name}在輔導室門口來回踱步，足足走了三趟，最後深深吸一口氣，鼓起勇氣，輕輕敲了敲門。
陳老師請{name}坐下，遞來一杯溫水。{name}把洗手間的事一五一十說出來，說完眼淚就掉了下來。「我是不是做錯了？我答應過她的。」陳老師溫柔地說：「你一點都沒錯。這種讓你心裡沉甸甸、又說永遠不能講的祕密，交給大人來幫忙就對了。你說出來，絕對不會惹上麻煩。」
接下來幾天，陳老師找小安慢慢聊天，也和導護老師一起，讓下課的操場變得更安心。小安加入了圖書館小幫手，下課時再也不躲起來了。有一天，她悄悄塞給{name}一張紙條：「謝謝你。其實我一直希望有人發現。」{name}看著紙條，心裡那顆大石頭咻地一下不見了。
林老師退休那天，全班把她帶到禮堂後面。布一掀開，滿牆的花朵、太陽和笑臉一下子亮了起來，角落還多了一隻小安畫的小藍鳥。林老師摀著嘴，又哭又笑：「你們居然瞞了我一整個月！」{name}和小安相視一笑。這個祕密，終於可以大聲說出來了。
en: Class 3B had a big secret. Behind the school hall, everyone was painting a thank-you mural for Ms. Lin, who would retire next month. Every lunch break, {name} and the others tiptoed in to mix colors and paint flowers. Just picturing Ms. Lin's face made {name} fizz inside like soda full of happy bubbles.

But lately, {name} had noticed something odd. At every recess, a classmate named Ann vanished. One day, walking past the restroom, {name} heard a tiny sniffle. "Ann, is that you?" The door creaked open. Ann's eyes were red. "Recess makes me scared," she whispered, "so I hide in here."

"What happened?" asked {name}. Ann only shook her head and held on tight to {his} hand. "Promise you'll never, ever tell anyone. Not even a teacher." {name} hesitated, then nodded. All that afternoon, every step felt heavy, as if someone had slipped a big stone into {his} backpack.

The next lunch break, the class painted again. Jay dabbed blue paint on the tip of his own nose, and everyone giggled. {name} laughed too, but {his} heart felt cloudy. The mural secret was like candy in a pocket, sweeter every time. Ann's secret was like tangled yarn. And the mural would be revealed in days, but Ann had said "never."

{name} thought of Ms. Chen, the school counselor, who always smiled and said anyone could bring her a worry. But what if Ann got angry? What if people called {name} a tattletale? {name} paced past the counselor's door one, two, three times. Then, with a deep breath, {name} knocked softly.

Ms. Chen offered a chair and a cup of warm water. {name} told her everything, and tears spilled out. "Did I do something wrong? I promised." Ms. Chen said gently, "Not at all. A secret that feels heavy, and that you're told never to tell, is one to share with a grown-up. You will never be in trouble for telling me."

Over the next few days, Ms. Chen talked quietly with Ann, and the recess teachers helped make the playground feel safer. Ann joined the library helpers and stopped hiding. One day she slipped {name} a note: "Thank you. I was really hoping someone would notice." Whoosh! The heavy stone was gone.

On Ms. Lin's last day, the class led her behind the hall. The cloth came down, and the wall burst with flowers, suns and smiling faces. In one corner sat a little blue bird that Ann had painted. Ms. Lin laughed and cried at once. "You kept this from me for a whole month!" {name} and Ann grinned. This secret could finally be said out loud.

questions: 壁畫的祕密和小安的祕密，讓{name}的心裡各有什麼感覺？哪裡不一樣？
{name}擔心說出來會被說愛告狀，最後為什麼還是去找陳老師？
如果有人要你守一個讓你擔心的祕密，你會去找誰說？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子玩「驚喜還是擔心？」小遊戲：輪流說出一個祕密情境，一起判斷它是會讓人開心、很快揭曉的驚喜，還是該告訴大人的擔心祕密。最後一起列出三位孩子信任、可以傾訴的大人。

questions: How did the mural secret and Ann's secret make {name} feel inside? How were they different?
{name} worried about being called a tattletale. Why did {name} still go to Ms. Chen?
If someone asked you to keep a secret that made you worried, who would you tell?
en.tip: This week, play a quick "Surprise or Worry?" game: take turns describing a secret and decide together whether it's a happy surprise that ends soon or a worry to tell a grown-up. Then name three trusted adults your child can always go to.

zh: 叮咚！叮咚！爺爺來了。{name}跑到門口。「爺爺好！」爺爺笑呵呵。爺爺有白白的鬍子。鬍子刺刺的，像小刷子。刷刷刷，刷刷刷。
爺爺彎下腰。「來，親一個！」啾！鬍子刺刺的。{name}的臉頰刺刺的。有一點癢，有一點痛。{name}皺起眉頭。{name}不喜歡這樣。
爺爺又彎下腰。「再親一個！」{name}小小聲說：「不要……」聲音好小好小。爺爺沒有聽見。{name}吸一口氣。站得直直的。
「爺爺，不要親親。請揮揮手！」這次好大聲。爺爺停下來。「好呀，沒問題！」爺爺舉起大大的手。揮呀揮，揮呀揮。像大風車，呼呼呼！{name}哈哈笑。
爺爺動動手指。「搔癢癢來囉！」咯咯咯，咯咯咯。好癢，好好笑。可是一直不停。「爺爺，請停！」爺爺馬上停下來。「好，停了。」{name}舉起小手。「擊掌吧！」啪！
喵——喵——貓咪咪咪來了。尾巴搖呀搖。{name}蹲下來。「咪咪，可以摸你嗎？」咪咪靠過來。蹭蹭{name}的手。呼嚕呼嚕，呼嚕呼嚕。{name}輕輕摸一摸。軟軟的，暖暖的。
摸了一會兒。咪咪站起來。伸一伸懶腰。咪咪要走了。{name}好想再摸摸。可是小手停住了。「好，咪咪，掰掰。」咪咪慢慢走開。跳到窗邊曬太陽。喵——
爺爺坐到沙發上。{name}靠在爺爺身邊。「爺爺，抱抱好嗎？」爺爺說：「好呀！」暖暖的抱抱。爺爺揮揮手。{name}也揮揮手。咪咪在窗邊，呼嚕呼嚕。
en: Ding-dong! Ding-dong! Grandpa is here! {name} runs to the door. "Hi, Grandpa!" Grandpa smiles big. He has a white, fluffy beard. His whiskers are scratchy, like a little brush. Scritch, scratch!
Grandpa bends down. "Here comes a kiss!" Smooch! The whiskers scratch {name}'s cheek. Prickly and tickly. A little bit ouchy. {name} frowns. {name} does not like it.
Grandpa bends down again. "One more kiss!" {name} whispers, "No..." It is a tiny, tiny voice. Grandpa does not hear. {name} takes a big breath. {name} stands up tall.
"No kiss, please, Grandpa. Wave!" This time it is loud and clear. Grandpa stops. "Okay, no problem!" He lifts his big hand. Wave, wave, wave! Like a windmill! Whoosh! {name} giggles.

Grandpa wiggles his fingers. "Tickle time!" Hee hee hee! Ha ha ha! But the tickles go on and on. "Stop, please!" says {name}. Grandpa stops right away. "Okay, all done." {name} holds up a hand. "High five!" Smack!
Meow! Meow! Here comes Mimi the cat. Swish goes her tail. {name} crouches down. "Mimi, may I pet you?" Mimi rubs {name}'s hand. Purr, purr, purr. {name} pets her gently. Soft and warm.

After a while, Mimi stands up. She stretches long. Mimi wants to go. {name} wants one more pet. But {name} pulls back. "Okay, Mimi. Bye-bye!" Mimi walks away slowly. She naps in the sunny window. Meow.
Grandpa sits on the sofa. {name} snuggles close. "Grandpa, can I have a hug?" "Yes, please!" says Grandpa. A big, warm hug. Grandpa waves. {name} waves back. In the window, Mimi purrs.

questions: 爺爺的鬍子刺刺的時候，{name}說了什麼？爺爺怎麼做？
咪咪走開的時候，{name}怎麼做？
如果有人一直搔你癢，你不喜歡，你可以說什麼？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子練習一句話：「不要，謝謝，我們擊掌好嗎？」當孩子對你的抱抱說不時，開心地回答「好！」並改成揮手或擊掌。

questions: What did {name} say when Grandpa's whiskers felt scratchy? What did Grandpa do?
What did {name} do when Mimi walked away?
If someone keeps tickling you and you don't like it, what can you say?
en.tip: This week, practice one phrase together: "No, thank you. How about a high five?" When your child says no to your hug, answer cheerfully, "Okay!" and offer a wave or high five instead.

zh: 早上，陽光灑在教室門口。{name}剛把書包放好。「早安！」莫莫一邊喊，一邊衝過來。她張開雙手，用力一抱。哇，好緊好緊！{name}被擠得扁扁的，連呼吸都卡住了。{his}肚子怪怪的，像打了一個小結。
第二天，莫莫又來一個大擠抱。第三天，也是一樣。{name}心裡想：「我不喜歡這樣。」可是莫莫笑得好開心。{name}怕說出來，莫莫會難過。話到了嘴邊，又吞了回去。吃午餐時，{name}一直在想這件事。
放學前，{name}在本子上畫了一張圖。圖上是兩隻手，手指勾在一起。{name}小聲練習：「我不喜歡擠抱抱。」第一次，聲音好小好小。第二次，大聲一點了。第三次，{name}說得好清楚。
隔天早上，莫莫又張開雙手跑來。{name}深吸一口氣，舉起一隻手。「等一下！我不喜歡擠抱抱。我們來玩祕密握手，好不好？」莫莫停下腳步，眨眨眼睛。「祕密握手？那是什麼？」
{name}伸出手示範給她看。先碰碰大拇指，再動動手指頭。接著拍一下手掌，最後一起喊「啵！」莫莫學兩次就會了。她笑得咯咯響：「這個比抱抱還好玩！」{name}肚子裡的小結，一下子鬆開了。
下課時，大家在走廊排隊。莫莫今天綁了兩條長辮子，上面有亮晶晶的髮夾。{name}好想摸一摸，就伸出了手。莫莫往後退一步：「請不要摸我的頭髮，我不喜歡。」{name}的手停在半空中。
{name}想起擠抱抱的感覺。原來莫莫也有不喜歡的事。{name}把手收回來，說：「好，對不起。那我們揮揮手？」莫莫開心地揮手，兩個人都笑了。林老師走過來，蹲下來說：「你們都有好好聽對方說話呢。」
莫莫小聲問：「阿嬤親我都好用力，我也可以說不嗎？」林老師點點頭：「可以呀，就算是家人也可以。你可以問阿嬤，我們擊掌好不好？」莫莫笑開了：「阿嬤最喜歡擊掌了！」
第二天早上，教室門口貼了一張「打招呼表」。上面有抱抱、擊掌、揮手，還有碰手肘。每個小朋友都選了自己喜歡的。林老師問：「{name}，今天想怎麼打招呼？」{name}笑著說：「祕密握手！」莫莫早就伸出手在等了。「啵！」
en: Morning sun shone on the classroom door. {name} hung up {his} backpack. "Good morning!" called Momo, running over. She threw her arms wide and squeezed. So tight! {name} could hardly breathe. {his} tummy felt funny, like a little knot.

The next day, Momo gave another big squeeze hug. The day after, the same. {name} thought, "I don't like this." But Momo smiled so happily. What if she felt sad? The words got stuck. All through lunch, {name} kept thinking.

Before home time, {name} drew a picture. It showed two hands with fingers hooked together. Then {name} practiced quietly. "I don't like squeeze hugs." The first try was tiny. The second was louder. The third time, {name} said it nice and clear.

The next morning, Momo ran over with open arms. {name} took a deep breath and held up a hand. "Wait! I don't like squeeze hugs. Let's do a secret handshake!" Momo stopped and blinked. "A secret handshake? What's that?"
{name} showed her. Tap thumbs. Wiggle fingers. Slap palms. Then both shout, "Pop!" Momo learned it in two tries. She giggled. "This is more fun than hugging!" The knot in {name}'s tummy came undone.

At recess, the class lined up in the hallway. Momo had two long braids with sparkly clips. {name} reached out to touch one. Momo stepped back. "Please don't touch my hair. I don't like it." {name}'s hand stopped in the air.

{name} remembered the squeeze hugs. Momo had things she didn't like, too. {name} pulled back and said, "Okay, sorry. Want to wave instead?" Momo waved happily, and they both laughed. Ms. Lin knelt down beside them. "You two really listened to each other."
Momo whispered, "Grandma's kisses are super squishy. Can I say no to her, too?" Ms. Lin nodded. "Yes, even to family. You could ask Grandma for a high five." Momo grinned. "Grandma loves high fives!"

The next morning, a Hello Chart hung by the door. It had hugs, high fives, waves, and elbow bumps. Everyone picked a favorite. Ms. Lin asked, "{name}, how do you want to say hello today?" "Secret handshake!" said {name}. Momo's hand was already out. "Pop!"

questions: 莫莫抱得太緊時，{name}做了什麼？{name}後來覺得怎麼樣？
莫莫說「請不要摸我的頭髮」時，{name}怎麼回應？
如果有人抱你、親你或搔你癢，你不想要，你可以怎麼說？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起發明一個專屬的祕密握手，並練習說「我不想要抱抱，我們擊掌好嗎？」。當孩子對你說不時，也請溫柔地接受，讓孩子知道他的感受很重要。

questions: What did {name} do when Momo's hug was too tight? How did {name} feel afterward?
When Momo said, "Please don't touch my hair," what did {name} do?
If someone wants to hug, kiss, or tickle you and you don't want it, what could you say?
en.tip: Tonight, invent your own family secret handshake together and practice saying, "I don't want a hug, can we high five?" When your child says no to you, accept it kindly so they know their feelings matter.

zh: 星期六下午，家裡飄著滷肉的香味，媽媽的老朋友陸叔叔要來作客。{name}一邊擺碗筷，一邊瞄向冰箱。上面貼著{his}在學校畫的「安全網小手」，五根手指各寫著一個名字：媽媽、爸爸、小阿姨、外婆，還有黃老師。
門鈴一響，陸叔叔哈哈大笑地走進來，張開雙臂：「來，給叔叔抱一個！」{name}退了一步，伸出手掌說：「不用了，我們擊掌就好。」陸叔叔卻像沒聽見，一把將{name}捲進懷裡，抱得緊緊的。{name}的肚子像打了一個結。
吃甜點的時候，陸叔叔又張開手臂走過來：「再抱一個嘛！」{name}搖搖頭，大聲說：「我不要。」說完便溜到椅子後面。陸叔叔笑著說：「害羞什麼呀！」{name}的心怦怦直跳，手足無措，手心也冒出了汗。
{name}跑進廚房找小阿姨，把事情一五一十說出來。小阿姨正忙著切西瓜，頭也沒抬：「陸叔叔是喜歡你啊，有禮貌一點就好。」{name}低下頭，覺得自己好像縮成了一顆小豆子。
{name}慢慢走回冰箱前，盯著那隻小手。一根手指沒聽懂，還有四根呢！{name}想起黃老師說過：「第一個大人沒聽懂，就再找下一個，一直說到有人幫忙為止。」真巧，今天下午黃老師正好要來家庭訪問。
叮咚！黃老師一進門，{name}就拉著老師的衣角，走到安靜的陽台。{name}深吸一口氣，聲音有點發抖：「陸叔叔一直要抱我，我說不要，他還是抱。我跟小阿姨說了，她叫我要有禮貌。」
黃老師蹲下來，認真聽完，點點頭：「你說不要，又一直找大人說，真的很勇敢。我們一起去告訴媽媽，好嗎？」媽媽聽完，先輕聲問：「我可以抱抱你嗎？」{name}點點頭，靠進媽媽溫暖的懷裡。站在門邊的小阿姨也紅了臉：「對不起，我剛剛沒有好好聽。」
傍晚，陸叔叔要回家了，又張開雙臂。媽媽和小阿姨一左一右站到{name}身邊：「{name}說過不要喔，換個方式吧！」{name}舉起手掌：「擊掌好嗎？」陸叔叔愣了一下，隨即咧嘴一笑，「啪」地擊掌，還發明了一套扭扭屁股的獨門招呼。大家笑成一團，冰箱上的小手，好像也在拍手。
en: On Saturday afternoon, the house smelled of braised pork. Mom's old friend, Uncle Lu, was coming to visit. As {name} set out the bowls, {his} eyes drifted to the fridge. There hung the Safety Net Hand from school, each finger labeled: Mom, Dad, Auntie, Grandma, and Teacher Huang.

The doorbell rang, and Uncle Lu boomed with laughter, arms flung wide. "Come give me a big hug!" {name} stepped back and held up a palm. "No thanks. Let's do a high-five." But Uncle Lu scooped {name} into a squeeze anyway. {name}'s tummy twisted into a knot.

At dessert, Uncle Lu came over again, arms stretched out. "One more hug!" {name} shook {his} head and said loudly, "I don't want to." Then {name} slipped behind a chair. "Why so shy?" Uncle Lu chuckled. {name}'s heart thumped, and {his} palms felt damp.

{name} hurried into the kitchen and told Auntie everything. Auntie was busy slicing watermelon and didn't even look up. "Uncle Lu just likes you. Be polite, that's all." {name} stared at the floor, feeling as small as a bean.

Back at the fridge, {name} studied the paper hand. One finger hadn't understood, but there were four more! {name} remembered Teacher Huang saying, "If the first grown-up doesn't get it, tell the next one, and keep telling until someone helps." And Teacher Huang was coming for a home visit that very afternoon.

Ding-dong! The moment Teacher Huang walked in, {name} tugged her sleeve and led her to the quiet balcony. Taking a deep breath, {name} spoke in a wobbly voice. "Uncle Lu keeps hugging me. I said no, but he still does. I told Auntie, and she said to be polite."

Teacher Huang knelt down and listened to every word. "You said no, and you kept telling grown-ups. That was brave. Shall we tell Mom together?" Mom listened too, then asked softly, "May I give you a hug?" {name} nodded and leaned in. By the door, Auntie's cheeks turned pink. "I'm sorry. I didn't really listen before."

That evening, Uncle Lu opened his arms to say goodbye. Mom and Auntie stepped up on either side of {name}. "{name} said no. Let's try something else!" {name} raised a palm. "High-five?" Uncle Lu blinked, then grinned. Smack! He even invented a silly wiggle-dance greeting. Everyone giggled, and the paper hand on the fridge seemed to clap along.

questions: 小阿姨說「有禮貌一點就好」的時候，{name}接下來做了什麼？
如果你跟一個大人說了，他卻沒聽懂，你會再去找誰？
你的安全網小手上，想寫哪五個人？有沒有一位是家人以外的大人？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起描下小手，在每根手指寫上一位信任的大人（至少一位是老師或學校護理師），貼在冰箱上；再一起練習說：「我不要，我們擊掌就好。」

questions: When Auntie said "Just be polite," what did {name} do next?
If you told a grown-up something and they didn't understand, who would you tell next?
Which five people would you put on your own Safety Net Hand? Is one of them someone outside the family?
