晚餐後，{name}把合約攤在餐桌上。爸爸讀到第二條，眉毛挑得老高：「連我也要管？」「人人平等。」{name}理直氣壯。媽媽笑著簽了名，四歲的弟弟小豆不會寫字，就蓋了一個沾著番茄醬的手印。爸爸嘆了一口長氣，像洩了氣的氣球，最後還是乖乖簽下名字。合約貼上冰箱，正式生效。
星期一，{name}說好看二十分鐘。影片裡的小貓正要跳上書架，計時器「嗶嗶嗶」響了。{name}的手指停在螢幕上，心裡像被貓爪抓了一下。「好想知道牠有沒有跳上去……」媽媽輕聲說：「失望是正常的，先吸一口氣。」{name}深呼吸，關掉平板，跑去和小豆比賽學青蛙跳，跳到兩人笑倒在地毯上。
星期三晚餐，桌子底下亮起一道微光。{name}清清喉嚨，指了指冰箱。爸爸像偷吃糖被逮到的小孩，趕緊把手機收進抽屜：「報告長官，收到！」那晚沒人滑手機，爸爸講起自己小時候養的鵝會追著郵差跑，大家笑得飯粒差點噴出來。{name}發現，眼睛不再乾乾澀澀，反而像睡過午覺一樣清爽。
星期五到了。{name}拖著腳步搬出積了灰塵的桌遊盒，準備忍耐一整晚。沒想到，爸爸每次擲骰子前都要對骰子說悄悄話；媽媽假裝手上的牌很爛，結果一口氣贏走三張；小豆把棋子藏在帽子底下，說是在「孵蛋」。{name}笑到肚子痛，抱著靠墊在沙發上打滾，完全忘了看時間。
「九點了，該刷牙睡覺囉。」爸爸說。「再一局就好！」{name}脫口而出，說完自己也愣住了——這句話上週明明是用來求多看一支影片的。全家哄堂大笑。爸爸眨眨眼：「時間到就停，合約說的。」{name}點點頭，拿起筆在合約最下面加上第五條：桌遊夜，可以每週兩次嗎？
en: On Sunday evening, {name} rubbed {his} tired eyes and realized the whole weekend had vanished, as if a vacuum cleaner had slurped it up. One video had led to another, and "just one more" had been said at least twenty times. {his} block castle was half built. {his} homework sat alone on the desk. "That's it," {name} announced, slapping the table. "This family needs a contract!"

{name} found the most official-looking paper in the house and ruled neat lines. Rule one: before using the tablet, agree how long, and stop when the timer rings. Rule two: Dad doesn't scroll his phone at dinner. Rule three: Mom doesn't answer work messages after eight. Rule four: Friday is board-game night. {name} wrinkled {his} nose at that one. Board games were boring, but Mom would surely ask for them anyway.

After dinner, {name} spread the contract across the table. Dad reached rule two and his eyebrows shot up. "Even me?" "Everyone's equal," {name} said firmly. Mom laughed and signed. Little brother Bean, who was four and couldn't write, added a ketchup handprint. Dad let out a long sigh, like a balloon losing air, then signed too. The contract went up on the fridge. It was official.

On Monday, {name} agreed to twenty minutes. A kitten on the screen was just about to leap onto a bookshelf when the timer went beep-beep-beep. {name}'s finger froze. "But I want to know if it makes it!" "It's okay to feel disappointed," Mom said softly. "Take a breath first." {name} breathed deep, switched off the tablet, and challenged Bean to a frog-hopping race until they both collapsed giggling on the rug.

At Wednesday dinner, a little glow appeared under the table. {name} cleared {his} throat and pointed at the fridge. Dad looked like someone caught sneaking candy and tucked his phone into a drawer. "Yes, Captain!" That night, Dad told the story of a goose from his childhood that chased the mail carrier, and everyone laughed so hard they nearly sprayed rice. {name} noticed that {his} eyes felt fresh, as if they'd had a nap.

Friday arrived. {name} dragged out the dusty game box, ready to survive a long, dull evening. But Dad whispered secrets to the dice before every roll. Mom pretended her cards were terrible, then swept up three in one turn. Bean hid a game piece under his hat and said it was "hatching an egg." {name} laughed until {his} tummy ached, rolling on the sofa with a cushion and forgetting all about the clock.

"Nine o'clock. Time to brush teeth," Dad said. "Just one more game!" {name} blurted, then stopped, surprised. Last week those exact words had been for one more video. The whole family burst out laughing. Dad winked. "When time's up, we stop. It's in the contract." {name} nodded, picked up a pen, and added rule five at the bottom: Can board-game night happen twice a week?

questions: 計時器響了、影片還沒看完時，{name}心裡有什麼感覺？{name}後來做了什麼？
如果我們家也寫一份3C合約，你想為大人加上哪一條規則？
你覺得什麼活動能讓眼睛和腦袋休息？我們一起來挑一個。
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起寫一份簡單的家庭3C合約，全家都簽名貼在冰箱上；每次開始用螢幕前先說好時間並設定計時器。

questions: How did {name} feel when the timer rang before the video ended? What did {name} do next?
If our family wrote a screen contract, what rule would you add for the grown-ups?
What activities help your eyes and brain rest? Let's pick one to do together.
en.tip: This week, write a simple family screen contract together, have everyone sign it, and stick it on the fridge; before any screen time, agree on how long and set a timer.

zh: 新家的燈亮著，箱子堆得高高的。{name}跑進自己的新房間。房間好大，也好空。{name}小聲說：「哈囉？」牆壁也小聲回答：「哈囉……」爸爸笑著說：「那是回音。房間空空的，聲音會跑來跑去。」{name}抱緊{his}小枕頭，心裡有點怪怪的。
「爸爸，我喜歡新家的大窗戶。」{name}說。「可是，我也好想念舊房間。」爸爸蹲下來，抱抱{name}。「爸爸也是喔。開心和難過，可以一起住在心裡。」{name}點點頭，心裡輕了一點。這時，{he}看見一個小紙箱。紙箱上面，畫著好多星星。
{name}打開紙箱。哇，裡面是一顆顆螢光星星！那是舊房間天花板上的星星。搬家前，爸爸一顆一顆撕下來。他把星星小心收好，放進箱子。「它們跟著我們搬來了！」{name}高興地說。爸爸眨眨眼：「我們把它們貼上去，好不好？」
天花板好高好高。爸爸把{name}抱起來，讓{him}坐在肩膀上。爸爸的雙手，牢牢扶著{name}。{name}撕開星星背後的紙。可是，星星黏住了{his}手指。星星翻來翻去，就是貼不好。咚！第一顆星星掉到床上了。{name}嘟起嘴：「好難喔。」
「慢慢來，」爸爸說。「先撕開一個角，再輕輕按。」{name}深呼吸，再試一次。{he}撕開一個小角，把星星按上去。一、二、三，{name}慢慢數。星星乖乖待著，沒有掉下來！「我成功了！」{name}笑了。爸爸也笑了：「你沒有放棄喔！」
一顆、兩顆、三顆……{name}越貼越快。{name}還記得舊房間的樣子。「這七顆，要排成一支大湯匙。」「最亮的這顆，要在床的正上方。」爸爸驚訝地說：「你記得好清楚！」「你把舊房間放在心裡，一起帶來了呢。」
最後一顆星星貼好了。爸爸把{name}放下來，關掉大燈。天花板上，亮起一片綠綠的星光。跟以前，一模一樣。{name}躺到床上，抬頭看著。「晚安，星星。」「晚安……」回音輕輕回答。這次，回音一點也不怪了。好像房間也在說晚安。
窗外傳來小狗「汪汪」的叫聲。爸爸說：「那是隔壁鄰居的小狗。明天我們去打招呼。」「還可以去樓下公園，找新朋友嗎？」{name}問。「當然可以。」爸爸親親{name}，說聲晚安。{name}看著熟悉的星星，慢慢閉上眼睛。新房間，開始像家了。
en: The lights were on in the new apartment. Boxes stood in tall piles. {name} ran into the new bedroom. It was big and very empty. "Hello?" {name} whispered. "Hello..." the walls whispered back. "That's an echo," Dad said with a smile. "Sounds bounce around empty rooms." {name} hugged {his} little pillow tight. Everything felt a bit strange.

"Dad, I like the big new window," said {name}. "But I miss my old room too." Dad knelt down and gave {name} a hug. "Me too. Happy and sad can live in your heart together." {name} nodded and felt a little lighter. Then {he} spotted a small box with stars drawn all over it.

{name} opened the box. Inside were lots of glow stars! They came from the old bedroom ceiling. Before the move, Dad had peeled them off one by one. He had packed them carefully in the box. "They moved here with us!" {name} cheered. Dad winked. "Shall we put them up?"

The ceiling was very high. Dad lifted {name} onto his shoulders. His hands held on tight. {name} peeled the paper off a star. But the sticky side stuck to {his} fingers! The star flipped and twisted. Then, plop! It fell onto the bed. "This is hard," {name} said with a pout.

"Take your time," said Dad. "Peel one corner, then press gently." {name} took a deep breath and tried again. This time {he} peeled just a tiny corner. {name} pressed the star up and counted. One, two, three. The star stayed put! "I did it!" {name} laughed. "You kept trying!" said Dad.

One star, two stars, three stars... {name} got faster and faster. {name} remembered just how the old ceiling looked. "These seven make a big spoon." "The brightest one goes right above my bed." "You remember so well!" said Dad. "You carried your old room here in your heart."

At last, the final star was up. Dad set {name} down and switched off the light. The ceiling glowed with soft green stars, just like before. {name} lay in bed and looked up. "Goodnight, stars." "Goodnight..." the echo answered softly. This time, it did not sound strange at all. It was like the room was saying goodnight too.

Outside, a little dog went "Woof, woof!" "That's our neighbor's puppy," said Dad. "We can say hi tomorrow." "Can we find new friends at the park downstairs too?" asked {name}. "Of course." Dad kissed {name} goodnight. {name} gazed at the familiar stars and slowly closed {his} eyes. The new room was starting to feel like home.

questions: {name}第一晚在新房間，心裡有什麼感覺？你覺得開心和難過可以同時有嗎？
{name}和爸爸把什麼從舊家帶到新家？如果你搬家，最想帶哪一樣寶貝？
你覺得{name}明天會認識誰、去哪裡玩？怎樣讓新地方慢慢變成家？
zh.tip: 今晚睡前，和孩子一起選一樣「從小陪著我」的東西放在床邊，說說它的回憶。這週可以一起在家附近找一個新的「祕密小角落」或跟一位鄰居打招呼。

questions: How did {name} feel on the first night in the new room? Can we feel happy and sad at the same time?
What did {name} and Dad bring from the old home to the new one? If you moved, which treasure would you bring?
Who do you think {name} will meet tomorrow, and where will they go? How can a new place slowly become home?
en.tip: Tonight at bedtime, choose one special thing that has been with your child for a long time, put it by the bed, and share a memory about it. This week, find a new 'secret corner' near home together or say hello to a neighbor.

title.en: {name}'s First Day at the New School

zh: 搬到新城市的第一個早上，{name}背著書包，站在新學校的大門口。心裡好像住著兩隻小鳥，一隻興奮得想唱歌，另一隻卻垂著翅膀，想念以前的教室和好朋友阿哲。爸爸蹲下來輕聲說：「又期待又捨不得，兩種感覺都沒關係喔。」
老師把{name}介紹給全班同學。{name}拿出那個貼滿恐龍貼紙的鉛筆盒，那是阿哲送的禮物。摸著熟悉的貼紙，{name}的心跳慢慢穩了下來。可是下課鐘一響，大家都跑開了，{name}突然想上廁所，卻不知道廁所在哪裡。
{name}在走廊上左看右看，每一扇門都長得好像。這時，坐在隔壁的女孩小安走過來，笑著問：「你在找廁所嗎？我去年也剛搬來，第一天還走錯到老師辦公室呢！」她帶{name}轉過樓梯旁的角落，藍色的門就在那裡。
中午到了，餐廳裡熱熱鬧鬧，排隊的隊伍彎來彎去，像一條長長的龍。{name}站在門口，不知道該排在哪裡。小安揮揮手說：「跟我來！先拿餐盤，再排這一排。」她還小聲告訴{name}：「星期五有布丁，是大家最喜歡的日子喔。」
兩個人坐在窗邊吃飯。小安說，她剛搬來的時候，每天都想念以前的家。「後來我發現，我的家人、我最愛的故事書，還有那些回憶，都跟著我一起搬來了。」{name}想起口袋裡媽媽寫的小紙條，上面畫著一個笑臉，心裡暖暖的。
下午，小安帶{name}認識學校的小角落：開著小黃花的花圃、可以借書的圖書角，還有能看見整個操場的窗台。管理圖書的伯伯對{name}眨眨眼說：「歡迎新朋友，明天記得來借書喔！」{name}一個一個記在心裡，覺得學校好像沒那麼大了。
放學回家後，{name}拿出一張明信片，寫給阿哲：「今天我有點緊張，也有點難過，因為你不在。可是我認識了小安，她帶我找到廁所和午餐的隊伍，星期五還有布丁！我還在用你送的鉛筆盒喔。」最後，{name}畫了兩個手牽手的小人。
傍晚，媽媽陪{name}把明信片投進郵筒。晚霞把天空染成了橘色，新家的窗戶一扇扇亮起燈光。{name}牽著媽媽的手，輕輕說：「明天，我要問小安，星期五要不要一起坐著吃布丁。」新的地方，正一點一點變得像家一樣。
en: On the first morning in a new city, {name} stood at the gate of a brand-new school. It felt like two little birds were inside: one wanted to sing with excitement, and one drooped its wings, missing the old classroom and best friend Jay. Dad knelt down. "Excited and sad at the same time? Both feelings are okay."

The teacher introduced {name} to the class. {name} took out a pencil case covered in dinosaur stickers, a gift from Jay. Touching those familiar stickers made {his} heart slow down. But when the bell rang, everyone hurried off, and {name} suddenly needed the restroom and had no idea where it was.

{name} looked up and down the hallway. Every door looked the same! Then Annie, the girl from the next desk, walked over with a smile. "Looking for the restroom? I moved here last year, and on my first day I walked into the teachers' office by mistake!" She led {name} around the corner by the stairs to a blue door.

At lunchtime, the cafeteria was busy and noisy, and the line curled around like a long dragon. {name} stood by the door, not sure where to go. Annie waved. "Follow me! Grab a tray first, then wait in this line." She whispered, "On Fridays there's pudding. Everybody loves Fridays."

They ate together by the window. Annie said that when she first moved, she missed her old home every day. "Then I noticed my family, my favorite storybooks, and all my memories moved here with me." {name} remembered the little note from Mom in {his} pocket, with a smiley face on it, and felt warm inside.

That afternoon, Annie showed {name} the school's special corners: a flower bed full of little yellow flowers, a reading nook with shelves of books, and a window that looked over the whole playground. The librarian winked. "Welcome, new friend! Come borrow a book tomorrow." {name} remembered each place, and the school didn't seem so big anymore.

After school, {name} wrote a postcard to Jay: "Today I was a little nervous and a little sad because you weren't here. But I met Annie. She helped me find the restroom and the lunch line, and there's pudding on Fridays! I'm still using the pencil case you gave me." At the bottom, {name} drew two little friends holding hands.

That evening, Mom walked with {name} to drop the postcard into the mailbox. The sky glowed orange, and the windows of their new home lit up one by one. Holding Mom's hand, {name} said softly, "Tomorrow I'll ask Annie if she wants to sit with me for pudding on Friday." Little by little, the new place was starting to feel like home.

questions: {name}第一天到新學校時，心裡有哪兩種感覺？你有過又開心又難過的時候嗎？
搬家時，{name}和小安帶了哪些重要的東西或回憶一起來？如果是你，你會帶什麼？
小安怎麼幫助{name}？如果班上來了新同學，你可以怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起寫一張明信片或畫一張圖，寄給想念的朋友或親人，並一起在新環境裡找一個「我們最喜歡的新角落」。

questions: What two feelings did {name} have on the first day at the new school? Have you ever felt happy and sad at the same time?
What special things or memories came along with {name} and Annie when they moved? What would you bring?
How did Annie help {name}? What could you do if a new kid joined your class?
en.tip: This week, write a postcard or draw a picture together for a friend or relative you miss, and go find one "favorite new corner" in your neighborhood or school.

zh: 渡輪「嗚——」一聲鳴笛，緩緩駛離港口。{name}抱著那顆籃球坐在窗邊，球上密密麻麻全是老朋友的簽名。爸爸換了新工作，全家要搬到澎湖。想到海島，{name}心裡雀躍不已；想到再也不能放學後衝去轉角的球場，胸口又悶悶的。媽媽輕聲說：「我也是又期待又捨不得，兩種心情都可以一起帶上船。」
新家在馬公一條安靜的小巷裡，門一打開，風就呼嘯著灌進來，把紙箱上的膠帶吹得啪啪作響。{name}迫不及待在門口練投籃，瞄準牆上的粉筆圈，用力一投——球在半空中硬生生拐了個彎，咕嚕咕嚕滾到牆角。「這裡的風根本在跟我作對！」{name}氣呼呼地撿回球。爸爸笑著說：「說不定它只是想認識你。」
週末，爸爸牽著{name}的手，沿著步道來到海邊的玄武岩前。一根根黑色石柱整整齊齊排成一列，高聳挺拔，像巨人削好的鉛筆。爸爸說，這是很久以前岩漿冷卻後慢慢裂成的。{name}站在欄杆後看得目不轉睛：「好像一整排準備跳球的球員！」海浪拍打著石柱，彷彿在替他們加油。
回程時，媽媽帶{name}走進一家小冰店。老闆端出一碗紫紅色的仙人掌冰，鮮豔得像晚霞。{name}挖了一大口，酸酸甜甜，冰得打了個哆嗦。「拍給阿哲看！」照片一傳出去，老朋友馬上回覆：「看起來超好吃，下次我去找你！」{name}抱緊簽名球，覺得朋友們好像也跟著搬來了。
隔天，{name}又在門口追著被風吹跑的籃球。隔壁的阿海伯拿著一只藍色大風箏走出來，笑咪咪地說：「澎湖的風這麼慷慨，不拿來放風箏太可惜了。」他帶{name}到屋後的空地。可是風箏一離手就栽了個跟斗，第二次又一頭撞進草叢。{name}嘟起嘴，阿海伯卻不慌不忙：「背對著風，線一點一點放。」
{name}深吸一口氣，再試一次。這回，那陣老是搶走籃球的風一把托起風箏，把它送得又高又穩，藍色尾巴在天上甩來甩去。「它在幫我耶！」{name}驚喜地大叫。阿海伯哈哈大笑：「風沒變，是你學會跟它合作了。對了，廟後面有座球場，四周有矮牆擋風，我孫女小恬每天傍晚都在那裡投籃。」
傍晚，夕陽把海面染成一片金黃。回到屋裡，{name}在阿海伯送的小風箏上畫了一顆籃球，旁邊寫滿老朋友的名字。星期六，爸爸陪著{name}和小恬先放風箏，再到廟後的球場打球。投進第一球時，{name}拍照傳給阿哲：「我的新球場，風很大，可是我越來越喜歡這裡了。」
en: The ferry gave a long, low hoot and slid away from the harbor. {name} sat by the window hugging a basketball covered in scribbled signatures from old friends. Dad had a new job, and the whole family was moving to Penghu. An island! {name} felt fizzy with excitement, and also heavy inside, missing the corner court back home. Mom whispered, "I feel both ways too. We can bring both feelings along."

The new house sat on a quiet lane in Magong. The moment the door opened, wind came roaring in, slapping the tape on the moving boxes. {name} hurried outside to practice, aimed at a chalk circle on the wall, and shot. The ball swerved in midair and bounced into the corner. "This wind is against me!" {name} grumbled. Dad laughed. "Maybe it just wants to meet you."

On the weekend, Dad held {name}'s hand as they followed a path down to the basalt cliffs. Tall black columns stood shoulder to shoulder, like pencils sharpened by a giant. Dad explained that long ago, hot lava had cooled and slowly cracked into these shapes. Gazing from behind the railing, {name} said, "They look like a team lined up for tip-off!" Below, waves splashed like cheering fans.

On the way home, Mom led {name} into a tiny ice shop. The owner set down a bowl of cactus ice, bright purple-pink like a sunset. {name} took a huge spoonful. Sweet, tangy, and so cold it caused a shiver. "Let's send a picture to Ah-Zhe!" A reply popped up fast: "Looks amazing! I'll visit you!" Squeezing the signed ball, {name} felt as if old friends had moved here too.

The next day, {name} was chasing the runaway ball again when Uncle Hai from next door stepped out holding a big blue kite. "Penghu's wind is so generous," he said with a grin. "It would be a shame to waste it." He took {name} to the open field behind the houses. The kite flipped and flopped, then nosedived into the grass. Uncle Hai stayed calm. "Back to the wind. Let the string out slowly."

{name} took a deep breath and tried again. This time, the very wind that kept stealing the basketball scooped up the kite and carried it high and steady, its blue tail swishing. "It's helping me!" {name} shouted. Uncle Hai chuckled. "The wind didn't change. You learned to team up with it. By the way, there's a court behind the temple with low walls to block the wind. My granddaughter Xiao-Tian shoots hoops there every evening."

As the sunset turned the sea gold, {name} went inside and drew a basketball on the little kite Uncle Hai had given, then wrote every old friend's name around it. On Saturday, with Dad watching, {name} and Xiao-Tian flew kites first, then played ball behind the temple. After sinking the first shot, {name} texted Ah-Zhe a photo: "My new court. Super windy, but I'm starting to love it here."

questions: {name}在渡輪上同時覺得興奮又難過，你有沒有過兩種心情一起出現的時候？
{name}把哪些東西和回憶帶到了澎湖？如果你要搬家，你最想帶走什麼？
一開始{name}覺得風在作對，後來發生了什麼事，讓新地方慢慢變得像家？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起在家附近找一個「新角落」（一家小店、一座公園或一位鄰居），拍張照片寄給遠方的親友，分享你們的新發現。

questions: On the ferry, {name} felt excited and sad at the same time. Have you ever felt two feelings at once?
What things and memories did {name} bring to Penghu? If you moved, what would you most want to take with you?
At first {name} thought the wind was against {him}. What happened that helped the new place start to feel like home?
en.tip: This week, explore one "new corner" near home together (a little shop, a park, or a neighbor), then take a photo and send it to a faraway friend or relative to share what you found.

zh: 搬家前一個星期，{name}攤開一張大大的白紙，畫下住了好多年的老街：轉角的早餐店，林阿姨的蛋餅總是煎得金黃酥脆；巷口的小廟，香爐旁有棵枝繁葉茂的老榕樹；還有那隻橘貓，天天霸占同一台機車座墊，睡得四腳朝天。{name}一筆一畫，連早餐店門口那塊缺角的磚都沒漏掉。
搬家那天，紙箱堆得像小山。{name}把地圖捲好塞進背包，心裡怪怪的，好像同時裝著汽水的泡泡和一顆沉甸甸的石頭。「新家有電梯耶！」{name}說完，又小聲補一句：「可是橘貓會忘記我嗎？」媽媽蹲下來抱住{name}：「我也是，又期待又捨不得。兩種心情一起來，很正常喔。」
新家的房間空蕩蕩的，說話都有回音。爸爸把老地圖貼在牆上，媽媽擺好全家的合照，連{name}那顆有點扁的枕頭也乖乖躺在床頭。隔天早上，餐桌上竟然是熱騰騰的蛋餅！「林阿姨把祕訣傳授給我了。」爸爸得意地眨眨眼，結果其中一張蛋餅破了個大洞，全家笑得東倒西歪。
吃完早餐，{name}拿出一張新白紙，在正中央畫了一個小方格：新家。四周卻是一片空白，白得讓人心慌。「一格一格慢慢來就好。」爸爸說。於是父子倆……不，是爸爸和{name}每天傍晚一起出門散步，把看到的東西記下來：會唱歌的垃圾車、門口擺滿盆栽的麵包店，還有一座溜滑梯長得驚人的小公園。
不過，有些格子很難填。麵包店的老闆叫什麼名字？公園裡那個總是自己踢球的男孩住在哪裡？{name}不好意思開口，筆尖在紙上猶豫了好久。直到有一天，那顆球骨碌碌滾到{his}腳邊。{name}深吸一口氣，把球踢回去，大聲說：「你要不要一起畫地圖？」
男孩叫浩然，一聽就眼睛發亮。他帶{name}認識麵包店的陳伯伯，原來陳伯伯每天早上都會留麵包邊給鴿子；又指給{name}看雜貨店門口那隻灰貓，牠也天天霸占一台機車座墊，睡姿和老街的橘貓如出一轍。{name}笑得合不攏嘴，趕緊把灰貓畫上去。
幾個星期後，新地圖密密麻麻，格子多到快擠出紙邊。{name}把它貼在老地圖旁邊，一左一右，像兩扇窗。這時浩然跑來敲門，手裡也拿著一張地圖。{name}低頭一看，上面有一個小方格，寫著工工整整的四個字：好朋友家。旁邊畫的，正是{name}住的這棟樓。
en: The week before the move, {name} spread a big sheet of paper on the floor and drew the old street, block by block. There was the corner breakfast shop, where Auntie Lin flipped egg crepes until they were golden and crisp. There was the little temple with its sprawling banyan tree. And there was the orange cat who claimed the same scooter seat every day, snoozing with all four paws in the air.

On moving day, boxes towered like mountains. As {name} rolled up the map and tucked it into a backpack, a strange feeling fizzed inside, like soda bubbles and a heavy stone at the same time. "The new building has an elevator!" {name} said. Then, more quietly: "Will the orange cat forget me?" Mom knelt down for a hug. "I feel excited and sad too. It's okay to feel both at once."

The new bedroom was so empty that voices echoed. Dad taped the old map to the wall, Mom set out the family photo, and {name}'s slightly squashed pillow settled in at the head of the bed. The next morning, egg crepes steamed on the table! "Auntie Lin shared her secret," Dad said with a wink. One crepe had a giant hole in the middle, and everyone laughed until their sides ached.

After breakfast, {name} took out a fresh sheet of paper and drew one small square in the center: New Home. Everything around it was blank, so blank it made {his} stomach flutter. "One square at a time," Dad said. So every evening they went walking together, and {name} jotted down what they found: a garbage truck that played music, a bakery crowded with potted plants, and a park with an astonishingly long slide.

Some squares were harder. What was the baker's name? Where did the boy who always kicked a ball by himself live? {name} felt too shy to ask, and the pencil hovered over the paper for a long time. Then one day the ball came rolling right up to {his} feet. {name} took a deep breath, kicked it back, and called out, "Want to help me make a map?"

The boy's name was Haoran, and his whole face lit up. He introduced {name} to Mr. Chen at the bakery, who saved bread crusts for the pigeons every morning. Then he pointed out a gray cat outside the corner store. It hogged a scooter seat too, sprawled out exactly like the orange cat back on the old street. {name} grinned from ear to ear and quickly drew it in.

A few weeks later, the new map was so crowded with squares they nearly spilled off the edges. {name} taped it beside the old map, one on the left and one on the right, like two windows. Just then, Haoran knocked at the door, holding a map of his own. On it was a small square, neatly labeled Best Friend's House, and beside it was a drawing of {name}'s building.

questions: 搬家那天，{name}心裡同時有哪兩種感覺？你有沒有過又開心又難過的時候？
{name}的新家裡，有哪些東西是從老家一起帶來的？如果是你，會想帶什麼？
{name}做了什麼，讓新地圖越來越滿？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子一起散步，畫一張「我們家附近」的小地圖，每次發現新店家或認識新鄰居就加上一格。

questions: On moving day, what two feelings did {name} have at the same time? Have you ever felt happy and sad at once?
What things from the old home came along to the new one? What would you want to bring?
What did {name} do to fill up the new map?
en.tip: This week, take a walk together and start a little map of your own neighborhood, adding a square each time you discover a new shop or meet a new neighbor.

zh: 晴天，公園裡暖暖的。{name}和媽媽來到沙坑。{name}拿著小桶子，媽媽拿著小鏟子。挖挖挖，沙沙沙。「我要做沙子蛋糕！」{name}說。
裝滿沙，拍一拍。倒過來，敲一敲。哇！一個圓圓的蛋糕。{name}插上小樹枝，當作蠟燭。媽媽放上一朵小黃花。「好漂亮的蛋糕！」媽媽笑著說。
咚、咚、咚！一顆紅皮球滾過來。滾呀滾，滾呀滾。噗！皮球壓到蛋糕上。蛋糕扁扁的，蠟燭倒了，小黃花也歪了。
{name}的臉熱熱的。{his}小手握得緊緊的。{name}好想踢沙子。好大的生氣，在肚子裡跳呀跳。媽媽蹲下來，輕輕說：「你很生氣，對不對？」
「我們一起當蝸牛吧。」媽媽說。蝸牛慢慢的，慢慢的。吸氣，好慢好慢。吐氣，好慢好慢。{name}和媽媽一起數：「一、二、三。」
再來一次。吸——吐——。「四、五、六。」肚子裡的生氣，慢慢變小了。變小了，再變小了。{name}的小手，也慢慢鬆開了。
{name}大聲說：「我好生氣！因為我的蛋糕扁了。」媽媽點點頭：「謝謝你告訴我。你想要什麼呢？」「我想和媽媽一起，再做一個！」
媽媽把紅皮球放到旁邊。裝滿沙，拍一拍。倒過來，敲一敲。新蛋糕圓圓的，比剛才還要大！{name}插上蠟燭，媽媽放上小黃花。「生日快樂，沙子蛋糕！」{name}和媽媽一起笑了。
en: It is a sunny day at the park. {name} and Mom go to the sandbox. {name} holds a little bucket. Mom holds a little spade. Dig, dig, dig! "I will make a sand cake!" says {name}.
Fill it up. Pat, pat, pat. Turn it over. Tap, tap, tap. Wow! A round sand cake! {name} adds a twig candle. Mom adds a little yellow flower. "What a pretty cake!" Mom smiles.
Bump, bump, bump! A red ball rolls over. Roll, roll, roll. Squish! It lands on the cake. The cake is flat. The candle falls down. The yellow flower tips over.
{name}'s face feels hot. {his} hands squeeze tight. {name} wants to kick the sand. A big mad jumps inside. Mom kneels down. "You feel mad, don't you?" she says softly.
"Let's be snails together," says Mom. Snails go slow, slow, slow. Breathe in, so slow. Breathe out, so slow. {name} and Mom count together. "One, two, three."
Again! In... and out... "Four, five, six." The big mad gets smaller. It gets smaller and smaller. {name}'s tight hands open up, little by little.
"I'm mad!" says {name}. "I'm mad because my cake got squished!" Mom nods. "Thank you for telling me. What do you want?" "Let's make a new one together!"

Mom sets the red ball aside. Fill it up. Pat, pat, pat. Turn it over. Tap, tap, tap. The new cake is even bigger! Twig candle, yellow flower. "Happy birthday, sand cake!" {name} and Mom laugh together.

questions: 蛋糕被壓扁的時候，{name}覺得怎麼樣？{he}和媽媽做了什麼？
你生氣的時候，身體會有什麼感覺？
下次你生氣了，可以怎麼說出來呢？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子一起練習「蝸牛呼吸」：慢慢吸氣、慢慢吐氣，一起數到三。再練習說一句：「我生氣，因為……」

questions: How did {name} feel when the cake got squished? What did {he} and Mom do?
How does your body feel when you get mad?
Next time you feel mad, what words can you use?
en.tip: This week, practice "snail breathing" together: breathe in slowly, breathe out slowly, and count to three. Then practice saying, "I'm mad because..."

zh: 嘩啦啦，嘩啦啦。浴缸裡好多泡泡。{name}在洗澡，爸爸坐在浴缸旁邊陪著。小黃杯舀水，倒水。嘩啦啦，真好玩！小鴨子漂過來，搖呀搖。泡泡飛起來，啵啵啵。{name}笑得好開心。
爸爸站起來。「時間到囉，要起來了。」{name}搖搖頭。「不要！不要！」爸爸拿起大毛巾。「水快涼了喔。」{name}抱緊小黃杯。「不要！不要！」
心裡熱熱的，鼓鼓的。像一座小火山。{name}好生氣！{name}舉起小黃杯。好想丟出去！杯子在手裡晃呀晃。爸爸輕輕握住{his}小手。
「你可以生氣。」爸爸說。「可是杯子不丟喔。」爸爸把小黃杯放好。大毛巾包住{name}。爸爸抱{him}到軟軟的地墊上。「來，像恐龍一樣跺腳！」
咚！咚！咚！{name}用力跺腳。像一隻大恐龍。吼——吼——！爸爸也跺腳。咚！咚！咚！兩隻恐龍在浴室裡。咚！咚！咚！吼——吼——！
「恐龍要大口吸氣喔。」爸爸說。吸——吐——，一。吸——吐——，二。吸——吐——，三。慢慢的，慢慢的。心裡的小火山，變小了。
{name}抬起頭。「我生氣！」「我還要洗澡！」爸爸點點頭。「你說出來了，真棒。」「你好愛洗澡，對不對？」「明天再玩泡泡，好嗎？」
{name}想一想。「好！小黃杯也要！」爸爸笑了。「小黃杯也一起。」大毛巾抱住{name}。軟軟的，暖暖的。小恐龍說：「吼~抱抱！」
en: Splish, splash! Splish, splash! So many bubbles in the tub. {name} is having a bath, and Dad sits right beside the tub. Scoop with the yellow cup. Pour, pour, pour. The little duck bobs by. Pop, pop go the bubbles!
Dad stands up. "Bath time is over now." {name} shakes {his} head. "No! No!" Dad holds up the big towel. "The water is getting cold." {name} hugs the yellow cup. "No! No!"
Hot and puffy inside. Like a little volcano. {name} feels so angry! Up goes the yellow cup. {name} wants to throw it! The cup wobbles, wobble, wobble. Dad gently holds {his} hand.
"It's okay to be angry," Dad says. "But cups are not for throwing." Dad sets the cup down. He wraps {name} in the towel. Onto the soft mat! "Let's stomp like a dinosaur!"
Stomp! Stomp! Stomp! {name} stomps hard. Just like a big dinosaur. Roar! Roar! Dad stomps too. Stomp! Stomp! Stomp! Two dinosaurs in the bathroom. Roar! Roar!
"Dinosaurs take big breaths," says Dad. Breathe in, breathe out. One. Breathe in, breathe out. Two. Breathe in, breathe out. Three. Slow and slow. The little volcano grows small.
{name} looks up. "I'm angry!" "I want more bath!" Dad nods. "You said it with words. Well done." "You love bath time, don't you?" "More bubbles tomorrow, okay?"
{name} thinks and thinks. "Okay! With the yellow cup!" Dad smiles. "Yes, the yellow cup too." The big towel hugs {name}. Soft and warm. The little dinosaur says, "Roar! Hug, please!"

questions: {name}很生氣的時候，想把杯子怎麼樣？後來爸爸請{him}做什麼？
恐龍吸了幾口大氣？我們一起數數看，好嗎？
你生氣的時候，可以怎麼說出來？「我生氣，因為……」
zh.tip: 這週洗澡或收玩具時，和孩子一起玩「恐龍跺腳」：跺三下、吸三口大氣，再說「我生氣，因為……」。先在不生氣的時候練習，真的生氣時就更容易用上。

questions: When {name} felt very angry, what did {he} want to do with the cup? What did Dad suggest instead?
How many big breaths did the dinosaur take? Can we count them together?
When you feel angry, how can you say it with words? "I'm angry because..."
en.tip: This week, at bath time or clean-up time, play "Dinosaur Stomp" together: stomp three times, take three big breaths, then say "I'm angry because...". Practice when everyone is calm so it is easier to use when anger feels big.

zh: 今天，幼兒園要做紙皇冠。{name}選了一張金黃色的紙。小剪刀咔嚓咔嚓，剪出五個尖尖的角。{name}再貼上亮晶晶的星星，一顆、兩顆、三顆。最後，把紙捲成一個圓圈。哇，皇冠做好了！{name}輕輕戴上，覺得好神氣。
「好漂亮喔！」小美拍拍手說。{name}笑咪咪地在教室走一圈。皇冠上的星星一閃一閃。樂樂坐在旁邊，眼睛一直看著皇冠。他的皇冠還沒做完，紙皺皺的。樂樂好想摸摸那顆最大的星星。
突然，樂樂伸出手，一把抓住皇冠。「給我戴戴看！」{name}嚇了一跳，趕快拉住另一邊。兩個人一拉，嘶——的一聲。皇冠裂成兩半了！一顆星星掉到地上。教室裡一下子變得好安靜。
{name}的胸口熱熱的，像燒開的水壺。{his}小手握得緊緊的，好想用力推樂樂。可是，{name}停住了。{he}想起林老師說過的話：「生氣的時候，先停下來，慢慢吸氣。」{name}站著不動，雙腳穩穩踩在地上。
{name}閉上眼睛，慢慢吸一口氣，像在聞一朵花。再慢慢吐氣，像在吹生日蠟燭。「一。」又吸一口氣。「二。」胸口的熱熱慢慢變小了。「三、四。」緊緊的拳頭鬆開了。「五。」{name}張開眼睛，心跳也變慢了。
{name}看著樂樂，用清楚的聲音說：「我很生氣，因為你把我的皇冠弄破了。」接著又說：「你想戴，要先問我。」樂樂低下頭，小聲說：「對不起，我只是好想試試看。」他撿起地上的星星，輕輕放到{name}手上。
林老師走過來，手裡拿著一捲膠帶。「我們一起來修修看，好嗎？」樂樂幫忙捏住兩半皇冠。{name}撕下一小段膠帶，仔細貼好。一段、兩段、三段。最後，{name}把那顆星星貼在膠帶上面。裂開的地方不見了！
{name}又戴上皇冠，星星還是亮晶晶的。樂樂問：「我可以戴一下嗎？」{name}點點頭，把皇冠輕輕遞給他。樂樂戴上，開心得轉圈圈。林老師笑著說：「你們兩個都好棒。」{name}也笑了，心裡暖暖的，像曬到太陽一樣。
en: Today the kindergarten class is making paper crowns. {name} picks a shiny gold sheet. Snip, snip go the little scissors. Five pointy tips appear. Next come sparkly star stickers. {name} rolls the paper into a circle. The crown is done! {name} puts it on and feels so grand.

"It's so pretty!" says Mia, clapping. {name} smiles and walks around the room. The stars twinkle in the light. Lele sits close by, staring at the crown. His own crown isn't finished yet. Lele really wants to touch the biggest star.
Suddenly, Lele grabs the crown. "Let me try it!" {name} holds on to the other side. They both pull. Rrrip! The crown tears in two. One star falls to the floor. The whole room goes very quiet.

Inside, {name} feels hot, like a boiling kettle. {his} hands squeeze into tight fists. They want to push Lele hard. But {name} stops. Ms. Lin's words float back: "When you feel angry, stop and breathe slowly." {name} stands still, feet firm on the floor.

{name} shuts both eyes. Breathe in slowly, like smelling a flower. Breathe out slowly, like blowing out birthday candles. "One." Another breath. "Two." The hot feeling gets smaller. "Three. Four." The tight fists open up. "Five." {name} looks up, feeling calm.

{name} looks at Lele and speaks clearly. "I'm angry because you ripped my crown." {name} adds, "Please ask me first next time." Lele looks down. "I'm sorry," he says softly. "I just really wanted to try." He picks up the star and gives it back.

Ms. Lin comes over with a roll of tape. "Shall we fix it together?" Lele holds the two halves still. {name} tears off a little strip and presses it on. One strip, two strips, three. Then the star goes right on top. The rip is gone!

{name} puts the crown back on. The stars still sparkle. "May I try it, please?" asks Lele. {name} nods and gently hands it over. Lele spins around with a big grin. "You both did great," says Ms. Lin. {name} smiles too, warm inside like sunshine.

questions: 皇冠破掉的時候，{name}的小手想做什麼？後來{he}做了什麼？
{name}用什麼話告訴樂樂自己的感覺？
你生氣的時候，身體會有什麼感覺？可以怎麼讓自己慢下來？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起練習「聞花、吹蠟燭」的慢慢呼吸，數到五；再輪流用「我很生氣，因為……」說一件小事。

questions: When the crown ripped, what did {name}'s hands want to do? What did {he} do instead?
What words did {name} use to tell Lele how {he} felt?
How does your body feel when you get angry? What could help you slow down?
en.tip: Tonight, practice 'smell the flower, blow out the candle' breaths together while counting to five. Then take turns saying one small thing using 'I'm angry because…'.

zh: 整整一個星期，{name}每天放學都坐在書桌前，小心翼翼地黏一艘木頭帆船。船身、船舵、小小的船帆，一片一片慢慢拼起來。星期五晚上，最後一面帆終於綁上桅杆，{name}把帆船放在客廳的矮櫃上，開心得看了又看。
第二天早上，弟弟小樂抱著玩具球，在客廳跑來跑去。「小樂，不要在這裡丟球！」{name}才剛說完，球就砰的一聲撞上矮櫃。帆船晃了晃，摔到地板上，桅杆啪地斷成兩截，白色的帆也皺成一團。
{name}覺得全身熱烘烘的，心臟咚咚咚跳得好快。{he}握緊拳頭，好想把那顆球用力丟出去。可是{name}看見小樂縮在沙發旁，眼睛紅紅的，好像快哭了。{name}咬著嘴唇，轉身走回自己的房間，輕輕關上門。
房間裡，{name}抱著枕頭坐在床上，胸口好像有一座小火山在咕嚕咕嚕冒泡。{he}想起媽媽說過：「生氣的時候，先停下來，慢慢吸氣。」{name}閉上眼睛，深深吸一口氣，再慢慢吐出來，一邊在心裡數：一、二、三、四、五……
數到十的時候，心跳慢了一點。再數一次，緊緊的拳頭也鬆開了。{name}還是很難過，可是心裡那座小火山已經不再噴火。這時，門外傳來輕輕的敲門聲。「{name}，我可以進來嗎？」是媽媽溫柔的聲音。
媽媽坐到床邊，安靜地等著。{name}吸了一口氣說：「我很生氣，因為我花了一整個星期做帆船，小樂一下子就把它弄壞了。」說著說著，眼淚掉了下來。「我希望大家小心我的東西。」媽媽抱住{name}：「謝謝你用說的告訴我，我們一起想辦法。」
回到客廳，小樂捧著斷掉的桅杆走過來，小聲說：「對不起，我不是故意的。」{name}看著弟弟，想了一下才說：「我剛才真的很生氣。以後球要在遊戲墊上滾，好不好？」小樂用力點點頭，把桅杆交給{name}。
下午，媽媽和{name}一起用白膠把桅杆黏好，再用細繩一圈一圈綁緊。{name}把皺皺的帆一點一點撫平，小樂在旁邊幫忙遞繩子。帆船重新挺起來了，媽媽把它放到高高的書架上。{name}看著它，嘴角慢慢翹了起來。
en: For a whole week, {name} sat at the desk after school, carefully gluing together a wooden sailing ship. The hull, the rudder, the tiny sails all went on, piece by piece. On Friday night, the last sail was tied to the mast, and {name} set the ship on the living room cabinet, smiling at it again and again.

The next morning, little brother Leo ran around the living room with his toy ball. "Leo, don't throw that in here!" {name} said. Too late. Bang! The ball hit the cabinet. The ship wobbled and crashed to the floor. The mast snapped in two, and the white sail crumpled.

{name} felt hot all over, and {his} heart thumped fast. {name} squeezed both fists tight and wanted to throw that ball as hard as possible. But then {name} saw Leo hiding by the sofa, eyes red, about to cry. Biting down on a lip, {name} walked to the bedroom and gently shut the door.

In the bedroom, {name} sat on the bed hugging a pillow. It felt like a little volcano was bubbling inside. {name} remembered what Mom always said: "When you feel angry, stop and breathe slowly." Eyes closed, {name} took a deep breath in, let it out slowly, and counted: one, two, three, four, five...

By ten, {his} heart had slowed a little. After counting once more, the tight fists opened up. {name} still felt sad, but the little volcano wasn't erupting anymore. Then came a soft knock at the door. "{name}, may I come in?" It was Mom's gentle voice.

Mom sat on the bed and waited quietly. {name} took a breath. "I'm angry because I worked on my ship all week, and Leo broke it in one second." Tears spilled out. "I need everyone to be careful with my things." Mom gave {name} a hug. "Thank you for telling me with words. Let's figure this out together."

Back in the living room, Leo came over holding the broken mast. "Sorry," he whispered. "I didn't mean to." {name} looked at him and thought for a moment. "I was really angry. From now on, can the ball just roll on your play mat?" Leo nodded hard and handed the mast to {name}.

That afternoon, Mom and {name} glued the mast back together and wrapped it tight with thin string, round and round. {name} smoothed the wrinkled sail bit by bit while Leo passed over the string. The ship stood tall again, and Mom placed it on a high shelf. Looking up at it, {name} slowly began to smile.

questions: 帆船摔壞的時候，{name}心裡有什麼感覺？{he}做了什麼讓自己平靜下來？
{name}是怎麼告訴媽媽自己為什麼生氣的？
如果你很生氣，你可以怎麼說出你的感覺和需要？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起練習「火山呼吸」：慢慢吸氣、慢慢吐氣，一起數到十；再輪流用「我生氣，因為……」說一件小事。

questions: How did {name} feel when the ship broke? What did {he} do to calm down?
How did {name} tell Mom why {he} was angry?
If you felt really angry, how could you say what you feel and what you need?
en.tip: Tonight, practice "volcano breathing" together: breathe in slowly, breathe out slowly, and count to ten. Then take turns finishing the sentence "I'm angry because…" about something small.

title.en: {name} Gets Angry on the Basketball Court

zh: 星期五的體育課，三年二班要在操場旁的籃球場比賽。{name}和小美、阿凱分在藍隊，大家興奮得跳來跳去。今天的裁判是班長阿哲，他脖子上掛著一個銀色哨子，站在場邊，看起來很神氣。
比賽開始了！球在場上咚咚咚地彈著。{name}一路運球，閃過一位紅隊同學，眼看就要跑到籃框下。就在{he}跳起來投籃的那一刻，紅隊的大偉也伸手來搶，兩個人的手碰了一下。「嗶——！」阿哲吹響哨子：「{name}犯規！」
「什麼？我又沒有推他！」{name}覺得胸口一下子熱了起來，心跳得好快。{his}雙手緊緊抓著籃球，好想用力把它往地上一摔。王老師走過來，蹲下來輕聲說：「{name}，先到旁邊的長椅休息一下，好嗎？」
{name}坐在長椅上，雙手握成拳頭。生氣的感覺像一顆越吹越大的氣球，在肚子裡鼓得滿滿的。{he}想起王老師教過的方法：慢慢吸一口氣，再慢慢吐出來。一、二、三……{name}一邊數，一邊看著天上的白雲飄過去。
數到十的時候，那顆氣球好像漏了一點氣。{name}又深呼吸了一次，拳頭慢慢鬆開了。這時候，大偉跑過來坐在旁邊，小聲說：「剛才我也伸手了，好像不全是你的錯。」{name}點點頭，覺得心裡輕鬆了一些。
休息時間到了，{name}走到阿哲面前，聲音不大，但很清楚：「我很生氣，因為我覺得剛剛不算犯規。我們兩個人都在搶球，手只是碰到而已。」阿哲抓抓頭說：「可是從我站的地方看，好像是你的手打到大偉了。」
王老師請大家圍成一圈：「看來我們對犯規的想法不太一樣。要不要一起訂清楚一點的規則？」同學們你一言我一語：用力推人、拉衣服才算犯規；兩個人同時搶到球，就猜拳決定誰發球。阿哲把新規則寫在小白板上，大家都舉手同意。
比賽重新開始，{name}和大偉用猜拳決定發球，結果是{name}贏了。這一次，{he}穩穩地投出一球，籃球在籃框上轉了一圈，「唰」地掉進網子裡。藍隊和紅隊一起拍手，{name}笑著和大偉用力擊了一下掌。
en: On Friday, Class 3B had a basketball game on the court next to the playground. {name} was on the blue team with Amy and Kai, and everyone was bouncing with excitement. The referee was Jay, the class leader, who stood proudly at the side with a shiny silver whistle around his neck.

The game began, and the ball went thump, thump, thump across the court. {name} dribbled past a red team player and raced toward the hoop. Just as {he} jumped to shoot, David from the red team reached for the ball too, and their hands bumped. "Tweet!" Jay blew his whistle. "Foul on {name}!"

"What? I didn't push him!" {name} felt hot inside, and {his} heart thumped fast. Squeezing the ball tight, {name} wanted to slam it hard onto the ground. Ms. Wang, their teacher, walked over and knelt down. "{name}, how about taking a little rest on the bench first?" she asked softly.

On the bench, {name} sat with tight fists. The angry feeling was like a balloon growing bigger and bigger inside. Then {name} remembered what Ms. Wang had taught the class: breathe in slowly, then breathe out slowly. One, two, three... {name} counted while watching the white clouds drift by.

By the time {name} reached ten, the balloon seemed to have lost a little air. One more deep breath, and the tight fists slowly opened. Just then, David came over and sat down. "I reached for the ball too," he said quietly. "Maybe it wasn't all your fault." {name} nodded and felt a bit lighter.

When the break ended, {name} walked up to Jay and spoke in a voice that was calm and clear. "I'm angry because I don't think that was a foul. We were both going for the ball, and our hands just bumped." Jay scratched his head. "But from where I was standing, it looked like you hit David."

Ms. Wang gathered everyone in a circle. "It sounds like we have different ideas about what a foul is. Shall we make clearer rules together?" Everyone shared ideas. Hard pushing or pulling shirts would count as a foul. If two players grabbed the ball at once, they would play rock-paper-scissors to decide who threw it in. Jay wrote the new rules on a little whiteboard, and everyone raised their hands to agree.

The game started again. {name} and David played rock-paper-scissors, and {name} won. This time, {he} took a steady shot. The ball rolled once around the rim and dropped through the net with a swish! Both teams clapped, and {name} gave David a big, happy high five.

questions: {name}很生氣、好想把球摔到地上的時候，{he}做了什麼讓自己慢慢平靜下來？
{name}是怎麼用說的，讓阿哲知道自己的感覺？你可以試著說說看「我很生氣，因為……」嗎？
如果你在玩遊戲時覺得不公平，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子一起練習「氣球呼吸」：雙手當成氣球，吸氣時慢慢張開，吐氣時慢慢合起來，一邊數到十。等孩子平靜後，請孩子用「我很生氣，因為……」說出自己的感覺。

questions: When {name} felt so angry and wanted to slam the ball, what did {he} do to calm down?
How did {name} use words to tell Jay about those feelings? Can you try saying, "I'm angry because..."?
What would you do if a game felt unfair to you?
en.tip: This week, practice "balloon breathing" together: open your hands like a balloon as you breathe in, close them as you breathe out, and count to ten. Once your child feels calm, invite them to share their feelings with "I'm angry because..."

title.en: {name} Gets a Turn at the Zoo

zh: 今天天氣好晴朗。全家一起去動物園。有爸爸、媽媽、{name}，還有小寶寶。寶寶坐在推車裡。推車咕嚕咕嚕，往前走。{name}跳呀跳，好開心！
媽媽低頭看寶寶：「寶寶醒了嗎？」爸爸低頭看寶寶：「寶寶笑了耶！」猴子吱吱吱，好像也在看。大家都看寶寶。{name}站在旁邊，小嘴扁扁的。
{name}拉拉爸爸的手。「爸爸，我也想要輪到我。」爸爸蹲下來，抱抱{name}。「謝謝你告訴我。」「你覺得被忘記了，對不對？」{name}點點頭。
爸爸笑著說：「爸爸的愛好大好大。」「寶寶有好多，你也有好多。」「一點都不會變少喔。」「你想當推車小幫手嗎？」{name}用力點頭：「想！」
{name}把{his}小手放在推車上。爸爸的大手也在旁邊。推呀推，咕嚕咕嚕。慢慢走，穩穩走。寶寶在車裡晃呀晃。「我是推車小幫手！」
樹上有小鳥，啾啾啾。「寶寶你看，小鳥！」草地上有鴨子，呱呱呱。「寶寶你看，鴨子！」寶寶揮揮小手，咯咯笑。{name}也咯咯笑。
來到長頸鹿家了。爸爸拿出一片葉子。「這是特別留給你的。」爸爸把{name}抱高高。長頸鹿低下頭，舌頭一捲。葉子不見了！{name}哈哈笑：「好癢喔！」
太陽慢慢下山了。全家要回家囉。{name}和爸爸，一起推推車。媽媽抱抱寶寶，也抱抱{name}。{name}笑著說：「我的心，好滿好滿。」
en: The sun is warm and bright. The whole family goes to the zoo. Dad, Mom, {name}, and the new baby. The baby rides in the stroller. Roll, roll, roll! {name} hops along, so happy.
Mom peeks in. "Is the baby awake?" Dad peeks in. "The baby is smiling!" The monkeys chatter, ooh-ooh-ah-ah. Everyone looks at the baby. {name} stands to the side, lips in a pout.
{name} tugs Dad's hand. "Dad, I want a turn too." Dad kneels down. He gives {name} a big hug. "Thank you for telling me. Do you feel left out?" {name} nods.
Dad smiles. "My love is big, so big. There's lots for the baby. There's lots for you. It never gets smaller. Want to be my stroller helper?" "Yes!" says {name}.
{name} puts {his} hands on the stroller. Dad's big hands stay close by. Push, push. Roll, roll. Slow and steady. The baby rocks gently. "I'm the stroller helper!"
A little bird sings, tweet, tweet. "Look, baby, a bird!" A duck waddles by, quack, quack. "Look, baby, a duck!" The baby waves and giggles. {name} giggles too.
Here are the giraffes! Dad holds out a leaf. "This is just for you." Dad lifts {name} up high. The giraffe bends down. Its long tongue curls. The leaf is gone! "It tickles!" laughs {name}.
The sun sinks low. Time to go home. {name} and Dad push the stroller together. Mom hugs the baby. Then Mom hugs {name}. "My heart is so full," says {name}.

questions: {name}覺得大家都在看寶寶時，{he}做了什麼？
如果你也想要爸爸媽媽陪你，你會怎麼說？
當大哥哥大姊姊，你最想幫忙做什麼工作？
zh.tip: 這週每天留五分鐘「只屬於你的時間」給大孩子，讓孩子選一件想一起做的小事；也可以練習一句話：「我也想要輪到我。」

questions: What did {name} do when everyone was looking at the baby?
If you want Mom or Dad to spend time with you, what could you say?
What special job would you like to do as a big helper?
en.tip: This week, give your older child five minutes a day of "just-you time" and let them pick a small activity. Practice the phrase together: "I want a turn too."

zh: 家裡來了一個小寶寶，名字叫小豆。小豆是{name}的弟弟。小豆好小好小，哭聲卻好大。「哇——哇——」早上哭，中午哭，晚上也哭。整個家都被哭聲塞滿了。{name}摀住耳朵，皺起眉頭。
媽媽抱著小豆，輕輕搖呀搖。{name}拿著圖畫書走過去。「媽媽，陪我看書好嗎？」媽媽小聲說：「等一下喔，小豆還在哭。」{name}等了又等。書本放在腿上，一頁也沒有翻。
吃點心的時候，媽媽在換尿布。玩積木的時候，媽媽在餵奶。{name}的積木高塔倒了，沒有人看見。{name}嘟起嘴巴，心裡悶悶的，像一朵灰灰的雲。{he}把臉埋進軟軟的抱枕裡。
晚飯前，媽媽坐到{name}旁邊。「寶貝，你好像不開心？」{name}小小聲說：「媽媽總是好忙。妳是不是比較愛小豆？」說完，{name}的眼睛紅紅的，鼻子也酸酸的。
媽媽把{name}抱進懷裡，抱得緊緊的。「謝謝你告訴我。」媽媽說：「家裡多一個人，愛也會多一份。你的那一份，一直都在這裡。」媽媽輕輕摸摸{name}的心口，暖暖的。
「其實，我需要一位小幫手。」媽媽眨眨眼睛。「你願意幫小豆開一場音樂會嗎？要很輕、很柔喔。」{name}眼睛一亮，跑去拿{his}玩具木琴。這是大孩子才能做的特別工作！
{name}用力一敲。叮——咚——哎呀，太大聲了！小豆哭得更響了。{name}深深吸一口氣，再試一次。這次敲得更慢、更輕。叮、叮、咚。小豆停下來，眨眨眼睛，盯著小木琴看。
突然，小豆咧開嘴，笑了！「媽媽，小豆笑了！」媽媽笑著說：「你是最棒的音樂家。」那天晚上，媽媽陪{name}看完了圖畫書。小豆躺在旁邊，聽著輕輕的叮咚聲，甜甜的睡著了。
en: A new baby came to live at home. His name was Little Bean. He was {name}'s baby brother. Little Bean was tiny, but his cry was huge. "Waaah! Waaah!" He cried in the morning. He cried at lunch and at night. {name} covered both ears and frowned.

Mom rocked Little Bean gently, back and forth. {name} walked over with a picture book. "Mom, can we read together?" Mom whispered, "Just a minute, sweetie. Little Bean is still crying." {name} waited and waited. The book sat still. Not one page turned.

At snack time, Mom was changing a diaper. At block time, Mom was feeding the baby. {name}'s tall block tower fell down. Nobody saw it. {name} pouted and felt gloomy, like a gray cloud. {he} hid in a soft pillow.
Before dinner, Mom sat down next to {name}. "Sweetheart, you look sad. What's wrong?" {name} said very quietly, "You are always so busy. Do you love Little Bean more?" {name}'s eyes felt hot and wet.

Mom pulled {name} into a big, tight hug. "Thank you for telling me," she said. "When our family grows, our love grows too. Your share is always right here." She gently patted {name}'s chest. It felt warm inside.

"Actually, I need a helper," Mom said with a wink. "Could you give Little Bean a concert? A very soft, gentle one?" {name}'s eyes lit up. {he} ran to get {his} toy xylophone. This was a special big-kid job!

{name} hit the keys hard. Ding! Dong! Oops, too loud! Little Bean cried even louder. {name} took a deep breath and tried again. This time, slower and softer. Ding, ding, dong. Little Bean stopped. He blinked and stared at the xylophone.

Then Little Bean's mouth curled up. He smiled! "Mom, he's smiling!" Mom laughed. "You are the best musician." That evening, Mom and {name} finished the picture book together. Little Bean listened to soft dings nearby and drifted off to sleep.

questions: {name}為什麼覺得心裡悶悶的？{he}後來怎麼做？
如果你覺得爸爸媽媽太忙、沒時間陪你，你可以怎麼說？
你覺得哥哥姊姊可以幫家裡做哪些特別的工作？
zh.tip: 這週每天找十分鐘當作「只屬於你的時間」，只陪大孩子做{his}想做的事。也可以一起練習說：「我想要你陪我一下。」

questions: Why did {name} feel gloomy, and what did {he} do about it?
If you feel Mom or Dad is too busy for you, what could you say?
What special jobs could a big sibling do at home?
en.tip: This week, set aside ten minutes a day as "just us" time, doing whatever your older child chooses. Practice the phrase together: "I'd like some time with you."

zh: 晴天到了，太陽笑咪咪。{name}和媽媽去公園。公園裡有滑梯，有沙坑。還有一個紅鞦韆！{name}最喜歡鞦韆了。{name}跑呀跑，咚咚咚，咚咚咚。
咦？有個小男生先到了。他叫小樂。小樂坐上鞦韆，笑嘻嘻。{name}也好想盪喔。{name}伸出小手，停在半空中。{name}回頭看看媽媽。
媽媽輕輕說：「我們可以問問看。」{name}走過去，小聲問：「小樂，你盪完，可以換我嗎？」小樂點點頭：「可以呀！」{name}笑了。小樂也笑了。
媽媽說：「我教你們唱鞦韆歌。一首歌給小樂，一首歌給{name}。」媽媽拍拍手，唱起來：「盪呀盪，高高飛，唱完一首，換一位！」
小樂盪呀盪，咻——咻——。{name}在旁邊等。等待好難喔！{name}的腳，踏踏踏。小小手，拍拍拍。{name}跟著媽媽唱：「盪呀盪，高高飛……」唱著唱著，就不急了。
「唱完一首，換一位！」小樂慢慢停下來，跳下鞦韆。「換你囉，{name}！」{name}坐上鞦韆。媽媽輕輕推。咻——咻——，{name}像小鳥一樣飛。
這次換小樂唱歌。小樂唱得好大聲：「盪呀盪，高高……吃！」哎呀，唱錯了！{name}咯咯笑。小樂也咯咯笑。媽媽笑得哈哈哈。
一首給小樂，一首給{name}。一首又一首，換呀換，轉呀轉。兩個人一起唱，一起笑。鞦韆咻咻飛，歌聲啦啦飄。{name}說：「一起玩，好好玩！」
en: It's a sunny day. The sun smiles big. {name} and Mom go to the park. There is a slide. There is a sandbox. And a red swing! {name} loves the swing. Run, run, run!
Oh! A little boy got there first. His name is Leo. Leo sits on the swing. He giggles. {name} wants to swing too. {name} reaches out, then stops. {name} looks at Mom.
Mom says softly, "We can ask." {name} walks over. "Leo, can I have a turn when you're done?" Leo nods. "Yes, you can!" {name} smiles. Leo smiles too.
Mom says, "Let's sing a swing song. One song for Leo. One song for {name}." Mom claps and sings, "Swing, swing, way up high! One song done, your turn to fly!"
Leo swings. Whoosh! Whoosh! {name} waits. Waiting is hard! {name} taps {his} feet. Clap, clap, go little hands. {name} sings along with Mom. "Swing, swing, way up high..." Waiting feels easier now.
"One song done, your turn to fly!" Leo slows down and hops off. "Your turn, {name}!" {name} climbs on. Mom gives a gentle push. Whoosh! Whoosh! {name} flies like a little bird.
Now Leo sings, loud and proud. "Swing, swing, way up... PIE!" Oops, wrong word! {name} giggles. Leo giggles too. Mom laughs, ha, ha, ha!
One song for Leo. One song for {name}. Song after song, round and round go the turns. They sing together. They laugh together. Whoosh goes the swing! "Playing together is so fun!" says {name}.

questions: {name}想盪鞦韆的時候，問了小樂什麼話？
等待的時候，{name}做了什麼讓自己不那麼急？
如果你也想玩別人正在玩的玩具，你會怎麼說？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子玩玩具時，練習說「你玩完，可以換我嗎？」，再一起唱一首短短的歌當作輪流的計時器。

questions: What did {name} say to Leo when {he} wanted the swing?
What did {name} do while waiting so it felt easier?
If you want a toy someone else is using, what could you say?
en.tip: This week, practice saying "Can I have a turn when you're done?" during playtime, and sing one short song together as a turn-taking timer.

zh: 今天的美勞課，要畫蘋果。林老師說：「請畫一顆紅紅的蘋果！」{name}好開心，馬上打開蠟筆盒。咦？盒子裡沒有紅色。{name}東找找，西看看。原來，全班只剩一支紅蠟筆。它躺在桌子中間，短短的，圓圓的。
坐在旁邊的阿寶，也看見了紅蠟筆。他伸出手，先拿了起來。{his}小手也伸到一半。{name}好想要那支紅蠟筆呀！可是，{name}停下來，吸一口氣。{he}輕輕地問：「阿寶，你畫完以後，可以換我嗎？」
阿寶眨眨眼睛，點點頭說：「好呀！我畫完就給你。」他開始畫蘋果。畫呀畫，圓圈越畫越大。「哎呀，太大了！」阿寶笑著說。「這顆蘋果像西瓜！」{name}也忍不住咯咯笑。兩個人笑得肩膀一抖一抖的。
等待好難喔。{name}的腳在桌子下晃來晃去。{his}手指頭在桌上咚咚咚地敲。「快好了嗎？」{name}小聲問。「再一下下！」阿寶說。{name}想了想，拿起綠色蠟筆。先畫一片葉子吧！葉子彎彎的，像一艘小船。
阿寶看見那片葉子，眼睛亮了起來。「哇，好漂亮！我的蘋果也想要葉子。」可是，他的綠蠟筆斷成兩半了。{name}把綠蠟筆遞過去，說：「給你用，我們交換！」阿寶開心地說：「謝謝你！」紅蠟筆和綠蠟筆，就這樣換了位置。
現在，紅蠟筆在{name}手上了。{name}畫了一個圓圓的蘋果。塗呀塗，蘋果紅得亮晶晶。阿寶幫大蘋果畫上葉子。他說：「我再幫它畫個笑臉！」{name}也給小蘋果加上一張嘴巴。兩顆蘋果都笑咪咪的。
林老師走過來，看看兩張圖。「這兩顆蘋果好像在聊天呢！」她說。阿寶說：「大蘋果說，你好！」{name}接著說：「小蘋果說，你也好！」全班都哈哈大笑。林老師把兩張圖，肩並肩地貼在牆上。
放學前，{name}和阿寶站在牆前面。一顆大大的紅蘋果，一顆小小的紅蘋果，靠在一起。阿寶說：「明天的美勞課，我們再一起畫吧！」{name}用力點點頭。那支短短的紅蠟筆，好像也在盒子裡偷偷笑呢。
en: Today in art class, everyone would draw apples. "Please draw a nice red apple!" said Ms. Lin. {name} opened the crayon box. Oh no, there was no red inside! {name} looked here and there. Only one red crayon was left in the whole class. It sat in the middle of the table, short and round.

Bao sat right next to {name}. He saw the red crayon too, and he picked it up first. {his} hand was already halfway there. {name} wanted that crayon so much! But {name} stopped and took a deep breath. "Bao, can I have a turn when you're done?"

Bao blinked and nodded. "Sure! I'll give it to you when I'm done." He started drawing his apple. His circle grew bigger and bigger. "Oops, too big!" Bao giggled. "My apple looks like a watermelon!" {name} giggled too. Their shoulders shook with laughter.

Waiting was hard. {name}'s feet swung under the table. {his} fingers went tap, tap, tap. "Almost done?" {name} whispered. "Just a little more!" said Bao. {name} thought for a moment and picked up the green crayon. A leaf first! It curved like a tiny boat.

Bao saw the leaf, and his eyes lit up. "Wow, so pretty! My apple wants a leaf too." But his green crayon was broken in two. {name} held out the green crayon. "You can use mine. Let's trade!" "Thank you!" said Bao. So red and green switched places.

Now the red crayon was in {name}'s hand. {name} drew a round apple and colored it in. It turned shiny red. Bao added a leaf to his big apple. "I'll give it a smiley face!" he said. {name} gave the little apple a smile too. Both apples grinned.

Ms. Lin came over and looked at both pictures. "These apples look like they're chatting!" she said. "The big apple says hello!" said Bao. "The little apple says hello back!" said {name}. The whole class laughed. Ms. Lin hung the two pictures side by side on the wall.

Before going home, {name} and Bao stood by the wall. One big red apple and one little red apple sat close together. "Let's draw together again tomorrow!" said Bao. {name} nodded hard. In the box, the short red crayon seemed to be smiling too.

questions: 只剩一支紅蠟筆的時候，{name}說了什麼？
{name}在等待的時候做了哪些事？如果你也要等，你會做什麼？
阿寶和{name}交換蠟筆以後，畫畫變得怎麼樣？
zh.tip: 這個星期玩玩具或畫畫時，和孩子一起練習說：「你用完以後，可以換我嗎？」等待時，一起想一件可以先做的小事。

questions: What did {name} say when there was only one red crayon left?
What did {name} do while waiting? What could you do while you wait for a turn?
How did drawing change after Bao and {name} traded crayons?
en.tip: This week, during play or drawing time, practice saying together, "Can I have a turn when you're done?" While waiting, think of one small thing to do in the meantime.

zh: 今天是{name}的生日。氣球飄呀飄，蛋糕香又甜。大家拍拍手，一起唱生日歌。「祝你生日快樂！」{name}笑咪咪，吹熄蠟燭。呼——
阿姨拿來一個大盒子。「這是給你的禮物！」{name}拆呀拆，沙沙沙，沙沙沙。哇！是一隻小狗玩偶。軟軟的耳朵，圓圓的鼻子。
{name}抱緊小狗，抱得好緊好緊。「謝謝阿姨！」阿姨笑了，眼睛彎彎的。{name}也笑了，心裡暖暖的。{name}學小狗叫：「汪汪！汪汪！」
{name}吃完一塊蛋糕。嗯，好好吃！還想再吃一塊。{name}舉起小盤子。「媽媽，請再給我一塊。」媽媽笑了：「好呀，沒問題！」
媽媽切了一塊蛋糕。上面有一顆紅草莓！「謝謝媽媽！」媽媽笑得好開心。小狗坐在旁邊，好像也想吃。啊嗚！{name}假裝餵牠一口。
表哥小樂坐在旁邊。{name}揮揮手，{his}小手一碰。咚！小樂的杯子倒了。果汁流呀流，滴滴答答。小樂嘟起嘴巴，眼睛紅紅的。
{name}趕快說：「對不起！」{name}拿來紙巾，擦呀擦，擦乾淨。媽媽倒了一杯新果汁。{name}把杯子遞給小樂。小樂笑了：「沒關係！」
派對要結束了。阿姨笑了，媽媽笑了，小樂也笑了。{name}抱著小狗，跟大家揮揮手。小狗好像也在說：「汪汪，好開心！」{name}笑得甜甜的。
en: Today is {name}'s birthday. Balloons float up high. The cake smells sweet. Everyone claps and sings. "Happy birthday to you!" {name} smiles big. Whoosh! Out go the candles.
Auntie brings a big box. "This is for you!" {name} pulls the paper. Rustle, rustle, rustle! Wow! It's a puppy toy. Soft, floppy ears. A round little nose.
{name} hugs the puppy tight. Tight, tight, tight! "Thank you, Auntie!" Auntie smiles a happy smile. {name} feels warm inside. "Woof! Woof!" {name} barks for the puppy.
{name} finishes a piece of cake. Yum, yum, so good! {name} wants one more. Up goes the little plate. "Mommy, more cake, please." Mommy smiles. "Yes, of course!"
Mommy cuts a new piece. A red strawberry sits on top! "Thank you, Mommy!" Mommy beams. The puppy sits close by. Does it want cake too? Nom! A pretend bite.
Cousin Lele sits nearby. {name} waves {his} hand. Bump! Lele's cup tips over. Drip, drip, drop! Juice runs across the table. Lele frowns. Lele looks sad.
"Sorry, Lele!" says {name}. {name} grabs a napkin. Wipe, wipe, all clean! Mommy pours fresh juice. {name} hands the cup to Lele. Lele smiles. "That's okay!"
The party is almost over. Auntie smiles. Mommy smiles. Lele smiles too. {name} hugs the puppy and waves bye-bye. "Woof, what a happy day!" {name} grins a sweet grin.

questions: {name}收到小狗禮物時，對阿姨說了什麼？
{name}想再吃蛋糕時，是怎麼跟媽媽說的？
如果你不小心碰倒朋友的杯子，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這週吃飯時玩「魔法話」遊戲：要東西時說「請」，拿到時說「謝謝」，大人也一起示範，每說一次就互相笑一笑。

questions: What did {name} say to Auntie after getting the puppy?
How did {name} ask Mommy for more cake?
What would you do if you bumped a friend's cup by accident?
en.tip: Play a "magic words" game at meals this week: say "please" when asking and "thank you" when receiving, with grown-ups joining in. Share a smile each time someone uses one.

zh: 早上，太陽亮晶晶。{name}和奶奶在站牌旁等公車。「叭叭！」藍色公車來了。車門「嘶」一聲打開。司機林叔叔笑著說：「早安！」{name}也大聲說：「林叔叔早安！」奶奶牽著{his}手，一起上車。
車上好熱鬧。有人在看書，有人在打哈欠。{name}坐在窗戶旁邊。窗外有高高的大樓。咦，還有一隻小狗穿雨衣。可是今天沒有下雨呀！{name}忍不住咯咯笑。奶奶也笑了：「那隻狗狗好時髦喔！」
公車要轉彎了。車子輕輕晃一晃。{name}的腳也晃了一下。哎呀！{he}踩到旁邊爺爺的腳。「哎喲！」爺爺叫了一聲。爺爺的帽子也滑下來了。{name}的心咚咚咚跳得好快。
{name}趕快說：「對不起！您還好嗎？」{he}撿起地上的帽子，輕輕還給爺爺。爺爺動一動腳趾頭。「我的腳趾說，沒關係！」他還讓鞋子點點頭。{name}噗哧一聲笑出來。原來爺爺姓陳。
快到公園站了。紅紅的下車鈴，就在小美旁邊。{name}好想按鈴。可是{name}的手搆不到。{name}問：「請問，我可以按鈴嗎？」小美點點頭：「當然可以！」她把手挪開，讓出位置。
{name}伸長一根手指。「叮咚！」鈴聲響了。前面亮起一個小燈。「謝謝你！」{name}對小美說。小美笑咪咪：「不客氣！」陳爺爺拍拍手：「按得真準！」奶奶也比了一個讚。
公車慢慢停下來。車門「噗嘶」一聲，好像在打噴嚏。{name}和奶奶站起來。陳爺爺笑著說：「今天的公車，好像特別友善呢。」{name}眨眨眼睛，看看大家。每個人都在微笑。
走到車門口，{name}轉身揮揮手。「謝謝林叔叔！」林叔叔也揮手：「慢慢走喔！」{name}牽著奶奶，一步一步下車。公車「叭叭」開走了。{name}心裡暖暖的，好像裝了一顆小太陽。
en: The morning sun was bright. {name} and Grandma waited at the bus stop. "Beep beep!" A blue bus rolled up. The doors opened with a hiss. Driver Lin smiled. "Good morning!" "Good morning, Mr. Lin!" said {name}. Grandma held {his} hand, and they climbed aboard.

The bus was busy. Some people read books. Some people yawned. {name} sat by the window. Tall buildings rushed by. Then {name} saw a little dog in a raincoat. But it wasn't raining! {name} giggled. Grandma laughed too. "What a fancy dog!"

The bus turned a corner. It gave a little wobble. {name}'s foot wobbled too. Oops! It landed on an old man's toe. "Ouch!" said the old man. His hat slid off his head. {name}'s heart went thump, thump, thump.

"I'm sorry!" said {name}. "Are you okay?" {name} picked up the hat. Then {he} handed it back gently. The old man wiggled his toes. "My toes say it's all right!" He made his shoe nod. {name} burst out laughing. His name was Grandpa Chen.

Soon the park stop was near. The red stop button was next to a girl named Mei. {name} really wanted to press it. But it was too far to reach. "Please, may I press the button?" asked {name}. Mei nodded. "Of course!" She moved her hand away.

{name} stretched out one finger. Ding-dong! The bell rang. A little light blinked on up front. "Thank you!" {name} said to Mei. "You're welcome!" Mei said with a grin. Grandpa Chen clapped. "Right on target!" Grandma gave a thumbs-up.

The bus slowed down and stopped. The doors went pshhh, like a big sneeze. {name} and Grandma stood up. Grandpa Chen smiled. "This bus feels friendlier today." {name} blinked and looked around. Everyone on the bus was smiling.

At the door, {name} turned and waved. "Thank you, Mr. Lin!" Mr. Lin waved back. "Take care, now!" {name} held Grandma's hand and stepped down. "Beep beep!" The bus rolled away. {name} felt warm inside, like a tiny sun.

questions: {name}不小心踩到陳爺爺的腳時，{he}說了什麼、又做了什麼？
{name}想按下車鈴時，是怎麼問小美的？小美幫忙後，{name}說了什麼？
今天有誰幫過你？你可以怎麼跟他說謝謝？
zh.tip: 這個星期一起玩「魔法話」遊戲：每次聽到家人說「請」、「謝謝」或「對不起」，就給彼此一個擊掌。睡前數一數今天擊掌了幾次。

questions: When {name} stepped on Grandpa Chen's toe by accident, what did {he} say and do?
How did {name} ask Mei about the stop button? What did {name} say after Mei helped?
Who helped you today? How could you say thank you to them?
en.tip: This week, play the "magic words" game: give each other a high five whenever someone in the family says please, thank you, or sorry. Count the high fives together at bedtime.

zh: 晚上到了，月亮出來了。媽媽親親{name}。「晚安，寶貝。」啪！燈關了。房間變得黑黑的。{name}眨眨眼睛。咦？房間好像不一樣了。好安靜，好安靜。
{name}抱起小烏龜燈。按一下，亮起來了。綠綠的光，暖暖的光。小烏龜圓圓的殼，亮亮的。光照到床邊，光照到地上。軟軟的光，輕輕的光。
那是什麼？黑黑的一大團。{name}拿起小烏龜，照一照。原來是椅子！還是那張小椅子。白天坐著吃點心的椅子。椅子沒有變，椅子在休息。
那又是什麼？高高的，尖尖的。{name}再照一照。原來是小熊和積木塔！還是那隻小熊。還是那座積木塔。都在原來的地方，一樣也沒少。
呼——呼——窗外有聲音。{name}抱緊小烏龜。心裡有一點點怕怕。{name}想到了媽媽。{he}輕輕叫：「媽媽！」
門開了一點點。媽媽探頭進來。「我在這裡喔。」媽媽坐到床邊。「呼呼的是什麼呀？」媽媽笑笑說：「是風。風在窗外唱歌呢。」
滴答，滴答。「那個呢？」「那是時鐘，慢慢在走路。」媽媽看看房間。「椅子還在，小熊還在。積木塔也還在。燈只是去休息了。」{name}點點頭。「小烏龜也在。」
媽媽把小熊放進{his}懷裡。「我就在隔壁喔。」綠綠的光，暖暖的。風輕輕唱，呼——呼——。時鐘輕輕走，滴答，滴答。眼睛慢慢閉上了。晚安，{name}。
en: Night has come. The moon is up. Mom gives {name} a kiss. "Good night, sweetie." Click! The light goes off. The room is dark. {name} blinks. The room looks different. So quiet, so quiet.
{name} hugs the turtle night-light. Press, and it glows! Soft green light. Warm green light. Light on the bed. Light on the floor.
What is that? A big dark shape. {name} holds up the turtle. Shine, shine. It's the chair! The same little chair. The chair didn't change. It's just resting.
What is that? Something tall and pointy. {name} shines the turtle again. It's Teddy and the block tower! The same Teddy. The same tower. Everything is in its place.
Whoo, whoo. A sound by the window. {name} hugs the turtle tight. {name} feels a little scared. Then {he} thinks of Mom. "Mom!"
The door opens a crack. Mom peeks in. "I'm right here." She sits on the bed. "What's that whoo-whoo?" Mom smiles. "That's the wind. It's singing outside."
Tick, tock. "What's that?" "That's the clock, taking tiny steps." Mom looks around. "The chair is here. Teddy is here. The light is just resting." {name} nods. "Turtle is here too."
Mom tucks Teddy into {his} arms. "I'm just next door." Green light glows, warm and soft. The wind sings, whoo, whoo. The clock goes tick, tock. Eyes close slowly. Good night, {name}.

questions: 燈關了以後，{name}用小烏龜燈照到了什麼？
{name}聽到呼呼的聲音、覺得怕怕的時候，做了什麼？
如果你晚上覺得怕怕的，你想抱著什麼、叫誰呢？
zh.tip: 今晚關燈後，和孩子一起玩「找一找」：用小夜燈照照房間，說出「椅子還在、小熊還在」，再一起聽聽夜晚的聲音，猜猜它們是什麼。

questions: What did {name} find when {he} shone the turtle light around the room?
What did {name} do when the whoo-whoo sound felt a little scary?
If you feel scared at night, what would you hug, and who would you call?
en.tip: Tonight after lights-out, play a quick 'still here' game: shine a night-light around the room and name each thing together ('The chair is still here, Teddy is still here'), then listen for one night sound and guess what it is.

zh: 森林裡的夜晚來了。{name}和媽媽搭好小帳篷。帳篷裡有軟軟的睡袋，還有{his}小熊布布。媽媽說：「該睡覺囉。」她輕輕關掉營燈。帳篷裡一下子變得好黑好黑。{name}抱緊布布，眨了眨眼睛。
「呱、呱、呱。」外面傳來奇怪的聲音。「唧、唧、唧。」又有細細的聲音。「沙、沙、沙。」帳篷旁邊也在響。{name}的心跳得好快。{he}小聲喊：「媽媽，我有點怕。」媽媽馬上靠過來，輕輕抱住{him}。「沒關係，害怕的時候，叫媽媽就對了。」
媽媽拿出一支手電筒。「我們先看看帳篷裡。」小小的光圈亮起來。光照到{his}背包，背包還在。光照到{his}故事書，故事書也在。水壺和枕頭，全都乖乖待在原地。媽媽笑著說：「燈去休息了，東西都沒走開喔。」
「那外面的聲音是誰呢？」{name}問。媽媽拉開帳篷的小窗，和{name}一起往外看。手電筒照向旁邊的樹葉。一隻綠色的小樹蛙，坐在葉子上。牠鼓起喉嚨，「呱、呱」叫了兩聲。{name}忍不住笑了：「原來是你呀！」
光圈慢慢移到草地上。草叢裡躲著幾隻小蟋蟀。牠們輕輕摩擦翅膀，「唧、唧、唧」地唱歌。媽媽說：「蟋蟀晚上最愛唱歌了。」{name}點點頭。現在聽起來，歌聲好溫柔。接著，一陣涼涼的風吹過來。
「沙、沙、沙。」頭上的樹葉輕輕搖動。媽媽把光往上照。好多葉子在風裡跳舞，像在拍手一樣。「是風在跟樹葉玩！」{name}說。{name}小聲說：「晚安，樹葉。」媽媽關上小窗，帳篷又暖暖的了。
媽媽拿出一盞小夜燈，放在帳篷角落。夜燈發出淡淡的黃光，像一顆小月亮。{name}抱著布布，鑽進軟軟的睡袋。媽媽躺在旁邊，握著{his}小手。「媽媽就在這裡，一整晚都在。」她輕聲說。
外面的樹蛙又唱起來了。「呱、呱、呱。」一隻唱完，另一隻接著唱，像一個小小的合唱團。蟋蟀輕輕跟著唧唧唱。風吹得樹葉沙沙響。{name}的眼睛慢慢閉上了。「晚安，小樹蛙。晚安，媽媽。」森林安安靜靜，{name}睡著了。
en: Night came to the forest. {name} and Mom set up a small tent. Inside were soft sleeping bags and Bubu, {his} teddy bear. "Time to sleep," Mom said. She switched off the lantern. The tent was very, very dark. {name} hugged Bubu tight.

"Ribbit, ribbit." A strange sound came from outside. "Chirp, chirp." A tiny sound joined in. "Swish, swish." Something rustled by the tent. {name} felt a fast thump inside. "Mom, I'm a little scared." Mom gave a hug right away. "That's okay. When you feel scared, just call me."

Mom picked up a flashlight. "Let's look inside the tent first." A little circle of light appeared. It found {his} backpack, still there. It found {his} storybook, still there. The water bottle and pillow sat right in place. "The lights are resting," Mom smiled. "Everything stayed put."

"But who is making the sounds?" {name} asked. Mom unzipped the little window. They peeked out together. The light shone on a leaf nearby. A tiny green tree frog sat there. Its throat puffed up. "Ribbit, ribbit!" {name} giggled. "So it's you!"

The circle of light moved slowly to the grass. A few crickets were hiding there. They rubbed their wings together. "Chirp, chirp, chirp." "Crickets love to sing at night," Mom said. {name} nodded. Their song sounded gentle now. Then a cool breeze blew past.

"Swish, swish." The leaves above began to sway. Mom pointed the light up. Lots of leaves were dancing in the wind, like tiny hands clapping. "It's the wind playing with the leaves!" said {name}. "Goodnight, leaves." Mom zipped the window shut. The tent felt cozy again.

Mom took out a small night light and set it in the corner. It glowed soft and yellow, like a little moon. {name} snuggled into the sleeping bag with Bubu. Mom lay down close by and held {his} hand. "I'm right here," she whispered. "All night long."

Outside, the tree frogs began to sing again. "Ribbit, ribbit." One frog sang, then another answered, like a tiny choir. The crickets chirped softly along. The leaves swished in the breeze. Slowly, {name} closed sleepy eyes. "Goodnight, frogs. Goodnight, Mom." The forest grew quiet, and {name} fell asleep.

questions: {name}覺得害怕的時候，{he}做了什麼？媽媽又做了什麼？
手電筒照亮帳篷時，{name}發現東西都還在嗎？我們的房間關燈以後，會有什麼還在？
晚上你聽過什麼聲音？你猜是誰發出來的呢？
zh.tip: 今晚關燈前，和孩子一起用手電筒「巡房」，一一照出熟悉的東西說「它還在」，再讓孩子挑一個抱抱玩偶和小夜燈陪睡。

questions: What did {name} do when {he} felt scared? What did Mom do?
When the flashlight lit up the tent, was everything still there? What stays in your room when the lights go off?
What sounds have you heard at night? Who do you think made them?
en.tip: Tonight before lights-out, take a flashlight tour of the room together, shining on familiar things and saying "still there." Then let your child pick a cuddly toy and a night light to keep them company.

zh: 今天早上，林老師在教室中間排了一圈椅子。「我們來玩搶椅子！」老師笑著說。椅子有五張，小朋友有六個。{name}、小美、阿哲、小傑和大家都站好了。音樂一響，就要繞著椅子走。音樂一停，就要快快坐下。{name}好期待喔！
叮叮咚咚，音樂開始了。大家繞著椅子慢慢走。{name}走著走著，跟在小美後面。突然，音樂停了！大家趕快找椅子坐。{name}轉了一圈，可是每張椅子都有人了。{name}是第一個出局的人。
{name}站在原地，眼睛熱熱的，鼻子也酸酸的。{he}好想哭喔。「我第一個就輸了。」{name}小聲說。林老師走過來，輕輕蹲下。「有點失望，對不對？」老師溫柔地問。{name}點點頭，嘴巴扁扁的。
「我們一起深呼吸好不好？」林老師說。{name}慢慢吸一口氣，肚子鼓鼓的。再慢慢吐出來，呼——。{name}又吸一口氣，再吐出來。心裡那團緊緊的感覺，好像變小了一點。{name}擦擦眼睛，坐到旁邊的小板凳上。
音樂又響了，椅子少了一張。{name}看著大家繞圈圈。阿哲走得搖搖晃晃，差點滑一跤，大家都笑了。音樂一停，小美搶到最後一張椅子。阿哲出局了，他低著頭走過來。{name}拍拍板凳說：「阿哲，坐這裡！」阿哲笑了。
兩個人一起當啦啦隊。「小美加油！」{name}拍拍手大喊。「大家加油！」阿哲也跟著喊。小朋友聽到加油聲，走得更開心了。最後只剩小美和小傑。音樂停了，小傑先坐下。{name}還是用力拍手：「小傑好棒！小美也好棒！」
林老師笑著走過來。「{name}，你幫大家加油，好溫暖喔。」老師說，「下一輪，你來放音樂好嗎？」{name}開心地點頭。老師把音樂機放在桌上。「按這個圓圓的按鈕，音樂就會開始。再按一次，音樂就會停。」
新的一輪開始了。{name}按下按鈕，叮叮咚咚！大家繞著椅子走。{name}等一下，再等一下……按！音樂停了。大家搶椅子，笑成一團。這次阿哲搶到椅子了，開心得跳起來。{name}笑著說：「放音樂好好玩！下次我也要再玩搶椅子！」
en: This morning, Ms. Lin set chairs in a circle. "Let's play musical chairs!" she said with a smile. There were five chairs and six children. {name}, Mei, Jay, Leo, and the others lined up. When the music played, they would walk. When it stopped, they would sit fast!

Ding-dong, the music began. Everyone walked slowly around the chairs. {name} walked and walked behind Mei. Suddenly, the music stopped! Everyone rushed to sit down. {name} turned around, but every chair was taken. {name} was the very first one out.

{name} stood very still. Eyes stinging, {he} wanted to cry. "I lost first," {name} whispered. Ms. Lin came over and knelt down. "You feel disappointed, don't you?" she asked gently. {name} nodded with a wobbly lip.

"Let's take a big breath together," said Ms. Lin. {name} breathed in slowly, filling up like a balloon. Then out it came. Whoosh! In again, and out again. The tight, knotty feeling grew a little smaller. {name} wiped away the tears and sat on a little bench nearby.

The music started again, and one more chair was gone. {name} watched everyone circle. Jay wobbled and almost slipped, and everyone giggled. When the music stopped, Mei grabbed the last chair. Jay was out. He walked over, looking down. {name} patted the bench. "Sit with me, Jay!" Jay smiled.

Now the two of them were a cheering team. "Go, Mei!" {name} shouted, clapping. "Go, everyone!" Jay cheered too. The cheers made the game even happier. At last, only Mei and Leo were left. The music stopped, and Leo sat first. {name} clapped hard. "Great job, Leo! Great job, Mei!"

Ms. Lin came over, smiling. "{name}, your cheering made everyone feel warm," she said. "Would you like to play the music next round?" {name} nodded happily. Ms. Lin set the music player on the table. "Press this round button to start the music. Press it again to stop."

A new round began. {name} pressed the button. Ding-dong! Everyone walked around the chairs. {name} waited, and waited, then pressed! The music stopped. Everyone scrambled and giggled. This time Jay got a chair and jumped for joy. "Playing the music is so fun!" {name} laughed. "Next time, I want to play musical chairs again!"

questions: {name}第一個出局的時候，心裡有什麼感覺？{he}做了什麼讓自己好一點？
阿哲出局的時候，{name}怎麼對他？如果你的朋友輸了，你會怎麼做？
你有沒有玩遊戲輸了的時候？下次你可以試試看做什麼？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子玩一個簡單的桌遊，輸的人先一起深呼吸三次，再對贏的人說：「你好棒！我們再玩一次！」大人也可以故意示範輸了的樣子。

questions: How did {name} feel when {he} was out first? What did {name} do to feel a little better?
What did {name} do when Jay was out? What would you do if a friend lost a game?
Have you ever lost a game? What could you try next time?
en.tip: This week, play a simple board game together. Whoever loses takes three big breaths with you, then says, "Great job! Let's play again!" Let your child see you lose kindly too.

title.en: {name} Rides to the Little Red Bridge

zh: 星期六早上，河邊公園的步道又寬又平，旁邊有一排矮矮的木頭欄杆。爸爸把腳踏車的輔助輪拆了下來，幫{name}扣好安全帽。「今天要試試只有兩個輪子喔！」爸爸說。{name}握緊把手，心裡撲通撲通地跳。
爸爸扶著後座，跟在旁邊小跑步。可是爸爸一放手，車子就左搖右晃，{name}只好趕快把腳踩到地上。再試一次，車子又歪向草地那邊，連人帶車輕輕倒在軟軟的草上。一次、兩次、三次……{name}數著數著，都數亂了。
這時，住在隔壁的小宇也騎著車過來。「我們來比賽，看誰先騎到那棵大榕樹！」{name}用力踩，可是才騎幾下就停住了。小宇先到了大樹下，回頭揮揮手。{name}牽著車走過去，吸一口氣說：「你騎得好快，好厲害！」
小宇笑著說：「謝謝！我剛開始學的時候，也一直倒在草地上呢。」可是{name}還是坐到草地上，抱著膝蓋不說話。好難啊，為什麼小宇會，自己卻一直學不會？{name}心裡酸酸的，一點都不想再騎了。
爸爸也坐了下來，陪{name}看河上的小鴨子。「覺得失望沒關係，」爸爸輕輕地說，「我們先一起深呼吸。」吸——吐——。小鴨子「呱呱」叫著游過去。爸爸問：「剛才騎車的時候，你的眼睛都在看哪裡呀？」{name}想了想：「看輪子，還有地上。」
小宇眼睛一亮：「我哥哥教過我，要看遠遠的地方，車子就會跟著你走！」爸爸指著步道盡頭那座紅色的小橋：「那我們換個方法，試試看把眼睛放在那座橋上。」{name}站起來，拍掉草屑，重新坐上座墊。
這一次，{name}抬起頭，一直盯著那座小紅橋。腳踩下去，一圈、兩圈、三圈……車子還是晃了一下，可是{name}沒有低頭，把手穩穩握好，車子竟然慢慢變直了。爸爸在後面小跑步跟著，小宇騎在旁邊大聲喊：「加油！加油！」
風輕輕吹過耳邊，小紅橋越來越近。{name}一路騎到橋邊，慢慢煞車，雙腳穩穩踩在地上。「我做到了！」小宇騎過來跟{him}擊掌。{name}笑著說：「明天我們再比賽一次！不管誰先到，都要一起來看小鴨子喔！」
en: On Saturday morning, the path by the river in the park was wide and smooth, with a low wooden fence along the side. Dad took the training wheels off the bike and helped {name} buckle up the helmet. "Today we try with just two wheels!" he said. {name} gripped the handlebars, heart thumping.

Dad held the back of the seat and jogged alongside. But each time he let go, the bike wobbled left and right, and {name} had to put both feet down fast. On the next try, the bike tipped toward the grass, and down went {name}, bike and all, onto the soft green lawn. Once, twice, three times... {name} lost count.

Just then, Leo from next door rolled up on his bike. "Let's race to the big banyan tree!" {name} pedaled hard but stopped after a few turns. Leo reached the tree first and waved. {name} walked the bike over, took a breath, and said, "You're so fast. That was great!"

"Thanks!" Leo grinned. "When I was learning, I kept tipping into the grass too." But {name} still sat down on the lawn, hugging both knees and saying nothing. Why could Leo do it when {name} couldn't? {name} felt heavy inside and didn't want to ride anymore.

Dad sat down too, and they watched the ducks on the river. "It's okay to feel disappointed," Dad said softly. "Let's take a big breath together." In... and out. The ducks paddled past, going quack, quack. "When you were riding, where were your eyes looking?" Dad asked. {name} thought. "At the wheel. And the ground."

Leo's face lit up. "My big brother told me to look far ahead, and the bike follows where you look!" Dad pointed to the little red bridge at the end of the path. "Let's try a new way. Keep your eyes on that bridge." {name} stood up, brushed off the grass, and climbed back on.

This time, {name} lifted {his} gaze and kept looking at the little red bridge. One push, two pushes, three... The bike wobbled once, but {name} didn't look down and held the handlebars steady. Slowly, the bike rolled straight! Dad jogged behind, and Leo rode alongside, shouting, "Go, go, go!"

The breeze whooshed past, and the bridge came closer and closer. {name} rode all the way there, braked gently, and put both feet down. "I did it!" Leo rode up for a high five. {name} laughed. "Let's race again tomorrow! Whoever wins, we'll both go see the ducks!"

questions: {name}一直倒在草地上、覺得很失望的時候，爸爸陪{him}做了什麼？後來{name}換了什麼新方法？
比賽輸給小宇的時候，{name}對小宇說了什麼？如果你比賽輸了，你可以怎麼對朋友說？
你有沒有試過一件很難、一直做不好的事？那時候你心裡有什麼感覺？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子一起玩一個小遊戲或練習一件新本事，不管輸贏或做錯，都一起深呼吸三次，然後說：「我們再試一次，或換個方法試試看！」

questions: When {name} kept tipping over and felt disappointed, what did Dad do together with {him}? What new way did {name} try next?
When {name} lost the race to Leo, what did {name} say to Leo? If you lose a game, what could you say to your friend?
Have you ever tried something hard that kept going wrong? How did you feel inside?
en.tip: This week, play a small game or practice a new skill with your child, and whenever someone loses or makes a mistake, take three deep breaths together and say, "Let's try again, or try a different way!"

zh: 運動會那天，操場上彩旗獵獵作響，加油聲此起彼落。四年二班的大隊接力只剩最後一棒，{name}站在接力區，手心直冒汗，心跳像打鼓一樣咚咚咚。小芸咬緊牙關衝過彎道，把紅色接力棒往前一遞——「啪噠！」接力棒掉在跑道上，骨碌碌地轉了好幾圈。
{name}手忙腳亂地撿起棒子，拔腿狂奔，可是其他班的選手早已一溜煙衝過終點。四年二班，最後一名。{name}覺得全身熱烘烘的，像剛出爐的包子，恨不得找個地洞鑽進去。{he}垂著頭，悄悄往司令台後面的陰影挪過去，連鞋帶鬆了都沒發現。
「{name}！你要去哪裡？」阿哲第一個追上來，高高舉起手掌。美琪也跑過來，接著是小芸，一個、兩個、五個……全隊的手掌排成一列。「啪！啪！啪！」清脆的擊掌聲一聲接一聲。{name}愣住了：「可是……我們是最後一名耶。」阿哲聳聳肩，笑嘻嘻地說：「對啊，而且是很有創意的最後一名，接力棒還表演了翻滾特技！」大家頓時笑成一團。
小芸卻搔搔頭，有點不好意思地說：「其實是我太早放手了，你還沒抓穩，我就鬆開了。」{name}瞪大眼睛，原來那一棒，不是只有自己一個人的錯！美琪拍拍手提議：「那下週下課，我們一起練交棒吧！」{name}深深吸了一口氣，把心裡那團悶悶的難過慢慢吐出來，用力點了點頭。
第一次練習，簡直是兵荒馬亂。阿哲喊「接！」的時候，美琪剛好在喊「跑！」，兩個人差點撞成一團；接力棒掉了三次，其中一次還滾進花圃，嚇得一隻打盹的麻雀啾啾叫著飛走了。{name}一邊撿棒子，一邊忍不住噗哧一笑。原來掉棒，好像也沒那麼可怕嘛。
漸漸地，大家想出了妙招：接棒的人往後伸出手，掌心朝上，像一個小小的停機坪；傳棒的人喊一聲「拿！」，等對方手指扣緊了才放開。{name}練了一遍又一遍，從手忙腳亂變得穩穩當當，最後連閉上眼睛，都能感覺到棒子「咚」地落進掌心。林老師在一旁看著，嘴角微微上揚。
星期五的體育課，林老師舉辦了一場班級友誼賽。這一次，接力棒在每個人手中穩穩傳遞，四年二班得了第二名。{name}衝過終點後，沒有急著看成績，而是先跑去和隔壁班的選手擊掌：「你們跑得好快！」接著轉過身，朝隊友們高高舉起手。「啪！」這一聲，又響又亮。
en: On sports day, bright flags snapped in the wind and cheers bounced all around the field. The Class 4B relay was down to the final leg. {name} stood in the handoff zone, palms sweaty, heart thumping like a drum. Xiaoyun charged around the bend, teeth gritted, and stretched out the red baton. Clatter! The baton hit the track and went spinning, round and round.

{name} scrambled to grab it and sprinted off, but the other runners had already zipped across the finish line. Class 4B came in last. {name} felt hot all over, like a steamed bun fresh out of the pot, and wished the ground would swallow every bit of the moment. Head down, {name} edged toward the shadows behind the stage, not even noticing a loose shoelace.

"{name}! Where are you going?" Azhe got there first, hand held high. Meiqi ran over too, then Xiaoyun. One, two, five hands lined up in a row. Smack! Smack! Smack! The high fives rang out one after another. {name} froze. "But we came in last." Azhe shrugged and grinned. "Sure, but we were creative about it. The baton even did a somersault!" Everyone burst out laughing.

Xiaoyun scratched her head, looking a little sheepish. "Actually, I let go too early. You hadn't grabbed it yet." {name} blinked in surprise. So that drop hadn't been one person's fault after all! Meiqi clapped. "Let's practice handoffs at recess next week!" {name} took a long, deep breath, let the heavy, gloomy feeling slowly drift out, and nodded hard.

The first practice was total chaos. Azhe yelled "Catch!" at the exact moment Meiqi yelled "Go!", and the two of them nearly crashed into each other. The baton fell three times. Once it rolled right into the flower bed, and a dozing sparrow fluttered off, cheeping in alarm. {name} picked it up and couldn't help giggling. Maybe dropping a baton wasn't so terrible after all.

Little by little, the team invented a clever system. The receiver reached back, palm up, like a tiny landing pad. The passer called "Take!" and let go only once the fingers closed tight. {name} practiced again and again, going from fumbling to steady, until even with eyes shut, the baton landed in {his} palm with a solid thump. Ms. Lin watched from the side, smiling quietly.

In Friday's gym class, Ms. Lin held a friendly relay race. This time, the baton moved smoothly from hand to hand, and Class 4B finished second. After crossing the line, {name} didn't rush to check the results. Instead, {name} jogged over to high-five the runners from the class next door. "You were so fast!" Then {name} turned and raised a hand to the team. Smack! That one was loud and bright.

questions: {name}掉了接力棒以後，心裡有什麼感覺？隊友們做了什麼，讓{him}好過一點？
你有沒有輸了比賽或犯錯、很想躲起來的時候？那時候什麼事情幫助了你？
比賽結束後，{name}先去和別班擊掌。你覺得當一個好隊友，比得第一名更重要的地方在哪裡？
zh.tip: 這週玩桌遊或比賽時，不論輸贏，結束後全家一起擊掌說「謝謝你跟我玩」。如果有人輸了覺得難過，就一起做三次深呼吸，再聊聊下次可以怎麼試試不同的方法。

questions: How did {name} feel after dropping the baton? What did the teammates do that helped {him} feel better?
Have you ever lost a game or made a mistake and wanted to hide? What helped you then?
After the race, {name} high-fived the other class first. Why do you think being a good teammate can matter more than coming in first?
en.tip: This week, after any board game or race, win or lose, have everyone high-five and say "Thanks for playing with me." If someone feels upset about losing, take three deep breaths together, then talk about one thing to try differently next time.

zh: 科學展的早晨，操場邊擠滿了人。陳老師站在二樓走廊，準備替每一組把雞蛋往下放。{name}捧著自己的作品，心臟砰砰亂跳：那是一頂用彩色塑膠袋做成的降落傘，八條棉線綁在小紙盒上，雞蛋就躺在盒子裡。「我做了三個晚上，」{name}對好朋友露露說，「它一定會像蒲公英一樣慢慢飄下來。」
輪到{name}了。陳老師一鬆手，降落傘卻沒有張開，八條線糾成一團，像一把被風吹壞的雨傘。紙盒直直墜落，「啪」的一聲，蛋黃在水泥地上攤成一朵黃色的小太陽。有人忍不住笑出來，又趕緊摀住嘴巴。{name}的臉一下子燙了起來，眼眶也熱熱的。三個晚上的心血，就這樣功虧一簣。
{name}默默走到樹蔭下，抱著膝蓋坐著。露露跟過來，安靜地坐在旁邊，過了一會兒才遞來一張面紙。「我上星期在家試，也摔破了兩顆蛋，」她小聲說，「我媽說冰箱裡的蛋快被我用光了。」{name}噗哧一笑，深深吸了一口氣，再慢慢吐出來。胸口那顆沉甸甸的石頭，好像輕了一點。
{name}撿起那頂皺巴巴的降落傘，攤在草地上仔細端詳。原來線有長有短，最長的一條多出一個指節；傘面中間又鼓得像氣球，空氣困在裡面，害它左搖右晃。回到教室，{name}借來一塊橡皮擦綁在傘下，把線剪成一樣長，再在傘面正中央剪個小洞。一次又一次試，傘終於穩穩地飄下來了。
「我知道哪裡出錯了！」{name}跑回操場，同學們立刻圍上來。這回{name}一點也不害羞，舉起降落傘比畫：「線要一樣長，中間開個小洞，讓空氣溜出去一點，傘才不會翻來覆去。」還沒上場的同學紛紛點頭，有人拿出剪刀，有人重新量線，七嘴八舌，熱鬧得像菜市場。
最後一個上場的是露露。她的作品是吸管編成的小籠子，蛋吊在正中央，上面還綁了一頂小小的降落傘。{name}瞇眼一看，愣住了：傘面中央，正有一個圓圓的小洞。露露眨眨眼說：「剛剛跟你學的。」陳老師鬆手，降落傘穩穩張開，像一隻水母慢悠悠地往下漂。
籠子輕輕落地，露露衝過去打開，蛋完好如初，連一條裂痕都沒有！{name}第一個跳起來，拍手拍到掌心發紅：「成功了！露露成功了！」露露把蛋高高舉起，又塞給{name}一張紙條，上面寫著：「下次一起做？」放學後，{name}在筆記本上畫了一頂新的降落傘，旁邊寫著三個大字：第二號。
en: On science fair morning, the playground buzzed with people. Ms. Chen stood on the second-floor walkway, ready to drop each team's egg. {name} held a carefully built project with a thumping heart: a parachute stitched from colorful plastic bags, eight cotton strings tied to a little paper box, and an egg tucked inside. "I worked on this for three nights," {name} told a best friend, Lulu. "It'll float down like a dandelion seed."

Then it was {name}'s turn. Ms. Chen let go, but the parachute never opened. The eight strings twisted into a knot, like an umbrella wrecked by wind. The box plunged straight down. Splat! The yolk spread across the concrete like a small yellow sun. Someone giggled, then quickly covered their mouth. {name}'s cheeks burned and {his} eyes stung. Three nights of work, gone in one second.

{name} slipped away to the shade of a tree and sat hugging both knees. Lulu followed and sat down quietly, not saying much. After a while, she offered a tissue. "I broke two eggs testing at home last week," she whispered. "My mom says I've nearly emptied the fridge." {name} snorted with laughter, took a deep breath, and let it out slowly. The heavy stone in {his} chest felt a little lighter.

{name} picked up the crumpled parachute and spread it on the grass to study it. Some strings were longer than others, one by a whole knuckle. The middle of the canopy puffed up like a balloon, trapping air and making it wobble. Back in the classroom, {name} tied an eraser underneath, trimmed every string to the same length, and snipped a tiny hole in the center. Test after test, the parachute finally drifted down, smooth and steady.

"I figured out what went wrong!" {name} raced back outside, and classmates crowded around. This time {name} wasn't shy at all, holding up the parachute to explain. "Make the strings equal, and cut a small hole in the middle so a little air can escape. Then it won't flip around." Kids who hadn't gone yet nodded eagerly. Some grabbed scissors, others re-measured string, everyone chattering at once.

Lulu went last. Her project was a tiny cage woven from straws, with the egg hanging in the middle and a small parachute tied on top. {name} squinted and froze. Right in the center of her parachute was a neat round hole. Lulu winked. "I just learned it from you." Ms. Chen let go, and the parachute bloomed open, gliding down as lazily as a jellyfish.

The cage landed softly. Lulu rushed over and opened it. The egg was perfect, without a single crack! {name} jumped up first, clapping until {his} palms turned pink. "You did it! Lulu did it!" Lulu held the egg high, then pressed a note into {name}'s hand. It said, "Build one together next time?" After school, {name} sketched a brand-new parachute in a notebook and wrote beside it in big letters: Number Two.

questions: {name}的蛋摔破時，心裡有什麼感覺？後來{he}做了哪些事讓自己好起來？
露露成功的時候，{name}為什麼會第一個跳起來替她加油？
你有沒有輸掉或做錯事的時候？如果再來一次，你會想試試什麼不一樣的方法？
zh.tip: 這週吃晚餐時，全家輪流說一件「今天出錯的事」和「我從中學到什麼」，大人先示範，讓犯錯變成可以輕鬆聊的話題。

questions: How did {name} feel when the egg splatted, and what did {he} do to feel better afterward?
Why do you think {name} was the first to jump up and cheer when Lulu's egg landed safely?
Can you remember a time you lost or made a mistake? If you tried again, what would you do differently?
en.tip: At dinner this week, take turns sharing one thing that went wrong today and one thing you learned from it, with a grown-up going first so mistakes feel easy to talk about.

zh: 星期三是美術課，教室裡好熱鬧。林老師說：「今天我們來畫大海。」{name}坐在莉莉旁邊。莉莉畫了一艘紅色的小船，還有一隻黃色的小魚。{name}看了好喜歡。桌上放著好多顏料罐，有紅的、黃的，還有藍的。
{name}想幫大海塗上藍色。{he}伸手去拿藍色顏料，手肘卻不小心碰到罐子。「咚！」罐子倒了。藍色顏料流了出來，剛好流到莉莉的畫上。小船不見了，小魚也不見了。整張紙變得藍藍的、濕濕的。
莉莉洗完水彩筆回來，看到自己的畫，一下子愣住了。「我的畫！是誰弄的？」她的眼睛紅紅的。{name}的心砰砰跳，好害怕。{name}趕快低下頭，小聲說：「我不知道。」說完，就假裝很認真地畫畫。
林老師走過來，輕輕拍拍莉莉的背。「別難過，我們一起想辦法。」可是{name}一點也不開心。{his}肚子怪怪的，畫筆也拿不穩。下課鈴響了，大家跑去玩。{name}卻坐在位子上，一動也不動。那個祕密，好像一顆大石頭，壓在心上。
{name}看看窗外，又看看莉莉的空位子。{name}深深吸了一口氣，慢慢走到林老師身邊。聲音小小的，有點發抖。「老師，藍色顏料……是我不小心打翻的。我剛剛好害怕，所以說不知道。」
林老師蹲下來，看著{name}的眼睛。「謝謝你告訴我。說出來，需要很大的勇氣喔。」老師笑了笑。「現在我知道發生什麼事了，我們一起來幫莉莉吧。」{name}覺得心裡那顆大石頭，好像變輕了一點。
莉莉回到教室。{name}走到她面前，小聲說：「莉莉，對不起。是我打翻顏料的。」莉莉眨眨眼睛，想了一下。林老師拿出一張新的畫紙。「我們可以一起畫一張新的嗎？」{name}問。莉莉點點頭：「好啊！」
這次，兩個人一起畫。莉莉畫紅色的小船，{name}畫好多小魚。那張藍藍的舊畫紙呢？等它乾了，老師把它剪成浪花，貼在新畫上。大海變得好漂亮！放學前，莉莉拉著{name}的手說：「下次，我們還要坐在一起畫畫喔！」{name}開心地笑了。
en: Wednesday was art day, and the classroom was busy. "Today, let's paint the sea," said Ms. Lin. {name} sat next to Lily. Lily painted a red boat and a yellow fish. {name} loved it. Jars of red, yellow, and blue paint sat on the table.

{name} wanted to paint a blue sea. {he} reached for the blue paint, but an elbow bumped the jar. Thunk! The jar tipped over. Blue paint spilled right onto Lily's picture. The boat and the fish were gone. The paper was wet and blue.

Lily came back from washing her brush. She stopped and stared. "My picture! Who did this?" Her eyes filled with tears. {his} heart went thump, thump. Feeling scared, {name} looked down and whispered, "I don't know." Then {name} pretended to paint.

Ms. Lin came over and patted Lily's back. "Don't worry. We'll find a way." But {name} did not feel happy at all. {his} tummy felt funny. When the bell rang, everyone ran out to play. {name} sat very still. The secret felt like a big rock inside.

{name} looked out the window, then at Lily's empty chair. Taking a deep breath, {name} walked slowly to Ms. Lin. The words came out small and shaky. "Ms. Lin, I spilled the blue paint by accident. I was scared, so I said I didn't know."

Ms. Lin knelt down and looked into {name}'s eyes. "Thank you for telling me. That took a lot of courage." She smiled. "Now that I know what happened, we can help Lily together." The big rock inside {name} felt a little lighter.

Lily came back to the classroom. {name} walked up to her. "Lily, I'm sorry. I spilled the paint." Lily blinked and thought for a moment. Ms. Lin brought out a fresh sheet of paper. "Can we paint a new one together?" {name} asked. Lily nodded. "Okay!"

This time, they painted side by side. Lily painted the red boat. {name} painted lots of little fish. And the old blue paper? Once it dried, Ms. Lin cut it into waves for the new picture. The sea looked wonderful! Before home time, Lily held {name}'s hand. "Let's sit together again next time!" {name} smiled.

questions: {name}說「我不知道」之後，心裡有什麼感覺？為什麼後來決定告訴老師？
林老師知道真相以後，怎麼幫忙解決問題？
如果你不小心弄壞了別人的東西，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這個星期，當孩子主動說出自己犯的錯時，先抱抱孩子並說：「謝謝你告訴我，我們一起想辦法。」再陪孩子一起補救。

questions: How did {name} feel after saying "I don't know"? Why did {name} decide to tell Ms. Lin?
After Ms. Lin knew the truth, how did she help fix the problem?
What would you do if you broke something that belonged to someone else by accident?
en.tip: This week, whenever your child tells you about a mistake, give a hug first and say, "Thank you for telling me. Let's fix it together." Then help your child make it right.

zh: 星期一下午，{name}背著書包回到家，手裡緊緊捏著一張考卷。英文拼字測驗只拿了六十分，紅筆畫的圈圈好多好多。老師說，考卷要帶回家給爸爸簽名，星期五再交回學校。
「{name}，今天在學校好玩嗎？」爸爸從廚房探出頭來問。{name}的心咚咚跳，趕快說：「還好啦！」然後一溜煙跑進房間，把考卷摺成小小一塊，塞進抽屜最裡面的襪子底下。
星期二，爸爸做了{name}最喜歡的番茄炒蛋，可是{name}吃起來一點都不香。星期三，爸爸講了好笑的笑話，{name}只勉強笑了一下。那張考卷好像變成一顆大石頭，沉甸甸地壓在{his}心上，走到哪裡都跟著。
星期四晚上，{name}躺在床上翻來覆去，怎麼也睡不著。{he}想：「爸爸知道了，會不會很失望？」可是明天就要交考卷了。{name}悄悄打開抽屜，拿出那張皺巴巴的紙，深深吸了一口氣。
{name}抱著考卷走到客廳。爸爸正在看書，抬起頭問：「怎麼還沒睡呀？」{name}的聲音小小的：「爸爸，我拼字考不好，還把考卷藏起來了，因為我怕你生氣。」說完，{name}的眼眶有點紅紅的。
爸爸放下書，把{name}抱到腿上，慢慢把考卷攤平。「謝謝你告訴我，」爸爸輕聲說，「把實話說出來，一定需要很大的勇氣吧？」{name}點點頭，心裡那顆大石頭，好像一下子變得輕飄飄的。
