On Saturday, Yun and a few classmates came over to {name}'s home. Grandma and Yun chatted away in sign language, faces bright, while the others raced to learn "orange" and "yummy." Laughter bounced around the living room. Grandma declared that Yun signed better than she did. At the door, Yun hooked her fingers at {name}, and {name} hooked back with a grin. No words were needed at all.

questions: 同學在背後笑小芸的時候，{name}一開始怎麼做？後來又做了什麼不一樣的事？
你身邊有沒有人看起來、聽起來或做事的方式跟你不一樣？你從他們身上發現了什麼有趣的地方？
如果你看到有人被嘲笑或被冷落，你可以說什麼或做什麼來陪伴他？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子一起上網查三個簡單的手語（例如「你好」、「謝謝」、「朋友」），每天晚餐時用手語互相打招呼。

questions: What did {name} do at first when kids laughed at Yun behind her back? What did {he} do differently later?
Do you know someone who looks, sounds, or does things differently from you? What interesting thing have you noticed about them?
If you saw someone being laughed at or left out, what could you say or do to stand by them?
en.tip: This week, look up three simple signs together (like "hello," "thank you," and "friend") and greet each other with them at dinner every night.

title.en: {name} and Bean the Turtle's Star Chart

zh: 星期一早上，林老師宣布一件事。「這週的烏龜小幫手是{name}！」{name}開心得跳起來。教室角落有個大水缸，裡面住著小烏龜豆豆。豆豆伸長脖子，好像在說：「你好呀！」
餵豆豆真好玩。{name}撒下一小匙飼料。豆豆慢慢游過來，嘴巴一開一合，一口就吞下去。小安在旁邊笑：「牠吃飯好像在點頭！」{name}也笑了，跟著數：「一口、兩口、三口！」
可是，清水缸就不好玩了。要用小網子撈葉子，還要擦玻璃。林老師幫忙換水，{name}負責刷石頭。石頭滑溜溜的，{name}縮了縮手說：「哎呀，好黏喔！」豆豆眨眨眼，好像在偷笑。
星期三，下課鐘一響，大家跑去操場玩。{name}溜滑梯、盪鞦韆，玩得好開心。放學時，{name}揹起書包就回家了。小網子還掛在水缸旁邊，一動也不動。
星期四早上，水缸變得霧霧的。水好混濁，什麼都看不清楚。豆豆把頭縮進殼裡，躲在石頭後面。小安小聲問：「咦，是誰沒清水缸？」{name}心裡怦怦跳。{he}想了想，舉起手說：「是我忘記了。」
林老師點點頭，拍拍{name}的肩膀。「謝謝你說實話。我們一起來幫豆豆吧！」{name}拿起網子，認真撈葉子。小安也來幫忙擦玻璃。老師換好清水，水缸又亮晶晶了。可是，豆豆還是不肯出來。
「我要怎樣才不會再忘記呢？」{name}拿出蠟筆，畫了一張圖表。上面有飼料、網子，還有一隻笑咪咪的烏龜。做完一件事，就貼一顆小星星。{name}把圖表貼在水缸旁邊。
星期五，老師在忙著改作業，沒有人盯著。{name}還是看看圖表，餵飼料、撈葉子，再洗洗手，貼上星星。這時候，豆豆慢慢探出頭來。牠爬上石頭，伸開四隻腳，在暖暖的燈下曬背。「豆豆，你出來啦！」{name}和小安笑成一團。
en: On Monday morning, Ms. Lin had big news. "This week's turtle helper is {name}!" {name} jumped up with joy. In the corner sat a big tank. A little turtle named Bean lived inside. Bean stretched out a long neck, as if to say hello.

Feeding Bean was so much fun. {name} sprinkled in one tiny spoon of food. Bean paddled over slowly. Open, close, gulp! An laughed, "Bean nods while eating!" {name} giggled and counted along. "One bite, two bites, three bites!"

But cleaning the tank was not fun. There were leaves to scoop with a little net. There was glass to wipe. Ms. Lin changed the water. {name} scrubbed the rocks. "Eww, so slippery!" Bean blinked, as if hiding a giggle.

On Wednesday, the bell rang for recess. Everyone ran out to play. {name} zoomed down the slide and flew on the swings. At home time, {name} grabbed {his} backpack and left. The little net hung by the tank, all alone.

On Thursday morning, the tank looked foggy. The water was so cloudy! Bean tucked in tight and hid behind a rock. An whispered, "Who forgot to clean it?" Thump, thump went {name}'s heart. Then {he} raised a hand. "I forgot. It was me."

Ms. Lin nodded and patted {name}'s shoulder. "Thank you for telling the truth. Let's help Bean together." {name} picked up the net and scooped every leaf. An wiped the glass. Ms. Lin poured in clean water. The tank sparkled. But Bean still stayed hidden.

"How can I remember next time?" {name} wondered. Out came the crayons. {name} drew a chart with food, a net, and a smiling turtle. Each finished job would get a little star. {name} stuck the chart right beside the tank.

On Friday, Ms. Lin was busy, and nobody was watching. Still, {name} checked the chart. Feed Bean. Scoop leaves. Wash hands. Add stars! Just then, Bean peeked out. Up onto the rock Bean climbed, legs stretched wide, sunbathing under the warm lamp. "Bean, you're back!" {name} and An giggled together.

questions: 水缸變混濁的時候，{name}說了什麼？你覺得那需要勇氣嗎？
{name}用什麼方法讓自己不再忘記照顧豆豆？
在家裡，你有什麼小任務是可以每天自己完成的？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起畫一張簡單的圖表，選一件小任務（像收玩具或餵植物喝水），每完成一次就貼一顆星星。

questions: What did {name} say when the water got cloudy? Do you think that took courage?
What did {name} make to remember to care for Bean?
What little job at home could you do by yourself every day?
en.tip: Tonight, draw a simple picture chart together for one small job, like tidying toys or watering a plant, and add a star each time it's done.

zh: 星期一早上，{name}把書包翻了個底朝天，心裡「咯噔」一聲。那本從學校圖書館借來的《章魚的祕密花園》，竟然不見了！今天就是還書日，書包裡卻只有便當盒、鉛筆盒，和一張皺巴巴的數學考卷。
{name}站在圖書館門口，腳像黏在地上一樣。一個念頭悄悄冒出來：「要是我假裝從來沒借過呢？說不定林老師根本不記得。」可是借書紀錄上，明明寫著{his}名字。{name}深吸一口氣，輕輕推開了門。
「林老師，對不起，」{name}的聲音小得像蚊子，「我把《章魚的祕密花園》弄丟了。我本來想說是家裡的貓麻糬叼走的，可是麻糬連餅乾都咬不動。」林老師噗哧一笑：「謝謝你直接告訴我。那你打算怎麼辦呢？」
放學回家後，{name}展開了地毯式搜索。床底下、沙發縫、玩具箱，連冰箱旁邊都看了一遍。麻糬跟在後面喵喵叫，好像也在幫忙。結果，{name}找到三顆彈珠、一隻襪子和一片餅乾屑，就是沒有那本書。
晚餐時，{name}抱出撲滿，把硬幣一枚一枚倒在桌上。「媽媽，如果真的找不到，我想用自己的零用錢賠一本新的。」媽媽有點驚訝：「這是你存了好久要買望遠鏡的錢呢。」{name}點點頭：「書是我借的，林老師還在等它回家。」
第二天，{name}帶著一袋叮噹作響的硬幣去找林老師，把搜索過程一五一十地說了。林老師沒有收錢，只說：「再等兩天吧，書常常躲在意想不到的地方。」那天下課，沒人提醒，{name}也把自己的抽屜整理得井井有條。
星期六，爸爸開車載全家去外婆家。車子一停，{name}彎腰去撿滾落的水壺，指尖卻碰到一個硬硬的書角。拉出來一看，正是《章魚的祕密花園》！原來它像真正的章魚一樣，縮在座椅底下的縫隙裡。
星期一，{name}雙手把書交給林老師。林老師翻開封底，裡面竟夾著一張歪歪扭扭的蠟筆章魚。「這是我小時候畫的，這本書是我的最愛，」她笑著說，「謝謝你這麼誠實又負責。」從那天起，{name}每次借書，都在月曆上畫一隻小章魚提醒還書日。
en: On Monday morning, {name} turned {his} backpack upside down, and {his} stomach did a flip. The library book, The Octopus's Secret Garden, was gone! Today was return day, but the backpack held only a lunch box, a pencil case, and one crumpled math test.

At the library door, {name}'s feet felt glued to the floor. A sneaky thought crept in: "What if I just pretend I never borrowed it? Maybe Ms. Lin won't remember." But the library record clearly showed {his} name. {name} took a deep breath and pushed the door open.

"Ms. Lin, I'm sorry," {name} said in a tiny voice. "I lost The Octopus's Secret Garden. I almost said our cat, Mochi, ran off with it, but Mochi can't even carry a cracker." Ms. Lin chuckled. "Thank you for telling me. So, what's your plan?"

After school, {name} began a full search party. Under the bed, between the sofa cushions, inside the toy box, even beside the fridge. Mochi trotted along, meowing as if helping out. {name} found three marbles, one lonely sock, and a cookie crumb, but no book.

At dinner, {name} carried out the piggy bank and poured the coins onto the table, one by one. "Mom, if I can't find it, I want to use my own money to buy a new one." Mom looked surprised. "But you've been saving that for a telescope." {name} nodded. "I borrowed it. Ms. Lin is waiting for it to come back."

The next day, {name} brought a jingling bag of coins to Ms. Lin and explained the whole search. Ms. Lin didn't take the money. "Let's wait two more days," she said. "Books love to hide in surprising places." At recess, with nobody asking, {name} tidied {his} desk drawer until everything sat neatly in rows.

On Saturday, Dad drove the family to Grandma's house. When the car stopped, {name} reached down for a rolling water bottle, and fingers bumped into the hard corner of a book. Out it came: The Octopus's Secret Garden! Just like a real octopus, it had squeezed into the gap under the seat.

On Monday, {name} handed the book to Ms. Lin with both hands. She opened the back cover, and there was a wobbly crayon octopus. "I drew that when I was little. This was my favorite book," she said, smiling. "Thank you for being so honest and responsible." From then on, whenever {name} borrowed a book, a tiny octopus on the calendar marked return day.

questions: {name}發現書不見時，本來想假裝沒借過，後來做了哪些事？
沒有人提醒，{name}也整理了抽屜。你有哪些事是不用別人說，自己就會做好的？
如果你弄丟或弄壞了別人的東西，你會怎麼說、怎麼幫忙補救？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子一起準備一張「還書／歸還月曆」，借來的書或物品就畫一個小圖示提醒歸還日，到期時讓孩子自己負責放回書包。

questions: When {name} first lost the book, {he} wanted to pretend it was never borrowed. What did {name} do instead?
{name} tidied the desk drawer even though no one asked. What is something you do well even when no one is watching?
If you lost or broke something that belonged to someone else, what would you say and how could you help fix it?
en.tip: This week, make a simple "return calendar" together: draw a small picture on the due date for any borrowed book or item, and let your child be in charge of packing it on that day.

zh: 高高的山坡上，開滿了黃色小花。{name}和奶奶來山上散步。奶奶在不遠處摘野莓。老松樹的樹洞裡，住著一窩蜜蜂。小蜜蜂嗡嗡飛過來，和{name}打招呼。「今天我要守門喔！」小蜜蜂得意地說。
守門，就是看清楚每隻飛來的蟲。是家人，才能請牠進門。一隻蜜蜂飛回來，腳上沾滿花粉。小蜜蜂聞一聞，是家的味道。「請進！」牠大聲說。{name}坐在旁邊的石頭上，笑著說：「你好認真喔！」
這時，一隻蝴蝶輕輕飛來。牠的翅膀是藍色的，閃閃發亮。蝴蝶在花朵上跳舞，轉了一圈又一圈。「哇，好漂亮！」小蜜蜂看呆了。牠一點一點離開門口，跟著蝴蝶飛進花叢裡。
{name}回頭看看老松樹。咦，有個黃黑條紋的影子在動。那是一隻胡蜂！牠躲在樹枝後面，悄悄爬向門口。牠想偷吃蜂巢裡的蜂蜜。{name}站在石頭旁，揮手大喊：「小蜜蜂，快回來！有胡蜂！」
小蜜蜂嚇了一跳，馬上飛回門口。「是我離開了，我來補救！」牠用力拍動翅膀，發出警報。嗡嗡嗡！嗡嗡嗡！{name}也跟著拍手幫忙。聲音傳進樹洞，也傳到花叢裡。
蜜蜂們一隻接一隻飛回來。牠們排在門口，一起嗡嗡叫。看起來像一道會唱歌的牆。胡蜂愣了一下。牠轉個身，飛到山的另一邊去了。蜂巢裡的蜂蜜，一滴也沒有少。
小蜜蜂飛到蜂后面前，低著頭說：「對不起，我剛才跑去看蝴蝶了。」蜂后笑著說：「你說實話，又馬上補救，真好。」一隻工蜂也說：「有你守門，我們才能安心採蜜。」小蜜蜂轉身說：「謝謝你，{name}！」
傍晚，奶奶提著一籃野莓走來。「{name}，我們回家囉。」蜜蜂們都進巢休息了。門口沒有誰在看著。小蜜蜂還是站得直直的。藍蝴蝶又飛過來，小蜜蜂揮揮翅膀說：「明天再看你，現在我要守門。」
en: High on a mountain slope, yellow flowers bloomed everywhere. {name} was out for a walk with Grandma. Grandma picked berries nearby. A family of bees lived in an old pine tree. Little Bee buzzed over to say hello. "Today I get to guard the door!" Little Bee said proudly.

A guard checks every bug that flies in. Only family may come inside. A bee flew home, legs dusty with pollen. Little Bee sniffed. It smelled like home. "Come in!" Little Bee called. {name} sat on a rock nearby and smiled. "You're doing great!"

Then a butterfly floated by. Its blue wings sparkled in the sun. It danced from flower to flower, around and around. "Wow, so pretty!" Little Bee stared. Bit by bit, Little Bee drifted away from the door, following it into the flowers.

{name} looked back at the pine tree. Something striped yellow and black was moving. It was a wasp! It hid behind a branch, creeping toward the door. It wanted the honey inside. {name} stood by the rock and waved. "Little Bee, come back! A wasp!"

Little Bee jumped and zoomed back to the door. "I left my spot. I'll fix it!" Little Bee beat both wings hard to sound the alarm. Bzzz! Bzzz! Bzzz! {name} clapped along to help. The sound rang into the hive and across the flowers.

Bees came flying home, one after another. They lined up at the door and buzzed together. They looked like a wall that could sing. The wasp paused. Then it turned and flew off over the mountain. Not one drop of honey was missing.

Little Bee flew to the Queen and bowed. "I'm sorry. I went to watch the butterfly." The Queen smiled. "You told the truth and fixed it fast." A worker bee added, "With you at the door, we can gather nectar safely." Little Bee turned. "Thank you, {name}!"

That evening, Grandma came with a basket of berries. "Time to go home, {name}." The other bees rested inside. Nobody was watching the door now. Still, Little Bee stood tall. The blue butterfly fluttered past again. Little Bee waved a wing. "See you tomorrow. Right now, I'm on guard."

questions: 小蜜蜂發現自己離開門口後，牠說了什麼、做了什麼？
最後沒有誰在看著，小蜜蜂為什麼還是站得直直的？
你在家裡有什麼小工作？如果忘記了，你會怎麼補救？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子一起選一件每天的小工作，例如澆花或收玩具，做完就說一句「這是我的工作，我做好了！」。

questions: What did Little Bee say and do after leaving the door?
Nobody was watching at the end. Why did Little Bee still stand guard?
What small job do you have at home? If you forget it, how could you fix it?
en.tip: This week, pick one small daily job together, like watering a plant or tidying toys, and after it's done, say, "That's my job, and I did it!"

zh: 校慶快到了，林老師抱來一條長長的布龍，紅色的身體上閃著金色的鱗片。「這條龍要靠全班一起舞動！」大家興奮得歡呼。{name}鑽到龍肚子底下，握緊一根竹竿，阿哲搶著扛龍頭，小美守在龍尾巴。
「預備，開始！」話音剛落，龍頭往前衝，龍尾往左跑，中間的人各走各的路。才轉一圈，布龍就扭成了一條大麻花，大家擠成一團，咯咯笑著倒在軟墊上。{name}從布底下探出頭來，龍尾巴正好垂在{his}肩膀上。
試了三次，龍還是打結。阿哲嘆口氣：「你們太慢了，我自己來！」他使出吃奶的力氣想把整條龍拉起來，可是龍身太長太重，才舉起龍頭，後面就軟趴趴地拖在地上，像一條睡著的大蟲。阿哲紅著臉放下竹竿，大家都安靜了。
這時，隔壁音樂教室傳來「咚、咚、咚」的鼓聲。{name}靈機一動：「如果我們都跟著同一個鼓聲走，會不會就不打結了？」小美舉手補充：「還可以一邊走一邊數拍子！」阿哲想了想說：「要轉彎時，我在龍頭喊一聲，大家就知道了。」
林老師借來一面大鼓。{name}先當鼓手，咚——咚——慢慢地敲。大家跟著拍子，一步、一步，龍身終於不再糾纏，像小河一樣彎彎地流動。練了一會兒，{name}把鼓棒交給小美，鑽回龍肚子下；接著輪到大偉，每個人都輪流當鼓手。
鼓聲越來越快，龍也越轉越靈活。有一次，大偉一腳踩錯拍子，差點被布纏住。前面的人立刻放慢腳步，後面的人輕輕扶住他的竹竿。「沒關係，跟著咚咚咚！」大家齊聲喊。大偉笑了，很快又跟上隊伍，龍身一下子就順了。
校慶當天，操場上擠滿了人。鼓聲一響，布龍昂起頭，忽高忽低、左盤右旋，鱗片在陽光下閃閃發亮，彷彿真的活了過來。更神奇的是，台下一年級的小朋友竟然跟著鼓聲拍起手來，「啪、啪、啪」，整個操場都變成了一面大鼓。
表演結束，大家從龍肚子底下鑽出來，笑得合不攏嘴。有人誇{name}的點子好，{name}卻指著小美和阿哲說：「是大家一起想、一起跳的！」阿哲拍拍龍頭笑著說：「這是我們全班的龍！」十雙小手同時舉起，擊了一次掌。
en: The school festival was coming, and Ms. Lin carried in a long cloth dragon with a red body and shimmering gold scales. "This dragon needs the whole class to dance!" Everyone cheered. {name} ducked under its belly and gripped a bamboo pole. Azhe grabbed the head, and Xiaomei took the tail.

"Ready, go!" The head charged forward, the tail scurried left, and everyone in the middle wandered their own way. After one turn, the dragon was twisted like a giant pretzel. The whole class tumbled onto the soft mat, giggling. {name} peeked out with the dragon's tail draped across {his} shoulders.

They tried three more times, and the dragon knotted every time. Azhe sighed. "You're all too slow. I'll do it alone!" He heaved with all his might, but the dragon was far too long and heavy. Only the head rose; the rest flopped on the floor like a sleepy worm. Azhe set the pole down, cheeks pink, and the room went quiet.

Just then, a drum boomed from the music room next door: dum, dum, dum. {name} had an idea. "What if we all follow one drum beat? Maybe we won't tangle!" Xiaomei's hand shot up. "We can count the beats out loud, too!" Azhe thought for a moment. "And I'll shout from the head whenever we turn."

Ms. Lin borrowed a big drum. {name} was the first drummer, tapping slowly: dum... dum... Step by step, everyone followed the beat, and the dragon stopped tangling. It curved and flowed like a little river. After a while, {name} passed the sticks to Xiaomei and ducked back under the dragon. Then it was Dawei's turn. Everyone took a turn drumming.

The beat grew faster, and the dragon swirled more nimbly. Once, Dawei stepped off the beat and nearly got wrapped in the cloth. The kids in front slowed right down, and the kids behind gently steadied his pole. "It's okay, just follow the dum-dum-dum!" they called together. Dawei grinned, caught up, and the dragon flowed smoothly again.

On festival day, the playground was packed. When the drum began, the dragon lifted its head, swooping high and low, coiling left and right, its scales flashing in the sun as if it were truly alive. Then something amazing happened. The first graders in the crowd started clapping along, clap, clap, clap, until the whole playground became one big drum.

When the dance ended, everyone wriggled out from under the dragon, grinning from ear to ear. Someone praised {name}'s idea, but {name} pointed to Xiaomei and Azhe. "We thought of it together, and we danced it together!" Azhe patted the dragon's head. "This is our whole class's dragon!" Ten pairs of hands flew up for one big high five.

questions: 阿哲想一個人舉起整條龍時，發生了什麼事？為什麼？
{name}、小美和阿哲各想出了什麼點子？把點子放在一起，有什麼不一樣？
你有沒有和別人一起完成過一件事？你們是怎麼輪流和互相幫忙的？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子玩「一起搬東西」的遊戲：兩人用一條毛巾一起運送一顆小球穿過客廳，邊走邊數「一、二、一、二」，數完後換孩子當喊口令的人。

questions: What happened when Azhe tried to lift the whole dragon alone? Why?
What ideas did {name}, Xiaomei, and Azhe each come up with? How did putting them together help?
Have you ever finished something together with other people? How did you take turns and help each other?
en.tip: This week, play a team-carry game: hold a towel between you and carry a small ball across the room while counting "one, two, one, two" together, then let your child be the one who calls the count.

title.zh: 一起找回貓頭鷹奶奶的眼鏡

zh: 森林邊有一片開滿小黃花的草地。每天傍晚，貓頭鷹奶奶都會戴上她的圓眼鏡，抬頭看星星，替森林畫出夜晚的地圖，讓小動物們找到回家的路。可是今天，她站在橡樹枝上，著急地拍著翅膀：「哎呀，我的眼鏡不見了！」
狐狸、兔子、刺蝟和{name}聽見了，馬上跑過來。「我們幫您找！」大家一說完，就各自衝進草地。狐狸往東邊跑，兔子往西邊跳，刺蝟往南邊滾，{name}往北邊走。草地好大，草又長又密，每個人都低著頭，一個人找呀找。
太陽慢慢往山後滑下去，大家回到橡樹下，你看看我，我看看你，手裡都是空的。兔子垂下耳朵：「草地太大了，我一個人找不完。」刺蝟也嘆了口氣：「我的腿太短，走不了多遠。」{name}想了想，說：「也許我們不要分開找，先一起想個辦法吧？」
狐狸抬起頭：「我的鼻子很靈，可以聞出貓頭鷹奶奶今天走過的路。」兔子豎起長耳朵：「我聽得見很小很小的聲音，眼鏡碰到石頭會叮一聲。」刺蝟說：「我最會鑽到落葉底下。」{name}點點頭：「我的眼睛很會找亮亮的東西。我們輪流來，好不好？」
狐狸先上場。牠把鼻子貼近地面，嗅嗅這裡，聞聞那裡：「這邊有貓頭鷹奶奶的羽毛味！」大家排成一排跟在後面，經過蒲公英，繞過大石頭，一直走到草地中間那棵老樹樁旁邊。狐狸停下來說：「味道在這裡最濃，接下來交給兔子吧！」
接著輪到兔子。大家都安安靜靜，連呼吸都放得好輕。一陣風吹過，樹樁旁的一堆落葉沙沙作響，接著傳來輕輕的一聲「叮」。兔子的耳朵一下子轉過去：「在那堆葉子裡！」刺蝟早就準備好了，開心地說：「換我了！」
刺蝟用鼻子把落葉一片一片推開，動作又輕又慢，怕把眼鏡弄壞。葉子越來越少，可是天色也越來越暗。忽然，最後一道夕陽照進來，{name}看見葉子縫裡閃了一下。「在那裡！」{name}小心地撿起圓圓的眼鏡，雙手捧著給大家看。
貓頭鷹奶奶戴上眼鏡時，天正好黑了，星星一顆顆亮起來。她很快畫好夜晚的地圖，還在角落畫了狐狸、兔子、刺蝟和{name}。「這張地圖，是我們大家一起完成的。」草地邊，{name}的家人提著燈籠揮手，大家笑著把地圖掛上橡樹，才一起踏上回家的路。
en: At the edge of the forest lay a meadow full of little yellow flowers. Every evening, Grandma Owl put on her round spectacles, studied the stars, and drew the forest's night map so small animals could find their way home. But today she flapped on her oak branch. "Oh dear, my spectacles are gone!"

Fox, Rabbit, Hedgehog, and {name} heard her and hurried over. "We'll help you look!" they said, and off they went in different directions. Fox ran east, Rabbit hopped west, Hedgehog rolled south, and {name} walked north. The meadow was huge, and the grass was long and thick.

As the sun slid toward the hills, everyone met back under the oak tree with empty paws and empty hands. Rabbit's ears drooped. "The meadow is too big for just me." Hedgehog sighed. "My legs are too short to go far." {name} thought for a moment. "Maybe we should stop searching alone and make a plan together."

Fox lifted his nose. "I can sniff out the path Grandma Owl walked today." Rabbit raised her long ears. "I can hear tiny sounds, like glass clinking on a stone." Hedgehog said, "I'm great at digging under leaves." {name} nodded. "I'm good at spotting shiny things. Let's take turns!"

Fox went first. He pressed his nose to the ground and sniffed here and there. "I smell Grandma Owl's feathers!" Everyone followed in a line, past the dandelions and around a big rock, all the way to an old tree stump. "The smell is strongest here," said Fox. "Rabbit, your turn!"

Everyone stood very still and breathed very softly so Rabbit could listen. A breeze swept by, and a pile of leaves beside the stump rustled. Then came a tiny clink. Rabbit's ears swiveled. "It's in those leaves!" Hedgehog was already waiting. "My turn!" he said happily.

Hedgehog nudged the leaves away one by one, gently and slowly, so nothing would break. The pile grew smaller, but the sky grew darker. Then the last ray of sunset slipped through, and {name} saw a little flash between the leaves. "There!" {name} carefully picked up the round spectacles and held them out for everyone to see.

Just as Grandma Owl put on her spectacles, night arrived and the stars twinkled on. She drew the night map, and in the corner she added Fox, Rabbit, Hedgehog, and {name}. "We made this map together," she said. At the meadow's edge, {name}'s family waved a lantern, and after hanging the map on the oak, everyone headed home.

questions: 大家一個人分開找的時候，發生了什麼事？後來一起找又有什麼不一樣？
狐狸、兔子、刺蝟和{name}各自最擅長什麼？你覺得自己最擅長什麼？
如果你和家人要一起整理房間，你們可以怎麼輪流和分工？
zh.tip: 這週挑一件家事，例如收玩具或擺碗筷，請孩子說出一個分工的點子，大家輪流完成後一起擊掌說：「我們一起做到了！」

questions: What happened when everyone searched alone, and what changed when they worked together?
What was Fox, Rabbit, Hedgehog, and {name} each best at? What do you think you are good at?
If our family cleaned up a room together, how could we take turns and share the jobs?
en.tip: This week, pick one chore, like tidying toys or setting the table, and ask your child to suggest how to split the jobs. When you finish, give a high five and say, "We did it together!"

zh: 媽媽生病了。媽媽躺在床上，咳咳，咳咳。爸爸說：「今晚我們來煮晚餐！」{name}拍拍手。姊姊也拍拍手。啪啪啪！姊姊說：「好多事要做喔。」爸爸笑一笑：「一個人太忙，三個人剛剛好！」
大家走進廚房。爸爸說：「我來切菜。」姊姊說：「我來攪麵。」{name}想一想。「我來洗菜！」嘩啦啦，水流出來了。{name}洗青菜，洗紅蘿蔔。搓一搓，揉一揉，洗得亮晶晶。
番茄滑溜溜。咻！番茄滾走了。{name}追著番茄跑。「抓到了！」姊姊哈哈笑。爸爸也哈哈笑。{name}再洗一次，交給爸爸。咚咚咚，爸爸切番茄。
姊姊站在鍋子旁邊。爸爸就在旁邊陪著。攪一攪，轉一轉。麵條在鍋裡跳舞。姊姊說：「手好痠喔。」爸爸說：「換我攪，妳休息。」{name}端來一杯水，給姊姊喝。
「我來擺桌子！」{name}說。一個碗，兩個碗，三個碗，四個碗。一雙筷子，兩雙筷子……咦？少一雙！{name}跑回去拿。四雙筷子，剛剛好！
姊姊說：「桌子空空的。」{name}說：「放一朵花好不好？」爸爸說：「好主意！」姊姊說：「再做一張卡片！」{name}畫一顆大愛心。姊姊寫上：「媽媽快好起來！」
麵煮好了，香噴噴！媽媽慢慢走來坐下。媽媽吃一口。「哇，有一點鹹喔！」爸爸抓抓頭。姊姊吐吐舌頭。原來兩個人都加了鹽！大家哈哈大笑。
媽媽喝一口水，又吃一口麵。媽媽笑瞇瞇。「這是最好吃的晚餐！因為是大家一起做的。」{name}抱抱媽媽。爸爸說：「下次加鹽前，先問一問！」一家人一起吃，一起笑。
en: Mom is sick today. She rests in bed. Cough, cough. Dad says, "Let's make dinner tonight!" {name} claps. Big sister claps too. Clap, clap, clap! "So many jobs," says Sister. Dad smiles. "Too much for one. Just right for three!"

Everyone goes to the kitchen. "I will chop," says Dad. "I will stir," says Sister. {name} thinks hard. "I will wash!" Splash, splash goes the water. {name} washes the greens and carrots. Rub, rub, scrub!
The tomato is slippery. Whoosh! It rolls away. {name} chases it across the floor. "Got you!" Sister giggles. Dad laughs too. {name} washes it again and hands it to Dad. Chop, chop, chop!

Sister stands by the pot. Dad stays right beside her. Stir, stir, round and round. The noodles dance in the pot. "My arm is tired," says Sister. "My turn," says Dad. {name} brings Sister a cup of water.
"I will set the table!" says {name}. One bowl, two bowls, three bowls, four. One pair of chopsticks, two pairs... Oops! One is missing. {name} runs back for more. Four pairs. Just right!
"The table looks empty," says Sister. "Can we add a flower?" asks {name}. "Great idea!" says Dad. "Let's make a card too!" says Sister. {name} draws a big heart. Sister writes, "Get well soon, Mom!"

The noodles are ready. Yum, they smell good! Mom comes slowly to the table. She takes a bite. "Oh! A little salty!" Dad scratches his head. Sister sticks out her tongue. They both added salt! Everyone laughs.

Mom sips some water. Then she eats more noodles. She smiles big. "This is the best dinner ever. Everyone made it together!" {name} gives Mom a hug. "Next time, we ask before adding salt," says Dad. Everyone eats and laughs together.

questions: {name}、爸爸和姊姊各做了什麼工作？
姊姊手痠的時候，大家怎麼幫忙？
如果我們家一起做一件事，你想負責什麼？
zh.tip: 這個星期找一件家事，例如擺碗筷或收玩具，讓每個人選一個小任務，完成後一起說：「我們一起做到了！」

questions: What job did {name}, Dad, and Sister each do?
How did everyone help when Sister's arm got tired?
If our family did a job together, what part would you like to do?
en.tip: This week, pick one chore, like setting the table or tidying toys, and let everyone choose a small task. When you finish, cheer together: "We did it together!"

title.en: Dudu Says, Your Turn to Brush!

zh: 天黑了，月亮出來了。{name}抱著恐龍嘟嘟，走進浴室。嘟嘟是綠色的玩具恐龍。嘟嘟的嘴巴大大的，牙齒一排排。嘟嘟總是在笑，笑嘻嘻！
每天晚上，{name}都先幫嘟嘟刷牙。拿起小牙刷，刷刷刷。前面的牙，刷一刷。後面的牙，刷一刷。輕輕的，轉小圈圈。嘟嘟的牙齒亮晶晶！
今晚，嘟嘟好像在說話。「吼！換你了！」{name}眨眨眼睛。嘟嘟又笑了，好像在說：「快點，快點！」{name}咯咯笑：「好啦，換我！」
媽媽擠了一點點牙膏。小小一顆，像一粒豆豆。{name}張開嘴巴，啊——。牙刷碰碰前面的牙。上上下下，刷刷刷。轉轉小圈圈，輕輕的。
接著刷後面的牙。後面的牙躲起來了！{name}找到它們，刷刷刷。左邊刷一刷，右邊刷一刷。一顆也不漏掉。嘟嘟在旁邊看，笑嘻嘻。
媽媽說：「我來幫你刷完。」媽媽輕輕刷，轉轉轉。「糖糖蟲，走開囉！」{name}笑出聲：「糖糖蟲，拜拜！」咕嚕咕嚕，漱漱口，吐出來。
{name}看著鏡子，咧嘴一笑。哇！牙齒亮晶晶！鏡子裡的嘟嘟也在笑。兩個大大的笑臉，一閃一閃。{name}說：「嘟嘟，我們一樣亮！」
嘟嘟好像又說：「明天早上，也要刷喔！」{name}點點頭：「早上刷，晚上刷！」{name}抱著嘟嘟，爬上床。燈關了，好安靜。晚安，嘟嘟。晚安，{name}。
en: Night has come. The moon is up. {name} carries Dudu to the bathroom. Dudu is a green toy dinosaur. Dudu has a big mouth full of teeth. Dudu always grins. Grin, grin!
Every night, {name} brushes Dudu's teeth first. Brush, brush, brush! Front teeth, brush them. Back teeth, brush them. Gently, in little circles. Dudu's teeth sparkle!
Tonight, Dudu seems to talk. "Rawr! Your turn!" {name} blinks. Dudu grins again, as if to say, "Hurry, hurry!" {name} giggles. "Okay, my turn!"
Mom squeezes out a tiny dot of toothpaste. It looks like a little pea. {name} opens wide. Ahhh! Brush the front teeth. Up and down. Little circles, round and round.
Now the back teeth. They like to hide! {name} finds them. Brush, brush, brush. This side, that side. Every single tooth. Dudu watches and grins.
Mom says, "I'll help you finish." She brushes gently, round and round. "Sugar bugs, go away!" {name} laughs. "Bye-bye, sugar bugs!" Swish, swish, spit!
{name} grins at the mirror. Wow! Sparkly teeth! Dudu grins in the mirror too. Two big smiles, shining bright. "Dudu, we both sparkle!"
Dudu seems to say, "Again in the morning!" {name} nods. "Morning and night!" {name} hugs Dudu and climbs into bed. Lights off. So quiet. Goodnight, Dudu. Goodnight, {name}.

questions: {name}刷牙的時候，前面和後面的牙齒是怎麼刷的？
刷完以後，誰來幫{name}刷完？你刷牙時，誰會幫你？
嘟嘟說明天早上也要刷，你什麼時候會刷牙呢？
zh.tip: 今晚讓孩子先幫一個玩偶刷牙，再換孩子自己用小圈圈刷，最後由您幫忙刷完，一起說：「糖糖蟲，拜拜！」

questions: How did {name} brush the front teeth and the back teeth?
Who helped {name} finish brushing? Who helps you?
Dudu said to brush again in the morning. When do you brush your teeth?
en.tip: Tonight, let your child brush a favorite toy's teeth first, then brush their own in little circles while you help finish, and say together, "Bye-bye, sugar bugs!"

zh: 天黑了，月亮出來了。窗外下著小雨。媽媽關掉電視，平板也關機了。「螢幕要睡覺囉。」媽媽說。「眼睛也要休息。」{name}點點頭。「我們來玩安靜遊戲！」
先來洗澡。嘩啦嘩啦，水暖暖的。泡泡圓圓的，泡泡滑滑的。{name}洗洗小手，洗洗小腳。毛巾軟軟的，香香的。爸爸抱一抱，擦乾乾。
再來穿睡衣。睡衣軟綿綿，睡衣暖呼呼。一隻手，伸進去。另一隻手，伸進去。兩隻小腳，也穿好了。好舒服，好舒服。{name}輕輕笑了。
接著刷牙。刷刷刷，上面刷一刷。刷刷刷，下面刷一刷。咕嚕咕嚕，漱漱口。牙齒亮晶晶。{name}對著鏡子，笑一個大大的笑。
然後是故事時間。{name}爬上小床。被子暖暖的，枕頭軟軟的。媽媽慢慢念故事。小熊打哈欠，小兔閉眼睛。{name}也打了一個哈欠。
爸爸把燈調暗。燈光黃黃的，好柔和。媽媽輕輕哼歌。嗯～嗯～嗯～。貓咪咪咪走進來。牠在地毯上，捲成一團。「噓。」爸爸小聲說。「仔細聽喔。」
滴答，滴答，是時鐘。呼嚕，呼嚕，是咪咪。滴滴，答答，是雨點敲窗。好安靜，好安靜。「睡覺時，身體會長大。」媽媽小聲說。「明天就有力氣玩。」
{name}開始數數。一、二、三……四、五、六……七……八……九還沒數到，{name}就睡著了。咪咪也睡著了。雨也輕輕的。晚安，{name}。晚安，好夢。
en: The sky is dark. The moon is up. Soft rain falls outside. Mom turns off the TV. The tablet goes off too. "Screens sleep now," Mom says. "Then our eyes can rest." {name} nods. "Let's play the quiet game!"
First comes the bath. Splash, splash! The water is warm. The bubbles are round and slippery. {name} washes little hands. {name} washes little feet. The towel is soft. Dad gives a big, snug hug.
Next come pajamas. Soft and warm, soft and warm. One arm goes in. The other arm goes in. Two little feet go in too. Cozy, cozy, cozy. {name} gives a happy sigh.
Then it's time to brush. Brush, brush, brush the top. Brush, brush, brush the bottom. Swish, swish, spit! Teeth are clean and shiny. {name} smiles big at the mirror.
Now it's story time. {name} climbs into bed. The blanket is warm. The pillow is soft. Mom reads very slowly. Little Bear yawns. Little Bunny closes his eyes. {name} yawns too.
Dad turns the lights down low. The light glows soft and gold. Mom hums a gentle tune. Mmm, mmm, mmm. Mimi the cat pads in. She curls up on the rug. "Shh," Dad whispers. "Listen."
Tick, tock, goes the clock. Purr, purr, goes Mimi. Pitter, patter, goes the rain on the window. So quiet. So quiet. "Sleep helps you grow," Mom whispers. "Tomorrow you can play again."
{name} starts to count. One, two, three... Four, five, six... Seven... eight... Before nine, {name} is fast asleep. Mimi is asleep too. The rain is soft. Goodnight, {name}. Sweet dreams.

questions: {name}睡覺前做了哪些事？我們睡前也做哪些事呢？
為什麼媽媽要讓螢幕先睡覺？
你今晚躺在床上時，可以聽到哪些安靜的聲音？
zh.tip: 今晚關燈後，和孩子一起玩「安靜遊戲」：輕聲說出聽到的三種小聲音，再慢慢數到十。

questions: What did {name} do before bed? What do we do before bed?
Why did Mom turn the screens off first?
What quiet sounds can you hear in your bed tonight?
en.tip: Tonight after lights out, play the quiet game together: whisper three tiny sounds you hear, then slowly count to ten.

zh: 傍晚，廚房飄出香香的味道。爸爸掀開蒸鍋，白煙冒了出來。「今天吃清蒸魚喔！」爸爸笑著說。{name}坐在餐桌旁，伸長脖子看。盤子裡有一條魚，上面鋪著細細的蔥絲。{name}眨眨眼睛，小聲問：「魚裡面有刺嗎？」
爸爸把魚端到桌上。「有一些小刺，很細很細。」{name}皺起眉頭說：「我怕刺刺到嘴巴。」說完，{name}把碗推遠一點。爸爸摸摸{his}頭，溫柔地說：「沒關係，我們只試一小口就好。不喜歡也可以喔。」
爸爸說：「吃新東西，就像去探險。先用眼睛看看。」{name}仔細地看。魚肉白白的，亮亮的。蔥絲綠綠的，像一根根小草。「再用鼻子聞聞。」{name}湊近一點，吸一口氣。香香的，還有一點點薑的味道。
「現在，看爸爸怎麼做。」爸爸拿起筷子，夾起一小塊魚肉。他慢慢撥開軟軟的魚肉。「看，刺躲在這裡。」爸爸把細刺放到旁邊的小盤子上。「這是骨頭盤，刺都住這裡。」{name}睜大了眼睛。
爸爸夾了一小塊給{name}。「先吹一吹，等它不燙。」{name}呼呼吹了兩下。接著，{name}拿起筷子，學爸爸慢慢撥。撥呀撥，魚肉散開了。哎呀！筷子一滑，魚肉掉回碗裡。{name}嘆了一口氣。爸爸說：「慢慢來，再試一次。」
{name}再夾一次，這次夾得穩穩的。{name}輕輕撥開魚肉。咦？有一根白白的小刺！{name}小心地夾起來，放到骨頭盤上。「爸爸，我自己找到的！」爸爸開心地拍拍手：「哇，你是尋刺小偵探！」
{name}把魚肉放進嘴裡，小口小口慢慢嚼。魚肉軟軟的，滑滑的。蔥絲脆脆的，還有一點甜。「味道怎麼樣？」爸爸問。{name}想一想，點點頭。爸爸笑著說：「我小時候不喜歡吃魚。現在，魚是我最愛的菜。」
{name}笑了，把碗遞給爸爸。「我還要一塊！」這次，{name}自己慢慢找，又找到一根刺。骨頭盤上多了兩根小刺，排得整整齊齊。窗外天色暗了，餐桌上暖暖的。{name}心裡想：明天，也許可以再試試別的新菜。
en: Evening came, and the kitchen smelled yummy. Dad lifted the steamer lid. White steam puffed out. "Steamed fish for dinner!" Dad said. {name} sat at the table and peeked. Thin green onions covered the fish. "Does fish have bones?" {name} whispered.

Dad set the plate down. "Yes, some tiny, thin ones." {name} frowned. "I don't want bones in my mouth." {name} pushed the bowl away a little. Dad patted {his} head. "That's okay. Let's try one small bite. You don't have to like it."

"New food is like exploring," Dad said. "First, use your eyes." {name} looked closely. The fish was white and shiny. The green onions looked like tiny grass. "Now use your nose." {name} leaned in and sniffed. It smelled warm, with a little ginger.

"Now watch me," said Dad. He picked up a small piece of fish. Slowly, he pulled the soft meat apart. "Look, here's a bone." He set it on a little dish. "This is the bone plate." {name}'s eyes grew wide.

Dad gave {name} a small piece. "Blow on it first, so it's not hot." {name} blew, whoosh, whoosh. Then {name} poked the fish with chopsticks, just like Dad. Oops! The piece slipped back into the bowl. {name} sighed. "Take your time," Dad said. "Try again."

{name} tried once more. This time the chopsticks held tight. {name} gently opened the fish. Wait, what was that? A tiny white bone! {name} lifted it onto the bone plate. "Dad, I found it all alone!" Dad clapped. "Wow, a bone detective!"

{name} took a small bite and chewed slowly. The fish was soft and smooth. The green onions went crunch, a little sweet. "How is it?" Dad asked. {name} thought, then nodded. Dad smiled. "When I was little, I didn't like fish. Now it's my favorite."

{name} grinned and held out the bowl. "Can I have another piece?" This time, {name} searched slowly and found another bone. Two little bones sat side by side on the bone plate. Outside, the sky grew dark. Inside, the table felt warm. Maybe tomorrow, {name} could try something new again.

questions: {name}吃魚之前，用眼睛和鼻子發現了什麼？
爸爸小時候不喜歡吃魚，後來怎麼了？你有沒有以前不喜歡、現在喜歡的食物？
如果桌上有一道你沒吃過的菜，你會怎麼像{name}一樣去探險？
zh.tip: 這週吃飯時玩「食物探險家」遊戲：一起說說新食物的顏色、味道、聲音，再一起試一小口，不喜歡也沒關係。

questions: What did {name} notice with eyes and nose before tasting the fish?
Dad didn't like fish when he was little. What happened later? Is there a food you like now that you didn't like before?
If a new food is on the table, how could you explore it like {name}?
en.tip: This week, play "Food Explorer" at dinner: describe a new food's color, smell, and crunch together, then each take one small bite, and it's fine not to like it.

zh: 美勞課開始了！林老師發給大家一團灰色黏土。{name}捏呀捏，捏出圓圓的殼。再搓出四隻小腳，和一顆小小的頭。「是一隻小烏龜！」{name}開心地說。小烏龜趴在桌上，好像準備去探險。
可是，{name}低頭一看，哇！手指黏黏的，掌心灰灰的。連指甲縫裡，都藏著黏土。「我的手變成烏龜殼了！」大家都笑了。這時，鈴聲叮叮噹噹響起來。點心時間快到了。
林老師說：「吃點心前，要先洗手喔。」{name}點點頭，舉起黏黏的小手。「出發！去洗手台探險！」{name}走過積木區，又走過圖書角。小烏龜在桌上等著，好像在說加油。
洗手台旁，貼著一張大海報。上面畫著五個步驟：濕、抹、搓、沖、擦。這時，米亞從操場跑回來。「我剛玩溜滑梯，也要洗手。」浩浩從廁所走出來，也排在後面。三個小探險家，一起站好了。
第一步，打開水龍頭，把手弄濕。第二步，按一下肥皂。白白的泡泡冒出來了！{name}聞一聞，香香的！第三步最重要，要認真搓。手心搓手心，手背也要搓。手指交叉，像在玩捉迷藏。
還有大拇指，一根一根轉圈搓。指甲在手心刮一刮。藏起來的黏土跑出來了！「要搓多久呢？」{name}問。米亞說：「唱完一首生日快樂歌！」三個人一起小聲唱。泡泡越來越多，越來越白。
第四步，用清水沖一沖。灰灰的泥水，在洗手台裡轉呀轉。轉成一個小漩渦，咕嚕咕嚕溜下去了！「再見，黏土！」{name}笑著說。第五步，拿紙巾把手擦乾。{his}小手摸起來滑滑的，好乾淨！
回到座位，點心是香蕉和小餅乾。林老師笑著說：「手乾淨，細菌就不會跑進嘴巴。」「也不會傳給好朋友喔。」{name}拿起餅乾，咬了一大口。小烏龜趴在旁邊，好像也在笑。今天的洗手探險，成功了！
en: Art class began! Ms. Lin gave everyone a lump of gray clay. {name} squished and rolled it into a round shell. Then came four little legs and a tiny head. "It's a turtle!" {name} cheered. The turtle sat on the table, ready for adventure.

Then {name} looked down. Oh my! Sticky fingers! Gray palms! Clay was even hiding under {his} nails. "My hands turned into turtle shells!" Everyone giggled. Just then, the bell went ding-dong. Snack time was almost here.

"Please wash your hands before snack," said Ms. Lin. {name} nodded and held up two sticky hands. "Off we go! Sink adventure!" Past the block corner and the book nook went {name}. The clay turtle waited on the table, cheering quietly.

A big poster hung beside the sink. It showed five steps: wet, soap, scrub, rinse, dry. Just then, Mia came in from the playground. "I played on the slide. I need to wash too." Hao came out of the bathroom and lined up behind them. Three little explorers stood in a row.

Step one: turn on the tap and wet your hands. Step two: one squirt of soap. White bubbles foamed up! {name} sniffed. Mmm, it smelled sweet! Step three was the big one: scrub well. Palm to palm. The back of each hand. Fingers laced together, playing hide-and-seek.

Thumbs got a twisty scrub, one and then the other. Nails scratched gently on each palm. Out came the hiding clay! "How long do we scrub?" asked {name}. "One happy birthday song!" said Mia. All three sang softly. The bubbles grew bigger and whiter.

Step four: rinse with clean water. Gray water swirled around the sink. It spun into a tiny whirlpool and gurgled down the drain. "Bye-bye, clay!" {name} laughed. Step five: dry with a paper towel. Now {his} hands felt smooth and squeaky clean.

Back at the table, snack was bananas and crackers. Ms. Lin smiled. "Clean hands keep germs out of our mouths." "And away from our friends, too." {name} took a big, crunchy bite. The clay turtle seemed to smile. The handwashing adventure was a success!

questions: {name}的手沾滿黏土時，{he}是怎麼一步一步把手洗乾淨的？
米亞和浩浩為什麼也來洗手？你什麼時候也需要洗手呢？
搓手的時候要唱一首歌，你想唱哪一首歌來洗手？
zh.tip: 這週吃飯前，和孩子一起邊洗手邊唱一首生日快樂歌，記得搓手心、手背、指縫、大拇指和指甲。

questions: When {name}'s hands were covered in clay, how did {he} wash them step by step?
Why did Mia and Hao come to wash their hands too? When do you need to wash yours?
You sing a song while you scrub. Which song would you like to sing?
en.tip: Before meals this week, wash hands together while singing one happy birthday song, scrubbing palms, backs, between fingers, thumbs, and nails.

zh: 星期六早上，城市的街道上車子來來往往。{name}牽著媽媽的手，走進一棟高高的大樓，來到樓上的牙醫診所。前幾天刷牙時，{name}發現後面一顆牙齒有個小黑點，媽媽說那是小蛀牙，今天要請醫生把它補起來。
候診室裡有一個魚缸，小金魚慢慢游來游去。可是{name}一點也看不進去，{his}心臟撲通撲通跳得好快，像有一隻小兔子在胸口蹦蹦跳。「媽媽，會不會很可怕？」{name}小聲地問。媽媽握緊{his}小手說：「我會一直陪在你旁邊喔。」
「{name}，輪到你囉！」林醫生戴著口罩，眼睛彎彎的在笑。{name}坐上一張會慢慢升高的大椅子，頭頂有一盞亮亮的燈。林醫生拿起一面小圓鏡說：「我先來數數你的牙齒，看看每一顆是不是都健康。一、二、三……」數完後她說：「二十四顆，大部分都好棒！」
林醫生舉起一根細細的管子：「這是『小吸管先生』，它會把嘴巴裡的口水吸走，聲音像在喝珍珠奶茶，咻嚕嚕！」{name}忍不住笑了出來。接著她又拿起一支小噴槍：「這是『風風槍』，會吹出一點點涼涼的風。」呼——真的好涼，像微風吹過牙齒。
「最後這個叫『嗡嗡刷』，它會把蛀牙的小黑點清乾淨。它的聲音有點吵，像一隻小蜜蜂。」林醫生說，「如果你想休息，就舉起右手，我會馬上停下來等你。」{name}點點頭，把右手輕輕放在肚子上，準備好了。
嗡嗡刷一開始響，{name}的心又跳快了。{name}慢慢舉起右手，嗡嗡聲立刻停了下來。林醫生溫柔地說：「我們一起深呼吸，不用急。」{name}吸氣、吐氣，覺得好多了。林醫生問：「你最喜歡哪一首歌？」沒多久，診所裡就響起了那首熟悉的歌。
跟著音樂，{name}在心裡輕輕哼著，還偷偷數著拍子。嗡嗡刷嗡嗡叫，小吸管先生咻嚕嚕，好像大家一起在合唱。歌還沒唱完，林醫生就說：「好了！小蛀牙已經補好囉。」{name}眨眨眼睛：「已經結束了嗎？比我想的還要快！」
林醫生拿出一大張貼紙，上面有小火箭、彩虹，還有一隻綠色的恐龍。{name}選了恐龍，把它貼在手背上。走出大樓，城市的陽光暖暖的。{name}牽著媽媽的手說：「下次我要讓林醫生數到二十四顆，每一顆都健康！」
en: On Saturday morning, cars hummed along the busy city streets. {name} held Mom's hand and rode the elevator up a tall building to the dentist's office. A few days ago, {name} had spotted a tiny dark dot on a back tooth. It was a small cavity, and today it would get fixed.

In the waiting room, goldfish swam slowly around a tank. But {name} could hardly watch them. Thump, thump, thump went {his} heart, like a little rabbit hopping inside. "Mom, will it be scary?" {name} whispered. Mom squeezed {his} hand. "I'll stay right next to you the whole time."

"{name}, it's your turn!" Dr. Lin's eyes crinkled with a smile above her mask. {name} climbed into a big chair that rose up slowly under a bright lamp. Dr. Lin held up a tiny round mirror. "First, I'll count your teeth and check that each one is healthy. One, two, three..." Then she said, "Twenty-four, and most of them are great!"

Dr. Lin lifted a thin tube. "This is Mr. Slurpy Straw. He sips up the spit in your mouth. Listen, slurrrp!" {name} giggled. Next she held up a little nozzle. "This is the Breezy Blower. It puffs out a tiny cool wind." Whoosh! It felt like a soft breeze tickling {his} tooth.

"The last one is the Buzzy Brush. It cleans away the dark dot. It's a little noisy, like a busy bee," Dr. Lin said. "If you need a break, just raise your right hand, and I'll stop and wait for you." {name} nodded, rested a hand on {his} tummy, and got ready.

When the Buzzy Brush started, {name}'s heart began to race again. {name} slowly raised a hand, and the buzzing stopped right away. "Let's take a deep breath together. No hurry," Dr. Lin said gently. In, out. Much better. "What's your favorite song?" she asked, and soon that very song filled the room.

{name} hummed along quietly and counted the beats. The Buzzy Brush buzzed, Mr. Slurpy Straw slurped, and it all sounded like a funny little band. Before the song even ended, Dr. Lin said, "All done! Your tooth is fixed." {name} blinked. "Already? That was so much faster than I thought!"

Dr. Lin brought out a sheet of stickers with rockets, rainbows, and a bright green dinosaur. {name} picked the dinosaur and pressed it onto the back of {his} hand. Outside, the city sunshine felt warm. Holding Mom's hand, {name} said, "Next time, I want Dr. Lin to count twenty-four healthy teeth!"

questions: 林醫生一開始為什麼要數{name}的牙齒？
你最喜歡哪一個工具的名字？它會發出什麼聲音？
如果看牙醫時你想休息一下，你可以怎麼做？
zh.tip: 今晚刷牙時，玩一個「數牙齒」遊戲：大人用小鏡子幫孩子數牙齒，並練習「舉手就停」——孩子一舉手，大人就停下來等一等。

questions: Why did Dr. Lin count {name}'s teeth at the start?
Which tool name did you like best, and what sound did it make?
If you need a break at the dentist, what can you do?
en.tip: Tonight at toothbrushing time, play a counting game with a small mirror, and practice "raise a hand to pause": whenever your child raises a hand, stop brushing and wait together.

zh: 早上的海邊好安靜，海水退得遠遠的，露出一條長長的沙洲。{name}提著小水桶，跟爸爸一起走上濕濕軟軟的沙子。爸爸拿出手機看了看：「潮水十點半會回來。海水回來的速度，比看起來快很多喔。」{name}點點頭，把這個時間牢牢記在心裡。
沙洲上到處都是寶藏。{name}撿到一顆小小的螺旋貝殼，還看見一隻寄居蟹背著家慢慢爬過。遠處有一艘漁船經過，船上的叔叔阿姨都穿著橘色救生衣。爸爸說：「只要坐船，或是到比較深的海裡，救生衣一定要穿好。」{name}覺得那些亮橘色，好像一顆顆小太陽。
走著走著，{name}發現遠方有一個好大的白色貝殼，在陽光下閃閃發亮。可是那裡的海水顏色比較深。「爸爸，我可以過去拿嗎？」爸爸蹲下來，溫柔地說：「我們只待在腳踩得到底、爸爸就在旁邊的地方。」{name}望著那個貝殼，心裡好捨不得。
爸爸又看了一次手機，已經十點二十分了。這時候，沙洲上的小水溝開始慢慢裝滿海水，涼涼的水悄悄繞過{name}的腳踝。{name}深吸一口氣，轉身牽起爸爸的手：「我們回去吧！」兩個人一起踩著淺淺的水，穩穩地走回乾乾的沙灘。
他們坐在沙灘上回頭看。一道道小浪捲過來，沙洲越變越窄，最後整個不見了，連那個大貝殼也被藏到海浪底下。{name}睜大眼睛：「才一下下耶！」爸爸笑著說：「對呀，所以我們看好時間，早一點回來。」{name}覺得心裡暖暖的。
救生站旁，救生員林叔叔正在跟幾個小朋友玩遊戲。他在沙灘上放了一個紅色三角錐，假裝是水裡需要幫忙的朋友。「如果朋友在水裡有危險，要怎麼辦？」有人喊：「跳下去救他！」林叔叔搖搖頭：「不跳下去。先大聲叫大人，再丟會浮的東西給他。」
輪到{name}了。{name}先大喊：「救命！快來大人！」然後用力丟出救生圈，可是繩子纏在一起，救生圈掉在半路上。{name}咬咬嘴唇，把繩子一圈一圈理好，抓緊尾端，手臂低低地往前一甩。救生圈飛了出去，剛好落在三角錐旁邊！
小朋友們都拍起手來。林叔叔對{name}比了一個大拇指，爸爸也笑得好開心。回家的路上，{name}把小螺旋貝殼放在耳邊聽海的聲音，說：「下次退潮，我們再一起看手機上的時間，好不好？」爸爸用力點頭：「一言為定！」
en: The beach was quiet that morning. The sea had pulled far back, leaving a long sandbar shining in the sun. {name} carried a little bucket and walked out with Dad. Dad checked his phone. "The tide comes back at ten thirty. The sea returns faster than it looks." {name} nodded and remembered the time.

The sandbar was full of treasures. {name} found a tiny spiral shell and watched a hermit crab carry its home across the sand. Far away, a fishing boat chugged past. Everyone on board wore an orange life jacket. "On a boat or in deep water, life jackets go on every time," Dad said.

Then {name} spotted a big white shell glittering much farther out, where the water turned dark blue. "Dad, can I go get it?" Dad knelt down. "We stay where our feet can touch the bottom, and where I'm right beside you." {name} looked at the shell for a long moment. It was hard to leave it.

Dad checked his phone again. Ten twenty. Little channels across the sandbar were filling up, and cool water curled around {name}'s ankles. {name} took a deep breath and reached for Dad's hand. "Let's go back!" Together they splashed through the shallow water, step by steady step, all the way to the dry beach.

They sat on the warm sand and looked back. Small waves rolled in, and the sandbar grew thinner and thinner until it vanished, big shell and all. "That was so fast!" said {name}. Dad smiled. "That's why we watched the time and came back early." {name} felt warm inside.

By the lifeguard station, a lifeguard named Mr. Lin was playing a game with some kids. A red cone on the sand stood for a friend who needed help in the water. "What do you do if a friend is in trouble?" One kid shouted, "Jump in!" Mr. Lin shook his head. "Don't jump in. Shout for a grown-up, then throw something that floats."

Then it was {name}'s turn. First came a loud shout: "Help! Grown-up, come quick!" Then {name} threw the ring, but the rope tangled and the ring flopped down halfway. {name} took a breath, coiled the rope neatly, held the end tight, and swung low. Whoosh! The ring landed right beside the cone.

All the kids clapped. Mr. Lin gave {name} a big thumbs-up, and Dad grinned. On the walk home, {name} held the spiral shell up to listen to the sea. "Next low tide, can we check the time on your phone together again?" Dad nodded. "It's a deal!"

questions: {name}看到遠方的大貝殼時，為什麼最後決定牽著爸爸的手走回沙灘？
如果你的朋友在水裡需要幫忙，你會怎麼做？
下次去游泳池、海邊或河邊，你要待在哪裡、誰要在旁邊看著你？
zh.tip: 這週在家用一條毛巾和一個枕頭玩「丟救生圈」遊戲：先大喊「快來大人！」再把會浮的東西丟過去。出門玩水前，也一起說一句約定：「大人看著我，我才下水。」

questions: When {name} saw the big shell far away, why did {he} decide to hold Dad's hand and walk back to the beach?
If a friend needed help in the water, what would you do?
Next time you go to a pool, beach, or river, where will you stay, and who will be watching you?
en.tip: This week, play a "throw the float" game at home with a pillow and a towel: shout "Grown-up, come quick!" first, then toss the pillow. Before any water trip, say your promise together: "A grown-up watches, then I get in."

title.en: {name} and Grandma Find the Little Green Man

zh: 星期六下午，太陽暖暖的。{name}牽著阿嬤的手，要去逛廟會。遠遠的，傳來咚咚鏘的鑼鼓聲。{name}跳了一下，說：「我要看舞龍！還要吃棉花糖！」阿嬤笑著說：「好，好，都帶你去。」
祖孫倆來到一條熱鬧的大街。路的兩邊停滿了車子，一輛接一輛。對面掛著好多紅燈籠。{name}指著兩輛車中間的縫，說：「阿嬤，我們從這裡鑽過去，最快！」
阿嬤蹲下來，握緊{name}的手。「車子好高，你小小的。開車的人看不到你喔。」{name}踮起腳尖，還是比車子矮。{he}嘟著嘴說：「這輛車好胖，像大河馬。」阿嬤哈哈笑：「所以我們去路口走。」
祖孫倆手牽手，沿著人行道慢慢走。經過一條小巷子，阿嬤停下腳步。噗噗噗！一輛機車從巷子騎出來，一下就不見了。{name}眨眨眼睛：「小巷子也有機車耶！」阿嬤點點頭：「對呀，大路小路都要小心。」
終於走到路口的斑馬線。阿嬤和{name}站在路邊，停下來。對面的燈裡，有一個紅色小人，站得直直的。{name}小聲說：「小紅人在罰站嗎？」阿嬤噗哧一笑：「他在說請等一等。我們等小綠人。」
叮！小綠人出現了，開始走路。{name}的腳動了一下。阿嬤說：「先看左邊，再看右邊，再看一次左邊。」{name}轉轉小腦袋，左、右、左。{his}耳朵也仔細聽。車子都停好了，機車也乖乖在等。
「可以走囉！」祖孫倆牽著手，走上斑馬線。{name}一邊走，一邊看著兩邊。走到一半，小綠人越走越快。{name}睜大眼睛：「阿嬤，小綠人在跑步耶！」阿嬤說：「我們不用跑，穩穩走就好。」一下子就到對面了。
廟會好熱鬧！舞龍在跳舞，鑼鼓咚咚鏘。阿嬤買了一支粉紅色的棉花糖給{name}。{name}請阿嬤咬一口。阿嬤的鼻子黏了一小團粉紅糖。{name}笑彎了腰：「阿嬤變成粉紅鼻子了！」回家時，{name}主動牽起阿嬤的手：「我們再去找小綠人吧！」
en: It was a warm Saturday afternoon. {name} held Grandma's hand on the way to the temple fair. Far away, drums went boom, boom, clang! {name} gave a little hop. "I want to see the dragon dance! And eat cotton candy!" Grandma laughed. "Yes, yes, we'll do both."

They came to a busy street. Cars were parked on both sides, one after another. Red lanterns swayed across the road. {name} pointed at a gap between two cars. "Grandma, let's squeeze through here. It's the fastest way!"

Grandma crouched down and held {name}'s hand tight. "These cars are tall, and you are small. Drivers can't see you here." {name} stood on tiptoe but was still shorter than the car. "This car is so chubby, like a hippo!" Grandma chuckled. "So let's walk to the corner."

Hand in hand, they strolled along the sidewalk. At a tiny alley, Grandma stopped. Putt-putt-putt! A scooter zipped out of the alley and was gone in a blink. {name} blinked too. "Scooters come out of little alleys too!" Grandma nodded. "Yes, big roads and small lanes."

At last they reached the crosswalk at the corner. Grandma and {name} stopped at the curb. Across the road, a little red man stood very still. {name} whispered, "Is he in time-out?" Grandma giggled. "He means, please wait. We'll wait for the little green man."

Ding! The little green man appeared and began to walk. {name}'s feet wiggled. Grandma said, "First look left, then right, then left again." {name} turned left, right, left. {his} ears listened carefully too. The cars had stopped. The scooters were waiting nicely.

"Now we can go!" Holding hands, they stepped onto the crosswalk. {name} kept watching both ways while walking. Halfway across, the green man walked faster and faster. "Grandma, the green man is running!" Grandma smiled. "We don't need to run. Steady steps." Soon they reached the other side.

The temple fair was so lively! The dragon danced, and the drums went boom, clang! Grandma bought {name} pink cotton candy. {name} gave Grandma a bite. A pink puff stuck to her nose! {name} laughed and laughed. "Grandma has a pink nose!" On the way home, {name} reached for Grandma's hand. "Let's go find the little green man again!"

questions: {name}想從兩輛車中間鑽過去時，阿嬤說了什麼？為什麼？
過馬路前，{name}和阿嬤先看了哪幾邊？耳朵也在做什麼？
如果我們走過小巷子口，你會怎麼做？
zh.tip: 這個星期出門時，每到路邊就一起停下來，小聲念「左、右、再左，耳朵聽聽」，再牽手等小綠人過馬路。

questions: What did Grandma say when {name} wanted to squeeze between the cars? Why?
Before crossing, which ways did {name} and Grandma look? What were their ears doing?
What would you do if we walked past the end of a little alley?
en.tip: This week, whenever you reach a curb together, stop and chant "Left, right, left again, ears listening," then hold hands and wait for the green walking light.

zh: 早上，{name}和媽媽搭捷運去學校。車廂亮亮的，好多人在看書。{name}抱著小熊背包，坐在媽媽旁邊。窗外的大樓，一棟一棟往後跑。「小熊，我們快到學校囉！」{name}小聲說。
忽然，捷運慢慢、慢慢停下來。地板輕輕搖，吊環晃來晃去，好像在跳舞。{name}的心咚咚跳。「媽媽，我怕怕。」{name}拉住媽媽的袖子。媽媽溫柔地說：「別怕，是地震。我們一起做。」
媽媽牽著{name}，蹲在柱子旁邊。「兩手抱緊柱子，身體蹲低低。」{name}照著做，縮得像一朵小香菇。媽媽用手護住{his}頭和脖子。「我們不靠近窗戶，也不亂跑喔。」
廣播響了，是司機叔叔的聲音。「各位旅客，請不要慌張。請抓好扶手，留在車廂裡。」叔叔說得慢慢的，聽起來好安心。{name}抱緊柱子，不動也不跑。旁邊的小寶寶咿咿呀呀，好像也在說：「好～」
過了一下下，搖晃停了。車廂好安靜。站務員阿姨走進來，笑著說：「大家跟我走，慢慢來，不用擠。」{name}牽緊媽媽的手。大家排成一排，走到月台。{name}數著步子：「一、二、三……」
到了學校，林老師拍拍手說：「早上有地震，大家都好棒！我們來練習一次。」{name}舉起手：「我在捷運上練習過了！」老師笑咪咪：「那請{name}當小老師好嗎？」同學們都睜大眼睛。
「先趴下！」{name}蹲低，鑽到桌子底下。「再掩護！」{name}用手抱住頭和脖子。「最後穩住！」{name}一手抓緊桌腳。小明太著急，屁股還露在外面，像一隻小烏龜。大家咯咯笑，小明趕快縮進去。
老師指指樓梯和窗戶：「搖的時候，不跑樓梯，離窗戶遠遠的。等不搖了，老師帶大家出去。」大家點點頭。放學時，媽媽來接{name}。「今天我好勇敢喔！」媽媽親親{name}的額頭，小熊背包也搖呀搖。
en: In the morning, {name} and Mom rode the MRT to school. The train was bright and busy. {name} hugged a little bear backpack. Tall buildings zipped past the window. "Bear, we are almost at school!" {name} whispered.

Suddenly, the train slowed down and stopped. The floor gave a gentle shake. The hand straps swung like they were dancing. {name}'s heart went thump, thump. "Mom, I feel scared." Mom smiled softly. "It's an earthquake. Let's do this together."

Mom and {name} crouched down by a pole. "Hold the pole tight with both hands. Stay low." {name} curled up small, like a little mushroom. Mom gently covered {his} head and neck. "We stay away from the windows. And no running."

Then the driver spoke over the speaker. "Everyone, please stay calm. Hold on and stay inside the train." His voice was slow and kind. {name} held the pole and stayed still. A baby nearby babbled, "Ba-ba!" It sounded like "Okay!"

Soon the shaking stopped. The train was very quiet. A station worker came in with a smile. "Follow me, everyone. Nice and slow. No pushing." {name} held Mom's hand tight. They walked in a line to the platform. "One, two, three..." {name} counted.

At school, Ms. Lin clapped her hands. "There was an earthquake this morning. You all did great! Let's practice." {name} raised a hand. "I practiced on the train!" Ms. Lin smiled. "Will you be our little teacher?" Everyone watched.

"Drop!" {name} crawled under a sturdy table. "Cover!" {name} covered head and neck with both hands. "Hold on!" {name} grabbed a table leg. Ming hurried so fast his bottom stuck out, like a little turtle. Everyone giggled. Ming tucked in quickly.

Ms. Lin pointed to the stairs and windows. "When it shakes, no stairs, and stay away from windows. When it stops, I'll lead you out." Everyone nodded. After school, Mom came. "I was so brave today!" said {name}. Mom kissed {his} forehead.

questions: 地板搖的時候，{name}和媽媽在捷運上做了什麼？
如果在教室裡地震了，你會躲到哪裡？要怎麼保護頭和脖子？
搖晃停了以後，要聽誰的話、怎麼走出去呢？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子玩「趴下、掩護、穩住」小遊戲：大人喊口令，孩子鑽到穩固的桌子下抱頭、抓緊桌腳，再一起找找家裡離窗戶遠的安全角落。

questions: What did {name} and Mom do on the train when the floor shook?
If the ground shook in your classroom, where would you go? How would you protect your head and neck?
After the shaking stopped, who did everyone listen to, and how did they walk out?
en.tip: Tonight, play a "Drop, Cover, Hold On" game: call out the steps while your child crawls under a sturdy table, covers head and neck, and holds a table leg. Then find a safe spot at home away from windows together.

title.en: {name} Can't Find Mom at the Bookstore

zh: 星期六下午，媽媽帶{name}去城裡的大書店。書店好大，有三層樓。書架高高的，像一座座小山。{name}找到一本恐龍繪本，眼睛亮了起來。「媽媽，我在這裡看喔！」媽媽點點頭，走到隔壁看食譜。
繪本裡的小恐龍在找蛋。{name}一頁一頁慢慢翻。翻到最後，小恐龍找到蛋了！{name}開心地抬起頭。「媽媽，你看！」可是旁邊沒有人。食譜架前也空空的。媽媽不見了。
{name}的心撲通撲通跳。{he}好想跑去找媽媽。腳已經往前踏了一步。這時，{name}想起家裡的約定。媽媽說過：「找不到我，先停下來。站在原地，不要亂跑。我一定會回來找你。」{name}把腳收回來，站得穩穩的。
{name}抱緊繪本，深深吸一口氣。一、二、三，再慢慢吐出來。心跳慢慢變小聲了。約定還有下一步：找穿制服、戴名牌的店員。{name}踮起腳尖，四處看一看。有一位帶著小孩的阿姨在挑書。再遠一點，有一位穿綠色背心的姊姊。
姊姊胸前有一個亮亮的名牌。上面寫著「小雨」。{name}用力揮揮手。「姊姊，請問可以幫我嗎？」小雨姊姊走過來，蹲了下來。她笑著說：「當然可以。發生什麼事了？」{name}小聲說：「我找不到媽媽了。」
小雨姊姊問：「你知道媽媽的名字嗎？」{name}點點頭。「我媽媽叫王小慧。」「那你記得媽媽的電話嗎？」{name}想了想。這串號碼，在家練習過好多次。{name}一個數字、一個數字，慢慢說出來。小雨姊姊仔細寫在本子上。
「你好棒！我們就在這裡等。」小雨姊姊拿起對講機。不久，書店的廣播響起來。「王小慧女士，您的孩子在童書區等您。」{name}站在恐龍書架旁，沒有走開。小雨姊姊陪在旁邊，一起看那本繪本。
沒多久，熟悉的腳步聲跑過來。「{name}！」媽媽喘著氣，緊緊抱住{him}。「你停在原地，還找了店員。媽媽好驕傲。」{name}笑了，把繪本舉得高高的。「媽媽，小恐龍也找到蛋了！」媽媽和小雨姊姊都笑了。
en: On Saturday afternoon, Mom took {name} to the big bookstore in the city. It had three floors! The shelves stood tall like little hills. {name} found a dinosaur picture book. "Mom, I'll read here!" Mom nodded and went next door to look at cookbooks.

In the book, a little dinosaur was looking for its egg. {name} turned page after page. At the end, the dinosaur found the egg! {name} looked up, smiling. "Mom, look!" But no one was there. The cookbook shelf was empty too. Mom was gone.

{name}'s heart went thump, thump. {name} wanted to run and look for Mom. One foot stepped forward. Then {name} remembered the family rule. Mom always said, "If you can't find me, stop. Stay right where you are. I will come back for you." So {name} stepped back and stood still.

{name} hugged the book and took a deep breath. One, two, three, and out. The thumping grew quieter. The rule had a next step: find a helper in a uniform with a name badge. {name} stood on tiptoe and looked around. A mom with two kids was choosing books. A bit farther away stood a young woman in a green vest.

A shiny name badge was pinned to her vest. It said "Rain." {name} waved and waved. "Excuse me, can you help me?" Rain walked over and knelt down. She smiled. "Of course. What happened?" {name} said softly, "I can't find my mom."

"Do you know your mom's name?" Rain asked. {name} nodded. "My mom is Wang Xiaohui." "Do you know her phone number?" {name} thought hard. They had practiced it at home many times. {name} said it slowly, one number at a time. Rain wrote each number down carefully.

"Great job! Let's wait right here." Rain picked up her walkie-talkie. Soon a voice came over the speaker. "Wang Xiaohui, your child is waiting in the children's books section." {name} stayed by the dinosaur shelf. Rain stayed too, and they looked at the book together.

Soon, quick footsteps came near. "{name}!" Mom hugged {him} tight, out of breath. "You stopped and stayed, and you found a helper. I'm so proud." {name} smiled and held up the book. "Mom, the little dinosaur found its egg too!" Mom and Rain both laughed.

questions: {name}發現媽媽不見時，先做了什麼？
{name}為什麼去找戴名牌的姊姊幫忙？如果在賣場找不到大人，你可以找誰？
你記得爸爸或媽媽的名字和電話嗎？可以說給我聽嗎？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子玩「電話號碼歌」：把爸媽的手機號碼分成三段，用拍手的節奏一起唸，每天睡前練一次。

questions: What did {name} do first after noticing Mom was gone?
Why did {name} ask the helper with the name badge? Who could you ask if you got lost in a store?
Do you know your grown-up's name and phone number? Can you tell me?
en.tip: Tonight, turn your phone number into a clapping chant: split it into three short parts and say it together with a clap. Practice it once each night before bed.

zh: 星期六早上，{name}坐在沙發上。電視上是跳跳兔！跳跳兔蹦、蹦、蹦。{name}笑得咯咯咯。抱著小枕頭，好開心！
嗶！畫面變了。弟弟拿著遙控器。「我要看小火車！」嘟嘟嘟，小火車跑出來了。{name}說：「換回來！」嗶！跳跳兔。嗶！小火車。
嗶、嗶、嗶！換來又換去。{name}的臉熱熱的。熱得紅紅的，像小番茄。{his}小手握得緊緊的。好想搶遙控器，好想大叫！
爸爸走過來，蹲在{name}旁邊。「你好像很生氣喔。」爸爸拿出紙和筆，畫了一支溫度計。下面是藍色，涼涼的。中間是黃色。最上面是紅色，燙燙的！
「生氣沒關係。」爸爸說。「可是不打人，不丟東西。」{name}指著紅色。「我在這裡！快要滾燙了！」爸爸點點頭。「我們一起慢慢吸氣。」
吸——像聞一朵香香的花。呼——像吹一根小蠟燭。「一、二、三。」再吸——再呼——「四、五、六。」肚子鼓起來，又扁下去，像一顆小氣球。
熱熱的感覺，慢慢變小了。{name}指著溫度計說：「現在是黃色。」爸爸笑了：「黃色很棒！」弟弟跑過來：「我也要吹蠟燭！」呼——口水噴出來了！哈哈哈！
{name}看著弟弟說：「你一直換台，我會生氣。我想看完跳跳兔。」弟弟眨眨眼睛。「可是，我想看小火車。」爸爸說：「那我們來輪流吧！」
「先看完跳跳兔，再看小火車。」弟弟點點頭，把遙控器交給爸爸。跳跳兔蹦蹦蹦，小火車嘟嘟嘟。{name}和弟弟靠在一起，咯咯笑。
en: It is Saturday morning. {name} sits on the sofa. Hoppy Bunny is on TV! Hop, hop, hop! {name} giggles and hugs a soft pillow. What a happy morning!
Beep! The picture changes. Little brother has the remote. "I want the train show!" Choo-choo! "Change it back!" says {name}. Beep! Bunny. Beep! Train.
Beep, beep, beep! Back and forth it goes. {name}'s face feels hot. Hot and red, like a tomato. {name} squeezes tight little fists. {name} wants to grab and yell!
Dad comes over and kneels down. "You look really angry." He draws a thermometer on paper. Cool blue at the bottom. Yellow in the middle. Boiling red at the top!
"It's okay to feel angry," Dad says. "But no hitting, and no throwing." {name} points at the red. "I'm here! Almost boiling!" Dad nods. "Let's breathe slowly together."
Breathe in, like smelling a flower. Breathe out, like blowing a candle. "One, two, three." In again, out again. "Four, five, six." Tummy puffs up, then down, like a balloon.

The hot feeling gets smaller and smaller. {name} points. "Now I'm yellow." Dad smiles. "Yellow is great!" Little brother runs over. "I want to blow candles too!" Whoosh! Spit flies everywhere! Ha ha ha!
{name} looks at little brother. "I feel angry when you change it. I want to finish Hoppy Bunny." Little brother blinks. "But I want trains." Dad says, "Let's take turns!"
"Bunny first, then trains." Little brother nods and gives Dad the remote. Hop, hop, hop goes Bunny. Choo-choo goes the train. {name} and little brother snuggle up and giggle.

questions: {name}生氣的時候，身體有什麼感覺？你生氣時呢？
爸爸和{name}一起做了什麼，讓溫度計變回黃色？
如果有人一直拿走你的東西，你可以說什麼？
zh.tip: 今晚和孩子一起畫一支藍、黃、紅的生氣溫度計貼在牆上，練習「聞花、吹蠟燭」數到六，並一起說說看：「我生氣，因為……」。

questions: How did {name}'s body feel when {he} got angry? How does yours feel?
What did Dad and {name} do to get back to yellow?
If someone keeps taking your things, what could you say?
en.tip: Tonight, draw a blue-yellow-red anger thermometer together and hang it on the wall. Practice 'smell the flower, blow the candle' to six, then try saying, 'I'm angry because…'.

zh: 公園裡，太陽暖暖的。溜滑梯旁邊，停著一台小車。紅紅的三輪車，亮晶晶。車上還有小鈴鐺。{name}看見了，眼睛亮了。「哇！紅色三輪車！」
米米也跑過來了。米米也看見了。「我要騎！」米米說。「我也要騎！」{name}說。{name}拉住把手。米米拉住椅子。
拉呀拉，拉呀拉。嘿咻！嘿咻！三輪車動也不動。{name}沒有騎到。米米也沒有騎到。小鳥在樹上看。啾啾，啾啾，好像在偷笑。
{name}停下來，想一想。咦，有了！「米米，你先騎。我來按鈴鐺。」「然後呢？」米米問。「然後換我騎！」米米笑了：「好呀！」
米米坐上去，踩呀踩。{name}跑在旁邊，按鈴鐺。叮叮！叮叮！三輪車轉一圈。叮叮！叮叮！又轉一圈。
{name}好想騎喔。等一等，好難喔。{name}輕輕問：「米米，騎完可以換我嗎？」「可以！再一圈就換你！」叮叮！最後一圈到了。
換{name}坐上去了。換米米按鈴鐺了。踩呀踩，轉呀轉。叮叮！叮叮！米米按得好大聲。{name}咯咯笑。米米也咯咯笑。
你騎一圈，我按一下。我騎一圈，你按一下。紅色三輪車，轉呀轉。叮叮！叮叮！兩個好朋友，笑得好開心。
en: The sun is warm at the park. By the slide sits a little trike. It is red and shiny. It has a tiny bell, too. {name} sees it. "Wow! A red trike!"
Mimi runs over. Mimi sees it, too. "I want to ride!" says Mimi. "I want to ride!" says {name}. {name} holds the handlebars. Mimi holds the seat.
Pull and pull. Tug and tug. Heave-ho! Heave-ho! The trike does not move at all. Nobody rides. A little bird watches from a tree. Tweet, tweet! It sounds like giggling.
{name} stops and thinks. Then, an idea! "Mimi, you ride first. I'll ring the bell." "And then?" asks Mimi. "Then it's my turn!" Mimi smiles. "Okay!"
Mimi climbs on. Pedal, pedal. {name} runs alongside and rings the bell. Ding, ding! Around they go. Ding, ding! Around again.
{name} really wants a ride. Waiting is hard. {name} asks softly, "Can I have a turn when you're done?" "Yes! One more lap, then you!" Ding, ding! Last lap!
Now {name} climbs on. Now Mimi rings the bell. Pedal, pedal, around and around. Ding, ding! Mimi rings it so loud. {name} giggles. Mimi giggles, too.
You ride, I ring. I ride, you ring. The red trike goes around and around. Ding, ding! Ding, ding! Two happy friends, laughing all the way.

questions: {name}和米米一直拉三輪車的時候，有人騎到嗎？後來{name}想到什麼好辦法？
{name}好想騎的時候，是怎麼問米米的？如果你也想玩別人的玩具，你會怎麼說？
兩個人輪流騎、輪流按鈴鐺，為什麼會玩得更開心呢？
zh.tip: 這週和孩子玩一個玩具時，練習說「你玩完可以換我嗎？」，並用計時器或數到十來輪流，讓孩子體會「等一等，就會輪到我」。

questions: When {name} and Mimi kept pulling the trike, did anyone get to ride? What good idea did {name} have?
How did {name} ask Mimi for a turn? What could you say if you want to play with someone else's toy?
Why was it more fun when they took turns riding and ringing the bell?
en.tip: This week, play with one toy together and practice saying, "Can I have a turn when you're done?" Take turns using a timer or counting to ten, so your child feels that waiting means their turn will come.

zh: 晚上，媽媽關掉大燈。房間一下子變黑了。椅子像一座小山。窗簾輕輕晃，好像在招手。{name}把被子拉到鼻子上，小聲說：「媽媽，房間變得好奇怪。」媽媽摸摸{his}頭：「怕怕沒關係，媽媽陪你。」
第二天早上，陽光暖暖的。媽媽說：「我們來玩摸摸猜猜。」{name}閉上眼睛。媽媽牽著{his}小手，慢慢往前摸。軟軟的，暖暖的，像一朵雲。「是我的小被被！」{name}笑著說。媽媽點點頭：「答對了！」
再往前摸，摸到圓圓的耳朵。身上一顆一顆，凸凸的。那是毛線織的小熊豆豆。「是豆豆！」接著，小手碰到涼涼的東西。滑滑的，圓圓的。「是床邊的檯燈！」媽媽拍拍手：「你好厲害喔。」
媽媽又說：「晚上燈會休息。可是房間不會跑掉。被被、豆豆和檯燈，都乖乖待在這裡。」媽媽還在牆邊，裝了一盞星星小夜燈。它的光小小的，黃黃的，像一顆想睡覺的星星。
傍晚，天空慢慢變成橘色。{name}洗了暖暖的澡，聽媽媽講了一個故事。媽媽打開星星小夜燈，再關掉大燈。「如果怕怕，就叫媽媽。我就在隔壁。」媽媽輕輕帶上門，留了一條小縫。
房間好安靜。忽然，窗外傳來「沙沙、沙沙」。{name}的心咚咚跳，小聲叫：「媽媽？」媽媽在門外說：「那是風在吹樹葉，它在唱歌呢。」接著，廚房傳來「嗡嗡」聲。「那是冰箱在哼歌。」
{name}慢慢伸出小手。軟軟的，暖暖的，是小被被。再摸一摸，凸凸的，是豆豆。往旁邊摸，滑滑的，涼涼的，是檯燈。小夜燈照著椅子，它不是小山，只是一張椅子。{name}笑了：「都還在耶。這還是我的房間。」
{name}把豆豆抱進懷裡。小夜燈亮亮的，風沙沙的，冰箱嗡嗡的。眼皮好重，好重。{name}輕輕說：「晚安，被被。晚安，豆豆。晚安，房間。」門外傳來媽媽的聲音：「晚安，寶貝。」
en: At bedtime, Mom turned off the big light. The room went dark. The chair looked like a little hill. The curtains swayed, as if waving. {name} pulled the blanket up to {his} nose. "Mom, my room feels strange," {name} whispered. Mom stroked {his} head. "It's okay to feel scared. I'm here."

The next morning, the sun felt warm. "Let's play touch-and-guess," said Mom. {name} closed both eyes. Mom held {his} hand, and they reached out slowly. Something soft. Something warm, like a cloud. "My blankie!" {name} laughed. "You got it!" said Mom.

Next, they felt round little ears. The body had tiny bumps all over. It was Bean, the knitted teddy bear. "It's Bean!" Then {name} touched something cool. It was smooth and round. "The lamp by my bed!" Mom clapped. "You're so good at this."

"At night, the lights take a rest," Mom said. "But your room doesn't go anywhere. Blankie, Bean, and the lamp stay right here." Then Mom plugged in a little star night light. Its glow was small and yellow, like a sleepy star.

In the evening, the sky turned orange. {name} had a warm bath and a story. Mom switched on the star night light. Then she turned off the big light. "If you feel scared, just call me. I'm right next door." She left the door open a crack.

The room was very quiet. Then, outside the window, came "shhh, shhh." {name}'s heart went thump, thump. "Mom?" Mom answered from the hall. "That's the wind in the leaves. It's singing." Then a soft "hmmm" came from the kitchen. "That's the fridge, humming a tune."

{name} slowly reached out a hand. Soft and warm. That was blankie. A little farther, tiny bumps. That was Bean. Over to the side, smooth and cool. That was the lamp. The night light shone on the chair. It was just a chair. "Everything's still here. It's still my room!"

{name} hugged Bean close. The night light glowed. The wind went shhh. The fridge went hmmm. Eyelids grew heavy, so heavy. "Goodnight, blankie," {name} whispered. "Goodnight, Bean. Goodnight, room." From the hall came Mom's soft voice. "Goodnight, sweetheart."

questions: {name}聽到「沙沙」和「嗡嗡」的聲音時，做了什麼？
{name}在黑黑的房間裡，摸到了哪些熟悉的東西？
如果你晚上覺得怕怕，有什麼可以幫你？
zh.tip: 今天白天和孩子玩「閉眼摸摸猜猜」，摸摸床上的被子、娃娃和床邊的東西；晚上關燈後，再請孩子伸手找找看，確認它們都還在。

questions: What did {name} do when the "shhh" and "hmmm" sounds came?
What friendly things did {name} find by touch in the dark room?
If you feel scared at night, what could help you?
en.tip: Play a close-your-eyes touch-and-guess game in your child's room today with the blanket, a cuddly toy and things by the bed. Tonight after lights out, invite your child to reach out and find them again.

zh: 為了班上的英文拼字比賽，{name}整整練習了兩個星期。早餐時拼，刷牙時拼，連對著魚缸裡的金魚也拼。口袋裡的單字卡被摸得軟軟皺皺的。比賽這天早上，{name}走進教室，心裡胸有成竹：「這次一定沒問題！」
第一回合開始了。林老師拿起卡片，清楚地念：「Wednesday。」{name}站起來，嘴角忍不住上揚，這個字太簡單了！「W-E-N-S-D-A-Y。」教室突然安靜下來。林老師溫柔地說：「好可惜，差一點點喔。」
{name}走回座位，臉頰燙得像剛出爐的饅頭，真想鑽到桌子底下躲起來。可是低頭一看，桌子那麼小，頭會撞到，腳也會露在外面，根本藏不住嘛！{name}只好坐好，慢慢吸一口氣，再慢慢吐出來。
旁邊的小安也被淘汰了。他湊過來小聲說：「我把 elephant 拼成有 f 的，大象都要哭了。」{name}忍不住噗哧一笑，胸口那塊沉甸甸的石頭好像輕了一點。這時，{name}看見美玲走上台，雙手緊緊抓著衣角，微微發抖。
那種緊張的感覺，{name}剛剛才嘗過。{name}對美玲比出大拇指，用嘴型說：「加油！」美玲眨眨眼，深吸一口氣，一個字母一個字母地拼出「library」。{name}和小安拍手拍得最大聲，就算有人拼錯，也小聲說：「差一點點，好棒！」
比賽愈來愈刺激，最後只剩美玲一個人。她全神貫注，拼對了「February」，全班掌聲雷動。下課時，美玲跑過來說：「看到你的大拇指，我就不抖了。其實去年我也拼錯 Wednesday，後來我都念成 Wed-nes-day，就記住了！」
放學後，{name}坐在教室裡等爸爸來接。{name}打開筆記本，一筆一畫寫下 Wednesday，一邊寫一邊用怪腔怪調念：「Wed-nes-day！」寫到第十遍時，那個愛躲起來的 d 再也逃不掉了。林老師經過，笑著點點頭。
爸爸來了，{name}把筆記本舉得高高的。林老師說：「下個月還有一場比賽喔。」{name}用力點頭，把單字卡放回口袋。走出校門時，爸爸牽著{name}問：「今天星期幾？」{name}恍然大悟，大聲回答：「W-E-D-N-E-S-D-A-Y，星期三！」
en: For two whole weeks, {name} practiced for the class spelling contest. {name} spelled at breakfast, spelled while brushing teeth, and even spelled to the goldfish. The word cards in {his} pocket grew soft and wrinkly. On contest morning, {name} marched into class feeling sure: this time, nothing could go wrong!

The first round began. Ms. Lin held up a card and read clearly, "Wednesday." {name} stood up, trying not to grin. Too easy! "W-E-N-S-D-A-Y." The room went very quiet. Ms. Lin said gently, "Oh, so close. That's not quite right."

{name} walked back to the desk with cheeks as hot as fresh-baked buns. Hiding under the desk sounded perfect. But the desk was tiny. {name} would bump a head, and both feet would poke out the side. No good at all! So {name} sat down, took a slow breath in, and let it slowly out.

An, who had also missed a word, leaned over and whispered, "I spelled elephant with an F. The poor elephant is probably crying." {name} giggled, and the heavy stone in {his} chest felt a little lighter. Just then, Mei-Ling stepped up front, gripping her sleeves, her hands trembling.

{name} knew that shaky feeling. It had only just happened. {name} gave Mei-Ling a big thumbs-up and mouthed, "You can do it!" She blinked, breathed deep, and spelled "library" one careful letter at a time. {name} and An clapped the loudest, and when anyone missed, they whispered, "So close! Nice try!"

The contest grew more and more exciting until only Mei-Ling was left. She spelled "February" perfectly, and the whole class cheered. At recess she ran over. "Your thumbs-up stopped my shaking. You know, last year I missed Wednesday too. Now I say it Wed-nes-day, and I never forget!"

After school, {name} waited in the classroom for Dad. {name} opened a notebook and carefully wrote Wednesday, saying it in a silly voice each time: "Wed-nes-day!" By the tenth time, that sneaky hiding D couldn't escape anymore. Ms. Lin walked by and smiled.

When Dad arrived, {name} held the notebook up high. "There's another contest next month," said Ms. Lin. {name} nodded hard and tucked the word cards back into a pocket. Walking out the school gate, Dad took {his} hand and asked, "So, what day is it today?" {name} laughed. "W-E-D-N-E-S-D-A-Y. Wednesday!"

questions: {name}拼錯字、想躲到桌子底下時，做了什麼讓自己好一點？
{name}被淘汰後，怎麼對待還在比賽的同學？美玲覺得怎麼樣？
你有沒有輸過或犯錯的時候？下次你想怎麼再試一次？
zh.tip: 這個星期和孩子玩一個小遊戲時，不論誰輸了，一起慢慢深呼吸三次，再說一句「差一點點，下次再試！」

questions: When {name} missed the word and wanted to hide under the desk, what did {he} do to feel a little better?
After {name} was out, how did {he} treat the classmates still spelling? How did Mei-Ling feel?
Can you remember a time you lost or made a mistake? How would you like to try again next time?
en.tip: This week, play a small game together, and whoever loses, take three slow breaths side by side and say, "So close, let's try again!"

zh: 夏天的夜晚，好安靜。{name}在爺爺的鄉下家。院子裡鋪著一張草蓆。爺爺說：「來，躺下來看星星。」{name}躺在草蓆上。草蓆涼涼的，好舒服。
天空黑黑的，好大好大。一顆星星亮了。兩顆星星亮了。三顆星星也亮了。一閃一閃，好像在眨眼睛。{name}輕輕數：「一、二、三。」
晚風吹過來，呼——呼——。稻田沙沙地響。爺爺拿來一條小毯子。他把毯子蓋在{name}身上。毯子軟軟的，暖暖的。{name}笑了。
爺爺指著天上說：「你看，那是月亮。」月亮彎彎的，像一艘小船。小船慢慢地划，慢慢地划。{name}小聲說：「月亮小船，你好。」
忽然，咻——！一道亮光劃過天空。是流星！流星跑得好快。「爺爺，快看！」{name}睜大眼睛。爺爺笑著說：「快許個願吧。」
{name}閉上眼睛，小手合起來。{name}在心裡輕輕說：「明年夏天，我還要再來。」爺爺摸摸{his}頭。「好，爺爺等你。」
草叢裡，蟋蟀開始唱歌。唧唧，唧唧。聲音小小的，輕輕的。螢火蟲飛過來，一閃，一閃。星星也一閃，一閃。院子好安靜。
{name}的眼皮好重。打個呵欠，啊——。蟋蟀還在唱，唧唧，唧唧。星星還在眨，一閃一閃。爺爺輕輕說：「晚安，{name}。」{name}在星空下，睡著了。
en: It is a quiet summer night. {name} is at Grandpa's country house. A soft mat lies in the yard. "Come," says Grandpa. "Let's look at the stars." {name} lies down. The mat feels cool and nice.
The sky is big and dark. One star comes out. Two stars come out. Three stars come out too. Twinkle, twinkle, they seem to wink. {name} counts softly, "One, two, three."
A breeze blows by. Whoosh, whoosh. The rice fields rustle. Grandpa brings a little blanket. He tucks it over {name}. The blanket is soft and warm. {name} smiles.
Grandpa points up. "Look, there's the moon." The moon is curved like a little boat. It sails slowly, slowly across the sky. {name} whispers, "Hello, little moon boat."
Suddenly, zip! A bright light streaks across the sky. A shooting star! It runs so fast. "Grandpa, look!" {name} says with wide eyes. Grandpa smiles. "Quick, make a wish."
{name} closes both eyes. Little hands fold together. {name} wishes quietly inside, "I want to come back next summer." Grandpa pats {his} head. "Yes. I'll be waiting for you."
In the grass, the crickets begin to sing. Chirp, chirp. Chirp, chirp. Their song is small and soft. Fireflies drift by, blink, blink. The stars blink too. The yard is very still.
{name}'s eyes feel heavy. A big yawn, ahh. The crickets still sing, chirp, chirp. The stars still twinkle. Grandpa whispers, "Goodnight, {name}." Under the twinkling sky, {name} falls asleep.

questions: 你可以像{name}一樣，小小聲數星星嗎？
彎彎的月亮，像什麼呢？
蟋蟀怎麼唱歌？我們一起小小聲唱唱看。
zh.tip: 關燈後抱著孩子，一起輕輕說「唧唧、唧唧」，再用手指在孩子背上慢慢畫一顆小星星，輕聲說晚安。

questions: Can you count the stars very softly, like {name} did?
What did the curvy moon look like?
How did the crickets sing? Let's sing it together, very quietly.
en.tip: After the lights go off, cuddle up and whisper "chirp, chirp" together, then slowly draw a little star on your child's back with one finger and say goodnight.

zh: 白白的雪地上，冷風呼呼地吹。北極熊一家要去抓魚。熊爸爸走在前面，熊媽媽跟在後面。小熊皮皮跑得最慢。{name}是皮皮的好朋友，牽著熊媽媽的手，一起慢慢走。
熊爸爸在冰上挖了一個洞。熊媽媽把大手伸進水裡，一下就抓到一條魚。皮皮也想幫忙，可是她的手太短了。皮皮低下頭說：「我太小了，什麼都不會。」
{name}坐到皮皮身邊，輕輕拍拍她的背。這時，{name}看見皮皮的耳朵動了一下。「妳聽到什麼了？」{name}問。皮皮歪著頭說：「冰在唱歌，喀、喀，好小聲。」
{name}也把耳朵靠近冰面，可是什麼都聽不到。熊爸爸笑著說：「我什麼也沒聽見呀。」熊媽媽也搖搖頭。只有皮皮聽得見，那聲音像雪花落下一樣輕。
熊爸爸往前走，想找新的地方挖洞。突然，皮皮的耳朵豎了起來。前面的冰發出細細的聲音：「喀啦、喀啦。」皮皮大叫：「爸爸，停下來！那裡的冰會裂開！」
熊爸爸馬上停住腳。熊媽媽抱緊{name}和皮皮，往後退了好幾步。熊爸爸用手輕輕敲一敲，冰面果然好薄，還有一條細細的裂縫。「好險啊！」熊爸爸說。
大家繞過薄冰，走到厚厚的冰上。皮皮一邊走，一邊仔細聽。熊爸爸說：「在冰上，要跟著大人一步一步走喔。」熊爸爸在這裡挖了新洞，抓到好多魚。{name}幫忙把魚排好，大家都笑了。
熊爸爸摸摸皮皮的頭說：「妳的小耳朵，聽見了大耳朵聽不見的聲音。」皮皮抬起頭，眼睛亮亮的。{name}拉著皮皮的手說：「小小的妳，幫了大大的忙！」回家路上，皮皮走在熊爸爸身邊，豎起耳朵幫忙聽，開心極了。
en: The snow was white, and the cold wind went whoosh. The polar bear family was going fishing. Papa Bear walked in front. Mama Bear walked behind. Little Pippa was the slowest. {name}, Pippa's good friend, held Mama Bear's paw.

Papa Bear dug a hole in the ice. Mama Bear reached into the water. Splash! She caught a fish right away. Pippa wanted to help too. But her arms were too short. "I'm too small," she sighed. "I can't do anything."

{name} sat down next to Pippa and patted her back. Then {name} saw Pippa's ears twitch. "What do you hear?" asked {name}. Pippa tilted her head. "The ice is singing," she said. "Crick, crick. Very softly."

{name} leaned close to the ice, but heard nothing at all. Papa Bear chuckled. "I don't hear a thing." Mama Bear shook her head too. Only Pippa could hear it. The sound was as soft as falling snowflakes.
Papa Bear walked ahead to dig a new hole. Suddenly, Pippa's ears shot up. The ice ahead made a tiny sound. Crick-crack, crick-crack. "Papa, stop!" Pippa shouted. "That ice is going to crack!"

Papa Bear froze right where he was. Mama Bear hugged {name} and Pippa close. Together they stepped far back. Papa Bear tapped the ice gently. It was very thin, with a small crack in it. "Whew, that was close!" said Papa Bear.

They walked around the thin ice to the thick ice. Pippa listened carefully as she went. "On the ice, always walk behind a grown-up, one step at a time," said Papa Bear. Papa Bear dug a new hole and caught lots of fish. {name} helped line them up, and everyone laughed.

Papa Bear patted Pippa's head. "Your little ears heard what our big ears missed." Pippa looked up, her eyes shining. {name} held her paw. "You're small, but you helped so much!" On the way home, Pippa walked beside Papa Bear, ears up to help listen, happy and proud.

questions: 皮皮聽到冰在唱歌「喀、喀」，你可以小小聲學學看嗎？
皮皮大叫「停下來！」的時候，你有什麼感覺？
{name}和皮皮一起走回家，路上可能會聽到什麼聲音？
zh.tip: 今晚關燈後，和孩子一起閉上眼睛，安靜聽一聽房間裡的聲音，再輪流用悄悄話說出聽到最小聲的聲音是什麼。

questions: Pippa heard the ice singing, "crick, crick." Can you make that sound very softly?
When Pippa shouted "Stop!", how did you feel?
As {name} and Pippa walked home together, what sounds might they hear?
en.tip: Tonight, with the lights off, close your eyes together and listen to the room. Then take turns whispering the softest sound you heard.

title.zh: 慢慢走的小殼和愛炫耀的白白
title.en: Little Shell and the Speedy Seagull

zh: 早晨，{name}和奶奶沿著海邊的沙灘散步。高高的礁石上住著一隻海鷗，名字叫白白。白白最愛展開翅膀，咻一下就從這頭飛到那頭，還得意地「嘎嘎」大叫：「整片海灘，誰也沒有我快！」
礁石下面，一隻小寄居蟹正慢慢爬著，牠叫小殼。小殼背上背著一個圓圓的螺殼，走一步，停一下，再走一步。白白低頭大笑：「小殼，你背著房子走路，真是慢吞吞！換成是我，早就飛到海的另一邊了。」
小殼沒有生氣，只是輕輕說：「我的家雖然有點重，可是走到哪裡都能帶著。」白白哼了一聲，飛回礁石最高處，看著自己用海草和小樹枝搭的窩。「我的窩才漂亮呢！」{name}聽了，悄悄看了奶奶一眼。
就在這時候，遠方的海浪一波比一波高。奶奶牽起{name}的手說：「浪變大了，我們往後退，站到乾乾的沙灘上。」兩個人剛走到安全的地方，嘩啦！一個大浪撲上礁石，白色的浪花四處飛濺。
浪退下去以後，白白的窩不見了，海草和樹枝散落在沙灘上。白白在空中繞來繞去，急得「嘎嘎」直叫。再看小殼，牠早就把身體縮進殼裡，等浪過去，才慢慢探出小腳，好像什麼事也沒發生過。
{name}問奶奶：「我們可以幫白白嗎？」奶奶笑著點頭，陪{name}在離海很遠的乾沙上，把散開的海草和樹枝一根根撿回來。小殼也慢慢爬過來，用小鉗子拖著一根細樹枝，一步一步，一點也不肯放棄。
可是小殼爬得太遠了，腳下的沙被太陽曬得暖烘烘，離牠的小水窪好遠好遠。{name}蹲下來，用雙手輕輕捧起小殼，在奶奶身邊，把牠放回淺淺的水窪旁。白白在一旁看著，低下頭，好久都沒有說話。
{name}和奶奶把海草和樹枝交給白白，白白在礁石後面避風的地方，搭好了一個新窩。然後牠飛到小殼身旁，收起翅膀，一步一步陪著牠慢慢走。「小殼，」白白小聲說，「原來慢慢走的你，比我更懂得保護自己的家。」
en: One morning, {name} and Grandma went for a walk along the sandy beach. High on the rocks lived a seagull named Whitey. Whitey loved to spread his wings and zoom from one end of the beach to the other. "Squawk! Nobody on this beach is as fast as me!"

Below the rocks, a little hermit crab named Little Shell was slowly crawling along. On his back he carried a round, swirly shell. Step, stop, step again. Whitey laughed down at him. "Little Shell, you drag your house everywhere! You're so slow! I'd be across the sea by now."

Little Shell didn't get upset. "My home is a bit heavy," he said softly, "but I can take it anywhere I go." Whitey just sniffed and flew back to his nest of seaweed and twigs. "My nest is much nicer!" {name} glanced quietly at Grandma.

Just then, the waves far out at sea began to grow taller and taller. Grandma took {name} by the hand. "The waves are getting big. Let's step back onto the dry sand." They had just reached a safe spot when, SPLASH! A huge wave crashed over the rocks.

When the water rolled back, Whitey's nest was gone. Seaweed and twigs lay scattered across the sand. Whitey circled above, squawking in a worried flurry. And Little Shell? He had simply tucked inside his shell. When the wave was gone, he poked his legs out again as if nothing had happened.

"Grandma, can we help Whitey?" {name} asked. Grandma smiled and nodded. Together they walked on the dry sand, far from the waves, picking up the seaweed and twigs piece by piece. Little Shell crawled over too, tugging a thin twig with his tiny claw, one step at a time, never giving up.

But Little Shell had crawled a long way. The sand under him was getting warm in the sun, and his little tide pool was far behind. {name} knelt down and gently scooped him up. Staying close to Grandma, {name} set him beside the shallow pool. Whitey watched and was quiet for a long time.

{name} and Grandma gave Whitey the seaweed and twigs, and he built a new nest in a cozy spot behind the rocks, safe from the wind. Then he landed beside Little Shell, folded his wings, and walked slowly with him. "Little Shell," Whitey said softly, "slow as you are, you knew how to keep your home safe better than I did."

questions: 白白咻一下飛過海灘的時候，你覺得牠心裡是什麼感覺？
大浪撲上礁石那一刻，你最想看看誰？是白白、小殼，還是{name}和奶奶？
如果你也能像小殼一樣背著一個小小的家，你想在裡面放什麼？
zh.tip: 今晚關燈前，和孩子窩在被子裡，輪流用悄悄話說出故事裡最喜歡的一個畫面。明天可以一起畫出小殼的螺殼小屋，想裝什麼就畫什麼。

questions: When Whitey zoomed across the beach, how do you think he felt inside?
When the big wave crashed over the rocks, who did you most want to check on: Whitey, Little Shell, or {name} and Grandma?
If you could carry a tiny home on your back like Little Shell, what would you keep inside it?
en.tip: Before lights out tonight, snuggle up and take turns whispering your favourite picture from the story. Tomorrow, you could draw Little Shell's shell home together and fill it with anything you like.

zh: 公寓頂樓有一座小菜園，是{name}和住在對門的林奶奶一起種的。小番茄紅得發亮，豌豆莢垂得像一串串綠色小鈴鐺。可是這個星期，怪事接二連三：小番茄少了五顆，豌豆莢只剩空殼，連最肥美的那顆草莓也不翼而飛。「一定有小偷！」{name}氣得直跺腳。
林奶奶推推老花眼鏡，笑咪咪地說：「那我們就來當偵探吧。」{name}立刻翻開筆記本，把線索一條條記下來：泥土上有細細的爪印，葉子上有尖尖的小洞，花盆旁還躺著半個被啃過的豆莢。{name}皺著眉頭推理：「小偷個子很小，而且不只一個。」奶奶點點頭，約好明天一早就來埋伏。
第二天清晨，媽媽答應讓{name}跟著林奶奶上頂樓。兩人蹲在晾衣架後面的大紙箱旁，屏氣凝神，一動也不動。天空從灰藍慢慢染成淡金色。{name}的腿開始發麻，肚子也咕嚕咕嚕叫，奶奶趕緊從口袋裡掏出一顆飯糰。就在這時，番茄架那邊傳來一陣窸窸窣窣的聲音。
三隻白頭翁輕巧地落在番茄架上，嘰嘰喳喳叫個不停。牠們歪著頭，你一口、我一口，把最紅的小番茄啄得汁水四濺，吃得心滿意足。{name}忍不住想衝出去把牠們趕走，林奶奶卻輕輕按住{his}手臂，朝牆角的水管努了努嘴，壓低聲音說：「別急，還有一位客人呢。」
一隻赤腹松鼠順著水管溜了下來，尾巴蓬得像一支雞毛撢子。牠東張西望，接著熟門熟路地掀開裝種子的小鐵盒，抓起一把葵花子往嘴裡塞，兩頰鼓得圓滾滾。{name}差點笑出聲：「原來鐵盒的蓋子是牠打開的！」松鼠抖抖尾巴，吱吱叫了兩聲，好像在說早安。
回到屋裡，{name}托著下巴想了好久。把牠們趕走很容易，可是小鳥要吃飯，松鼠也得填飽肚子啊。「奶奶，我們幫牠們開一間餐廳吧！」林奶奶眼睛一亮，翻出舊木板、麻繩和一個空牛奶盒。奶奶負責鋸木板，{name}負責量尺寸、畫設計圖，兩人忙得不亦樂乎。
週末，小小的餵食台掛上了菜園另一頭的晾衣架。上層放葵花子和碎果皮，下層擺一小碟清水。隔天一早，白頭翁在餵食台上嘰嘰喳喳開飯，松鼠抱著葵花子吃得津津有味，番茄架上的果子一顆也沒少。{name}在筆記本最後一頁寫下：「案子破了，菜園多了幾位新鄰居。」
en: On the roof of the apartment building there was a little garden that {name} had planted with Grandma Lin from across the hall. The cherry tomatoes glowed red, and the pea pods dangled like tiny green bells. But this week, strange things kept happening. Five tomatoes vanished. Pea pods were left empty. Even the plumpest strawberry was gone. "We have a thief!" {name} said, stamping one foot.

Grandma Lin pushed up her glasses and smiled. "Then let's become detectives." {name} opened a notebook right away and wrote down every clue: tiny claw prints in the soil, sharp little holes in the leaves, and half a nibbled pea pod lying beside a flowerpot. {name} frowned and reasoned it out. "The thief is small, and there's more than one." Grandma Lin nodded. They would stake out the garden at dawn.

The next morning, Mom said {name} could go up to the roof with Grandma Lin. The two detectives crouched beside a big cardboard box behind the clothes rack, barely breathing, not moving a muscle. The sky slowly turned from gray-blue to pale gold. {name}'s legs began to tingle, and a stomach rumbled loudly, so Grandma Lin passed over a rice ball. Just then, something rustled by the tomato vines.

Three little bulbuls fluttered onto the tomato stakes, chirping and chattering. They tilted their heads and took turns pecking, until juice splattered from the reddest tomatoes. {name} was ready to leap out and shoo them away, but Grandma Lin gently touched {his} arm. She nodded toward the drainpipe in the corner and whispered, "Wait. There's one more guest."

A squirrel with a rusty-red belly scurried down the pipe, its tail fluffed up like a feather duster. It glanced left and right, then calmly flipped open the little tin of seeds, as if it did this every day. It stuffed sunflower seeds into its mouth until its cheeks bulged. {name} nearly laughed out loud. "So that's who keeps opening the lid!" The squirrel flicked its tail and chattered, as if saying good morning.

Back inside, {name} sat with chin in hand, thinking hard. Chasing them off would be easy, but birds need breakfast, and squirrels get hungry too. "Grandma, let's open a restaurant for them!" Grandma Lin's eyes sparkled. She dug out old boards, some rope, and an empty milk carton. She did the sawing, while {name} measured everything and drew the plans. They had a wonderful time.

That weekend, a small feeder hung from the clothes rack at the far end of the garden. Sunflower seeds and fruit peels sat on top, with a dish of fresh water below. The next morning, the bulbuls chirped over their breakfast, the squirrel munched happily, and not a single tomato went missing. On the last page of the notebook, {name} wrote: "Case closed. The garden has some new neighbors."

questions: 看到泥土上的爪印和葉子上的小洞時，你猜小偷會是誰？
清晨躲在紙箱旁邊埋伏，如果換成是你，你會覺得緊張、好玩，還是有點想睡？
如果你也幫小動物開一間餐廳，你想取什麼店名？菜單上會有什麼？
zh.tip: 今晚躺在床上，輪流輕聲說出三個「線索」，讓對方猜猜是哪一種小動物或家裡的東西；明天有空時，再一起畫一張你們自己的餵食台設計圖。

questions: When you heard about the claw prints and the little holes in the leaves, who did you guess the thief was?
If you were hiding by the cardboard box at dawn, would you feel nervous, excited, or a little sleepy?
If you opened a restaurant for animals too, what would you name it, and what would be on the menu?
en.tip: Tonight in bed, take turns whispering three "clues" about an animal or something in your home and let the other person guess. Tomorrow, you could draw your own feeder design together.

title.zh: 小小的{name}和高高的長頸鹿

zh: 今天，{name}和媽媽去動物園。走呀走，走呀走。哇！好高好高的長頸鹿！牠的脖子長長的。牠的腿也長長的。{name}抬頭看，看呀看。脖子都酸酸了！
長頸鹿伸長脖子。咬一口樹頂的葉子。嚼嚼嚼，嚼嚼嚼。看起來好好吃喔！{name}說：「我也想高高的！」{name}踮起腳尖。踮呀踮，踮呀踮。還是小小的。
{name}跳一跳。蹦！蹦！蹦！還是碰不到葉子。媽媽笑了：「跳得好可愛。」{name}也咯咯笑。跳累了，蹲下來。休息一下下。
咦？草地上有小紅點。小紅點，圓又圓。小紅點，會走路！原來是一隻小瓢蟲！背上有黑點點。一個、兩個、三個。
瓢蟲爬上小草。爬呀爬，爬呀爬。{name}小聲說：「哈囉，小瓢蟲。」瓢蟲搖搖小觸角。好像也在說哈囉。{name}看得好清楚。
{name}抬頭問：「長頸鹿，你看到了嗎？」長頸鹿低頭找。找呀找，找呀找。太遠了，看不到。長頸鹿眨眨大眼睛。好像在問：「在哪裡呀？」
{name}笑了。高高的，看得到葉子。小小的，看得到瓢蟲。高高很好玩。小小也很好玩！瓢蟲張開翅膀。呼——飛走了。
{name}站在下面揮揮手。「長頸鹿，拜拜！」長頸鹿點點頭。嚼嚼嚼，好像也說拜拜。{name}牽著媽媽的手。小小的{name}，好開心！
en: Today {name} visits the zoo with Mom. Walk, walk, walk. Wow! A giraffe! So tall, so tall! Long, long neck. Long, long legs. {name} looks up, up, up.
The giraffe stretches way up high. It nibbles leaves from the treetop. Munch, munch, munch. Yum, yum, yum! "I want to be tall too!" says {name}. Tiptoe, tiptoe. Still small.
{name} jumps and jumps. Boing! Boing! Boing! Still no leaves. Mom giggles. "What a bouncy jump!" {name} giggles too. Then {name} squats down for a little rest.
Look! A tiny red dot in the grass. A round red dot. A walking red dot! It is a little ladybug! Black spots on its back. One, two, three.
The ladybug climbs a blade of grass. Up, up, up it goes. "Hello, little ladybug," {name} whispers. The ladybug wiggles its feelers. Hello back! {name} sees it so well.
{name} looks up. "Giraffe, can you see it?" The giraffe looks down. Look, look, look. Too far away! The giraffe blinks its big eyes. "Where is it?"
{name} smiles. Tall friends see treetop leaves. Small friends see little ladybugs. Tall is fun. Small is fun too! The ladybug opens its wings. Whoosh! Away it flies.
{name} waves from down below. "Bye-bye, Giraffe!" The giraffe nods. Munch, munch. Bye-bye too! {name} holds Mom's hand. Little {name} feels happy, happy, happy.

questions: 長頸鹿的脖子有多長？你可以用小手比給我看嗎？
{name}跳呀跳，蹦！蹦！蹦！你也想跳跳看嗎？
小瓢蟲的背上有幾個黑點點？我們一起數數看！
zh.tip: 關燈前，和孩子躺著輕輕用手指在被子上「爬呀爬」，扮成小瓢蟲，小聲說「哈囉」和「晚安」。

questions: How long was the giraffe's neck? Can you show me with your hands?
{name} went boing, boing, boing! Do you like to jump like that?
How many black spots did the ladybug have? Let's count them together!
en.tip: Before lights out, snuggle up and let your fingers crawl softly over the blanket like a little ladybug, whispering "hello" and "good night."

zh: 夜晚來了。月亮圓圓的。屋裡暖暖的，燈光黃黃的。媽媽抱著小寶寶。媽媽輕輕唸故事。寶寶聽著聽著，打了個小呵欠。{name}站在門邊，看著看著。
{name}抱著小熊。心裡有一點酸酸的。「媽媽都陪寶寶。」{name}小小聲說。「我也想聽故事。」媽媽抬起頭，笑了。「來，坐我旁邊。」
{name}靠著媽媽。媽媽摸摸{his}頭。「你有點難過，對嗎？」{name}點點頭。「謝謝你告訴我。」媽媽說。「愛就像這盞燈。多一個人，也照得到。」
「我們想個新計畫。」媽媽說。「先請你唸書給寶寶聽。然後媽媽唸大孩子的故事。只唸給你一個人聽。」{name}的眼睛亮亮的。「好！」
{name}挑了一本小書。書裡有小鴨子。{name}翻開第一頁。「小鴨子，呱呱呱。」寶寶看著{name}。「小鴨子，游游游。」寶寶的小手動一動。
{name}翻到最後一頁。「小鴨子，晚安囉。」寶寶的眼睛閉起來了。呼——呼——寶寶睡著了。媽媽輕輕說：「你唸得真好。寶寶好喜歡你。」{name}笑得甜甜的。
媽媽把寶寶放進小床。再抱著{name}，鑽進被子。被子軟軟的，暖暖的。媽媽拿出一本大書。「這是大孩子的故事。」書裡有星星，有小船，還有月亮。
媽媽的聲音慢慢的，輕輕的。窗外好安靜。燈光暗暗的。{name}的眼睛好重，好重。「我是最棒的大孩子。」{name}小聲說。媽媽親親{his}額頭。「晚安，我的寶貝。」
en: Night came. The moon was round and bright. The house felt warm. The lamp glowed soft and gold. Mom held the baby close. She read a story, slow and low. The baby gave a tiny yawn. {name} stood by the door, watching.
